IDX.translation_intro: Śrī Manaḥ-śikṣā
IDX.en_translation:
O my mind, my brother! I entreat you with folded hands: always give up pride and develop unprecedented, intense attachment for your spiritual master, the village of Vraja and its residents, all good people, the assembly of priests, your own mantra, the Holy Name, and the shelter of the youthful Divine Couple of Vraja. 

O mind, do not perform the pious or impious acts described in the Vedas. Instead, engage in abundant service to Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa here in Vraja. Always remember the son of Śacī as non-different from Kṛṣṇa, the son of the Lord of Vraja, and as the topmost spiritual master. Remember Him as the dearmost of Kṛṣṇa here eternally. 

O mind, listen then! If you desire to reside in the land of Vraja with great affection in every birth, and if you long to serve the youthful Divine Couple intimately, then clearly and perpetually remember with love Svarūpa Dāmodara, Śrī Rūpa Gosvāmī along with his associates, and his elder brother Sanātana Gosvāmī, and offer obeisances to them. 

O mind, abandon the prostitute of unholy talk, which steals all intelligence. Indeed, do not listen to the tiger of impersonal liberation, which devours the entire self. Even giving up the attachment to the Lord of Vaikuṇṭha in the spiritual sky, worship the couple Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa in Vraja, who are the givers of the jewel of Their own love. 

O mind, here I feel as if I am being strangled and killed, entangled by the ugly nooses of sinful acts that cause suffering and the manifest entanglements of lust and other vices. In the path of Kṛṣṇa—the killer of Bakāsura—cry out so that He may protect you from this path. 

O mind! How can you burn yourself and me by bathing in the pungent urine of increasing deceit and crooked drama? Always bathe in the nectarine ocean of love for the lotus feet of Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa, and thus please yourself and me greatly. 

O mind, how can pure divine love touch this heart of mine where the shameless desire for fame—like a dog-eating woman—dances? Always serve the incomparable beloved associate of the Lord—devotional service—so that he may quickly evict that desire for fame and enthrone pure love here. 

O mind, worship Kṛṣṇa here in the cowherd village with fervent prayers in such a way that by His mercy He may burn away my wickedness, even though I am deceitful; that He may bestow upon me the brilliant nectar of prema (divine love); that He may inspire me in the method of worshiping Śrī Rādhā. 

O mind, remember Kṛṣṇa—the moon of Vraja—as the Lord of my Lord. Remember the Queen of Vraja, Rādhā, as His Lord. Remember Lalitā as Her incomparable friend. Remember Viśākhā as the teacher who bestows instructions. Remember Govardhana Hill and Rādhā-kuṇḍa as the givers of beautiful love by Their mere sight. 

O mind, worship the beloved of Hari, Rādhā, who by the rays of Her beauty eclipses even the pastimes of Pārvatī; who by the abundance of Her good fortune defeats Śacī, Lakṣmī, and Satyabhāmā; and who by Her captivating power throws away the chaste new gopīs headed by Candrāvalī. 

O mind, desiring to attain direct service to Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa—who are overwhelmed by transcendental love—in Vraja, along with Śrī Rūpa and his associates, always drink these five nectars: worshiping Them, chanting Their names, meditating on Them, hearing about Them, and offering obeisances to Them. In this way, daily worship Govardhana Hill. 

Whoever, becoming a follower of Śrī Rūpānuga along with his associates here in the forest of Gokula, sings aloud these excellent eleven-verse instructions to the mind with sweet words and thus comprehends all meanings, will attain the incomparable jewel of devotional service to Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa.

chandram vrajavane svarim tannathatve tadatula sakhitve tu lalitam visakham siksali vitarana gurutve priya saro girindrau tatpreksa lalita rati datve smara manah ratim gauri lile api tapati saundarya kiranaih sachi laksmi satyah paribhavati saubhagya valanaih vasikaraischandravali mukha navina vrajasatih ksipatyarad ja tam hari dayita radham bhaja manah samam sri rupena smara vivasa radha giribhrto rvraje saksat seva labhana vidhaye tad gana yujoh tadijyakhya dhyana sravana nati panchamrtamidam dhayannitya govardhanamanudinam tvam bhaja manah manahsiksaikadasaka varametanmadhuraya gira gayatyuccḣaih samadhigata sarvartha tati jah sayuthah sri rupanuga iha bhavan gokulavane jano radha krsnatula bhajana ratnam sa labhate
IDX.author: raghunāthadāsa gosvāmī
IDX.verses:
gurau goṣṭhe goṣṭhālayiṣu sujane bhūsuragaṇe 
svamantre śhrī-nāmni vraja-nava-yuva-dvandva-śharaṇe 
sadā dambhaṁ hitvā kuru ratimapūrvāmatitarā- 
maye svāntarbhrātaśhchaṭubhirabhiyāche dhṛta-padaḥ 

na dharmaṁ nādharmaṁ śhrutigaṇa-niruktaṁ kila kuru 
vraje rādhā-kṛṣṇa-prachura-paricharyāmiha tanu 
śhachī-sūnuṁ nandīśhvara-pati-sutattve guruvaraṁ 
mukunda-preṣṭhatve smara paramajasraṁ nanu manaḥ 

jadīccḣerāvāsaṁ vrajabhuvi sarāgaṁ pratijanur 
yuva-dvandvaṁ taccḣet paricharitumārādabhilaṣeḥ 
svarūpaṁ śhrī-rūpaṁ sagaṇamiha tasyāgrajamapi 
sfuṭaṁ premṇā nityaṁ smara nama tadā tvaṁ śhṛṇu manaḥ 

asadvārtā-veśhyā visṛja mati-sarvasva-haraṇīḥ 
kathā mukti-vyāghrā na śhṛṇu kila sarvātma-gilanīḥ 
api tyaktva lakṣmī-pati-ratimito vyoma-nayanīṁ 
vraje rādhā-kṛṣṇau sva-rati-maṇidau tvaṁ bhaja manaḥ 

asaccḣeṣṭā-kaṣṭa-prada-vikaṭa-pāśhālibhiriha 
prakāmaṁ kāmādi-prakaṭa-patha-pāti-vyatikaraiḥ 
gale vaddhvā hanye‛hamiti vakabhid-vartmapa-gaṇe 
kuru tvāṁ futkārānavati sa jathā tvāṁ mana itaḥ 

are chetaḥ prodyat-kapaṭa-kuṭi-nāṭī-bhara-khara- 
kṣaranmūtre snātvā dahasi kathamātmānamapi mām 
sadā tvaṁ gāndharvā-giridhara-pada-prema-vilasat- 
sudhāmbhodhau snātvā svamapi nitarāṁ māñcha sukhaya 

pratiṣṭhāśhā dhṛṣṭā śhvapacharamaṇī me hṛdi naṭet 
kathaṁ sādhuḥ premā spṛśhati śhuchiretannanu manaḥ 
sadā tvaṁ sevasva prabhu-dayita-sāmantamatulaṁ 
jathā tāṁ niṣkāśhya tvaritamiha taṁ veśhayati saḥ 

jathā duṣṭatvaṁ me davayati śhaṭhasyāpi kṛpayā 
jathā mahyaṁ premāmṛtamapi dadātyujjvalamasau 
jathā śhrī-gāndharvā-bhajana-vidhaye prerayati māṁ 
tathā goṣṭhe kākvā giridharamiha tvaṁ bhaja manaḥ 

madīśhānāthatve vraja-vipina-chandraṁ vrajavane- 
śhvarīṁ tannāthatve tadatula-sakhītve tu lalitām 
viśhākhāṁ śhikṣālī-vitaraṇa-gurutve priya-saro- 
girīndrau tatprekṣā-lalita-rati-datve smara manaḥ 

ratiṁ gaurī-līle api tapati saundarya-kiraṇaiḥ 
śhachī-lakṣmī-satyāḥ paribhavati saubhāgya-valanaiḥ 
vaśhīkāraiśhchandrāvalī-mukha-navīna-vrajasatīḥ 
kṣipatyārād jā tāṁ hari-dayita-rādhāṁ bhaja manaḥ 

samaṁ śhrī-rūpeṇa smara-vivaśha-rādhā-giribhṛto- 
rvraje sākṣāt-sevā-labhana-vidhaye tad-gaṇa-yujoḥ 
tadijyākhyā-dhyāna-śhravaṇa-nati pañchāmṛtamidaṁ 
dhayannītyā govardhanamanudinaṁ tvaṁ bhaja manaḥ 

manaḥśhikṣaikādaśhaka-varametanmadhurayā 
girā gāyatyuccḣaiḥ samadhigata-sarvārtha-tati jaḥ 
sayūthaḥ śhrī-rūpānuga iha bhavan gokulavane 
jano rādhā-kṛṣṇātula-bhajana-ratnaṁ sa labhate
IDX.translation_intro: Śrī Manaḥ-śikṣā
IDX.en_translation:
O my mind, my brother! I entreat you with folded hands: always give up pride and develop unprecedented, intense attachment for your spiritual master, the village of Vraja and its residents, all good people, the assembly of priests, your own mantra, the Holy Name, and the shelter of the youthful Divine Couple of Vraja. 

O mind, do not perform the pious or impious acts described in the Vedas. Instead, engage in abundant service to Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa here in Vraja. Always remember the son of Śacī as non-different from Kṛṣṇa, the son of the Lord of Vraja, and as the topmost spiritual master. Remember Him as the dearmost of Kṛṣṇa here eternally. 

O mind, listen then! If you desire to reside in the land of Vraja with great affection in every birth, and if you long to serve the youthful Divine Couple intimately, then clearly and perpetually remember with love Svarūpa Dāmodara, Śrī Rūpa Gosvāmī along with his associates, and his elder brother Sanātana Gosvāmī, and offer obeisances to them. 

O mind, abandon the prostitute of unholy talk, which steals all intelligence. Indeed, do not listen to the tiger of impersonal liberation, which devours the entire self. Even giving up the attachment to the Lord of Vaikuṇṭha in the spiritual sky, worship the couple Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa in Vraja, who are the givers of the jewel of Their own love. 

O mind, here I feel as if I am being strangled and killed, entangled by the ugly nooses of sinful acts that cause suffering and the manifest entanglements of lust and other vices. In the path of Kṛṣṇa—the killer of Bakāsura—cry out so that He may protect you from this path. 

O mind! How can you burn yourself and me by bathing in the pungent urine of increasing deceit and crooked drama? Always bathe in the nectarine ocean of love for the lotus feet of Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa, and thus please yourself and me greatly. 

O mind, how can pure divine love touch this heart of mine where the shameless desire for fame—like a dog-eating woman—dances? Always serve the incomparable beloved associate of the Lord—devotional service—so that he may quickly evict that desire for fame and enthrone pure love here. 

O mind, worship Kṛṣṇa here in the cowherd village with fervent prayers in such a way that by His mercy He may burn away my wickedness, even though I am deceitful; that He may bestow upon me the brilliant nectar of prema (divine love); that He may inspire me in the method of worshiping Śrī Rādhā. 

O mind, remember Kṛṣṇa—the moon of Vraja—as the Lord of my Lord. Remember the Queen of Vraja, Rādhā, as His Lord. Remember Lalitā as Her incomparable friend. Remember Viśākhā as the teacher who bestows instructions. Remember Govardhana Hill and Rādhā-kuṇḍa as the givers of beautiful love by Their mere sight. 

O mind, worship the beloved of Hari, Rādhā, who by the rays of Her beauty eclipses even the pastimes of Pārvatī; who by the abundance of Her good fortune defeats Śacī, Lakṣmī, and Satyabhāmā; and who by Her captivating power throws away the chaste new gopīs headed by Candrāvalī. 

O mind, desiring to attain direct service to Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa—who are overwhelmed by transcendental love—in Vraja, along with Śrī Rūpa and his associates, always drink these five nectars: worshiping Them, chanting Their names, meditating on Them, hearing about Them, and offering obeisances to Them. In this way, daily worship Govardhana Hill. 

Whoever, becoming a follower of Śrī Rūpānuga along with his associates here in the forest of Gokula, sings aloud these excellent eleven-verse instructions to the mind with sweet words and thus comprehends all meanings, will attain the incomparable jewel of devotional service to Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa.

IDX.author: raghunāthadāsa gosvāmī
IDX.verses:
gurau mantre nāmni prabhuvara-śhachī-garbhaja-pade 
svarūpe śhrī-rūpe gaṇayuji tadīya-prathamaje 
girīndre gāndharvāsarasi madhurpuyyāṁ vrajavane 
vraje bhakte goṣṭhālayiṣu paramāstāṁ mama ratiḥ 

na chānyatra kṣetre hari-tanusanāthehapi sujanād 
rasāsvādaṁ premnā dadhadapi vasāmi kṣaṇam-api 
samaṁ tvetad-grāmyāvalibhirabhi tanvannapi kathāṁ 
vidhāsye saṁvāsaṁ vraja-bhuvana eva pratibhavam 

sadā rādhā-kṛṣṇoccḣaladatula-khelāsthalayujaṁ 
vrajaṁ santyajyaitad-yugavirahito‛pi kraṭimapi 
punardvārāvatyāṁ jadupatimapi prauḍhavibhavaiḥ 
sfurantaṁ tadvāchāpi hi nahi chalāmīkṣitumapi 

gatonmādai rādhā sfurati hariṇā śhliṣṭahṛdayā 
sfuṭaṁ dvārāvatyāmiti jadi śhṛṇomi śhrutitaṭe 
tadāhaṁ tatraivoddhatamati patāmi vrajapurāt 
samuḍḍīya svāntādhikagati-khagendrādapi javāt 

anādiḥ sādirvā paṭuratimṛdurvā pratipada- 
pramīlatkāruṇyaḥ praguṇakaruṇāhīna iti vā 
mahā-vaikuṇṭheśhādhika iha naro vā vrajapate- 
rayaṁ sūnurgoṣṭhe prati-jani mamāstāṁ prabhuvaraḥ 

anādṛtyodagītāmapi munigaṇairvaiṇikamukhaiḥ 
pravīṇāṁ gāndharvāmapi cha nigamaistat priyatamām 
ja ekaṁ govindaṁ bhajati kapaṭī dāmbhikatayā 
tadabhyarṇe śhīrṇe kṣaṇamapi na jāmi vratamidam 

ajāṇḍe rādheti-sfuradabhidhayāsiktajanayā- 
‛nayā sākaṁ kṛṣṇaṁ bhajati ja iha premanamitaḥ 
paraṁ prakṣālyetaccḣaraṇa-kamale tajjalamaho 
mudā pītvā śhaśhvaccḣirasi cha vahāmi pratidinam 

parityaktaḥpreyojanasamudayairvāḍhamasudhī- 
rdurandho nīrandhraṁ kadanabharavārdhau nipatitaḥ 
tṛṇaṁ dantairdaṣṭvā chaṭubhirabhiyāchehadya kṛpayā 
svayaṁ śhrī-gāndharvā svapadanalināntaṁ nayatu mām 

vrajotpanna-kṣīrāśhana-vasanapātrādibhirahaṁ 
padārthairnirvāhya vyavahṛtimadambhaṁ saniyamaḥ 
vasāmīśhākuṇḍe giri-kula-vare chaiva samaye 
mariṣye tu preṣṭhe sarasi jīvādipurataḥ 

sfurallakṣmīlakṣmī -vrajavijayilakṣmībhara-lasad- 
vapuḥ śhrī-gāndharvāsmaranikara-divyad giribhṛtoḥ 
vidhāsye kuñjādau vividha-varivasyāḥ sa-rabhasaṁ 
rahaḥ śhrī-rūpākhyapriyatamajanasyaiva charamaḥ 

kṛtaṁ kenāpyetannīja-niyamaśhaṁsi-stavamimaṁ 
paṭhet jo visravdhaḥ priya-yugala-rūpe‛rpita-manāḥ 
dṛḍhaṁ goṣṭhe hṛṣṭo vasati-vasatiṁ prāpya samaye 
mudā rādhā-kṛṣṇau bhajati sa hi tenaiva sahitaḥ
IDX.en_translation:
Let my supreme love be for the Spiritual Master, the mantra, the Holy Name, and the lotus feet of Lord Caitanya. Let it be for Svarūpa Dāmodara, Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī and his associates, and his elder brother Sanātana Gosvāmī. Let it be for Govardhana Hill, Rādhā-kuṇḍa, Mathurā, and the forest of Vraja. Let it be for the devotees and for all the residents of Vraja. 

I will not reside for even a moment in any other place, even if it is a holy place of Lord Hari, or even if I am tasting divine mellows with love from saintly persons there. Rather, I will always make my residence, in every birth, only in the land of Vraja, associating with its inhabitants. 

Abandoning Vraja, where the peerless pastimes of Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa always overflow, I will not go to see even for a moment the Lord of the Yadus resplendent with great opulence in Dvārakā, even if invited. 

If I hear it rumored that Rādhā is appearing in Dvārakā with Lord Hari, then with an agitated mind, I will immediately fly there from Vraja, even faster than Garuḍa. 

Whether He is beginningless or has a beginning, whether He is expert or very gentle, whether His compassion blossoms at every step or is seemingly absent, whether He is greater than the Lord of Vaikuṇṭha or just a human being here—let this Son of Nanda Mahārāja in Vraja be my only Lord in every birth. 

This is my vow: I will not go for even a moment near that deceitful and arrogant person who worships Lord Govinda alone, disregarding Śrīmati Rādhā-rāṇī, who is most dear to the Vedas and is sung by all the sages. 

Whoever worships Lord Kṛṣṇa along with Rādhā, bowing down with love—I will wash his lotus feet, drink that water with joy, and always carry it on my head every day. 

Utterly bewildered, having abandoned all beneficial purposes, and deeply fallen into an ocean of misery, I bite a blade of grass between my teeth and humbly beg today: “Let Śrīmati Rādhā-rāṇī herself lead me to Her lotus feet!” 

Sustaining my life without pride with the milk, food, and clothes produced in Vraja, I will reside at Rādhā-kuṇḍa and Govardhana Hill. And I will die at that most beloved lake in front of the devotees. 

As the ultimate follower of the most beloved Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī, I will eagerly and secretly perform various services in the groves for Śrīmati Rādhā-rāṇī and for Lord Kṛṣṇa, who is resplendent with the beauty of many Cupids. 

He who reads with faith this hymn, which proclaims his own vow, with his mind offered to the Divine Couple, will certainly attain a firm and joyful residence in Vraja and will worship Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa along with Their associates.

gurau śhrī-gaurāṅge tad-udita-su-bhakti-prakaraṇe 
śhachī-sunor-līlā-vikasita-su-tīrthe nija-manau 
harer namni preṣṭhe hari-tithiṣu rupānuga-jane 
śhuka-prokte śhāstre prati-jani mamāstāṁ khalu ratiḥ 

sadā vṛndāranye madhura-rasa-dhanye rasa-mayaḥ 
parāṁ śhaktiṁ rādhāṁ parama-rasa-mūrtiṁ ramayati 
sa chaivāyam kṛṣṇo nija-bhajana-mudrām-upadiśhan 
śhachī-sūnur gauḍe prati-jani mamāstāṁ prabhu-varaḥ 

na vairāgyaṁ grāhyaṁ bhavati na hi jad bhakti-janitaṁ 
tathā jñānaṁ bhānaṁ chiti jadi viśheṣaṁ na manute 
spṛhā me nāṣṭaṅge hari-bhajana-saukhyaṁ na hi jatas 
tato rādhā-kṛṣṇa-prachura-paricharyā bhavatu me 

kuṭīre ‘pi kṣudre vraja-bhajana-yogye taru-tale 
śhachī-sūnos tīrthe bhavatu nitarāṁ me nivasatiḥ 
na chānyatra kṣetre vibudha-gaṇa-sevye pulakito 
vasāmi prāsāde vipula-dhana-rājyānvita iha 

na varṇe saktir me na khalu mamatā hyāśhrama-vidhau- 
na dharme nddharme mama ratir ihāste kvachid api 
param tat-tad-dharme mama jaḍa-śharīram dhṛtam idam 
ato dharmān sarvān su-bhajana-sahāyānn abhilaṣe 

su-dainyaṁ sāralyaṁ sakala-sahanaṁ mānada-danaṁ 
dayāṁ svīkṛtya śhrī-hari-charana-sevā mama tapaḥ 
sadāchāro ‘sau me prabhu-pada-parair jaḥ samuditaḥ 
prabhos chaitanyasyākṣaya-charita-pīyūṣa-kṛtiṣu 

na vaikuṇṭhe rājye na cha viṣaya-kārye mama ratir 
na nirvāṇe mokṣe mama matir ihāste kṣaṇam api 
vrajānandād anyad hari-vilasitaṁ pāvanam api 
kathañchin māṁ rādhānvaya-virahitaṁ no sukhayati 

na me patnī-kanyā-tanaya-jananī-bandhu-nichayā 
harau bhakte bhaktau na khalu jadi teṣāṁ su-mamatā 
abhaktānām-anna-grahaṇam api dośho viṣayiṇāṁ 
kathaṁ teṣāṁ saṅgād hari-bhajana-siddhir bhavati me? 

asat-tarkair-andhān jaḍa-sukha-parān kṛṣṇa-vimukhān 
ku-nirvāṇāsaktān satatam ati-dūre pariharan 
arādhāṁ govindaṁ bhajati nitarāṁ dāmbhikatayā 
tad-abhyāse kintu kṣaṇam api na jāmi vratam idam 

prasādānna-kṣīrāśhana-vasana-pātrādibhir ahaṁ 
padārthair nirvāhya vyavahṛtim asaṅgaḥ ku-viṣaye 
vasann īśha-kṣetre yugala-bhajanānandita-manas 
tanuṁ mokṣye kāle juga-pada-parāṇāṁ pada-tale 

śhachī-sūnor-ājñā-grahaṇa-chaturo jo vraja-vane 
parārādhyāṁ rādhām bhajati nitarām kṛṣṇa-rasikām 
ahaṁ tvetat-pādāmṛtam anudinaṁ naiṣṭhika-manā 
vaheyaṁ vai pītvā śhirasi cha mudā sannati-yutaḥ 

harer dāsyaṁ dharmo mama tu chira-kālaṁ prakṛtito 
mahā-māyā-yogād-abhinipatitaḥ duḥkha-jaladhau 
ito jāsyāmy ūrdhvaṁ sva-niyama-su-ratya prati-dinaṁ 
sahāyo me mātraṁ vitatha-dalanī vaiṣṇava-krpā - 

kṛtaṁ kenāpyetat sva-bhajana-vidhau svaṁ niyamakāṁ 
paṭhed jo viśhraddhaḥ priya-yugala-rūpe ‘rpita manaḥ 
vraje rādhā-kṛṣṇau bhajati kila saṁprāpya nilayaṁ 
sva-mañjaryāḥ paśhchād vividha-varivasyāṁ sa kurute
IDX.en_translation:
May my attachment, in every birth, be to the Spiritual Master, to Lord Gaurāṅga, to the practices of pure devotion taught by Him, to the holy places where the Son of Mother Śacī performed His pastimes, to my own mantra, to the Holy Name of Lord Hari, to the holy days of the Lord, to the followers of Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī, and to the scriptures spoken by Śukadeva Gosvāmī. 

May that same Lord Kṛṣṇa, who always enjoys in the forest of Vṛndāvana with Rādhā—the supreme potency and personification of the highest mellows—and who has appeared as the Son of Mother Śacī in the land of Gauḍa teaching His own method of worship, be my supreme Lord in every birth. 

Renunciation that is not born of devotion is not acceptable. Similarly, knowledge and realization are of no special value if they do not lead to spiritual consciousness. I have no desire for the eight-fold yoga process, because there is no happiness of worshipping Lord Hari within it. Therefore, may I be blessed with abundant service to Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa. 

May my residence always be in the holy land of the Son of Mother Śacī, even if it is in a tiny cottage suitable for the worship of Vraja, or under a tree. I have no desire to reside even in a palace endowed with vast wealth and a kingdom in any other place, even if it were served by the demigods. 

I have no attachment to social class or the regulations of the spiritual orders of life. My attachment is not at all in pious or impious deeds. But since this material body is sustained by those duties, I desire all such duties only as they serve as aids to pure devotional service. 

Great humility, simplicity, tolerance of all things, giving respect to others, and accepting mercy—the service of the lotus feet of Lord Hari is my only austerity. This good conduct of mine has been spoken of by those devoted to the lotus feet of the Lord in their descriptions of the nectarean character of Lord Caitanya. 

I have no attachment to the spiritual world of Vaikuṇṭha, nor to worldly activities. My mind is not interested even for a moment in impersonal liberation. Other than the bliss of Vraja, even the pure pastimes of Lord Hari do not make me happy if they are without a connection to Rādhā. 

I do not care for my wife, children, mother, or any relatives if they do not have deep affection for Lord Hari, His devotees, and the path of devotion. Even accepting food from non-devotees and materialistic people is a fault. How then, through their association, could I ever attain perfection in the worship of Lord Hari? 

I will always keep far away from those who are blinded by false arguments, those devoted to material happiness, those averse to Lord Kṛṣṇa, and those who worship Lord Govinda without Rādhā out of great pride. I will not follow their practices for even a single moment; this is my vow. 

Managing my life with the food, milk, clothing, and utensils produced in the holy land, and remaining unattached to worldly affairs, I will reside in the land of the Lord. With a mind delighted by the worship of the Divine Couple, I will give up my body at the lotus feet of those who are devoted to Them. 

With a firm mind, I will daily carry upon my head and drink the nectar of the lotus feet of that person who is expert in following the orders of the Son of Mother Śacī, and who worships with great devotion the supremely worshipable Rādhā in the forests of Vraja. 

Servitude to Lord Hari is my natural and eternal duty. I have fallen into the ocean of misery due to the influence of the great illusory energy. From this state I will rise daily with my own regulated practice and great attachment. My only helper is the mercy of the devotees, which destroys all illusion. 

Whoever reads this hymn, which was composed as a set of regulations for the method of worship, with great faith and a mind offered to the Divine Couple, will surely attain Their abode and worship Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa in Vraja, performing various services as a maidservant.

IDX.first_line: gurudeva baḍa kṛpā kari’ gauḍa vana mājhe
IDX.search: gurudeva bada krpa kari gauda vana majhe godrume diyacḣa sthana ajna dila more ei vraje basi harinama kara gana kintu kabe prabhu jogyata arpibe e dasere daya kari chitta sthira habe sakala sahiba ekante bhajiba hari saisava yauvane jada sukha sange abhyasa hoila manda nija karma dose e deha hoila bhajanera pratibandha vardhakye ekhana pancha roge hata kemane bhajiba bala kandiya kandiya tomara charane padiyacḣi suvihvala
IDX.author: sacchidānanda bhaktivinoda ṭhākura
IDX.verses:
gurudeva! 
baḍa kṛpā kari’, gauḍa-vana-mājhe, 
godrume diyācḣa sthāna 
ājñā dilā more, ei vraje basi’, 
harināma kara gāna 

kintu kabe prabhu, jogyatā arpibe, 
e dāsere dayā kari’ 
chitta sthira ha’be, sakala sahiba, 
ekānte bhajiba hari 

śhaiśhava-yauvane, jaḍa-sukha-saṅge, 
abhyāsa hoila manda 
nija karma-doṣe, e deha hoila, 
bhajanera pratibandha 

vārdhakye ekhana, pañcha-roge hata, 
kemane bhajiba bala 
kāṅdiyā kāṅdiyā, tomāra charaṇe, 
paḍiyācḣi suvihvala
IDX.translation_intro: From The Harmonist, June 1930. Edited by Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī.
IDX.en_translation:
Gurudeva! Out of thy great mercy, ‘Mid the wood-land of Gauda, Thou hast given me a place in Godruma. Thou hast given me thy command,- Abiding here in Braja You sing the Name of Hari. 

But when, O revered one! Wilt thou, out of thy mercy, Bestow the fitness on this slave? When will my mind be tranquil, I will bear up with all, And serve Hari with singleness of heart? 

In childhood and youth, By contact with worldly pleasure, My habit has grown corrupt. By my own evil deeds This body has become A hindrance to the service of God. 

Now in old age Smitten with the five-fold malady <highlight>[or pañca-kleśa, namely, ignorance, false ego, material attachment, aversion, and absorption in material objects]</highlight>, Teach me how I am to serve, Crying with anguish, At thy feet I fall in this great distress.
IDX.es_translation:
Gurudeva, en Tu misericordia me diste un lugar en Godruma, en los bosques de Śhrī Gauḍa-maṇḍala, y me ordenaste que residiera en este lugar que es (no diferente de) Vraja y cantara los santos nombres de Śhrī Hari. 

Pero, ¡oh, maestro!, ¿cuándo darás misericordiosamente a este sirviente tuyo la cualificación (para cumplir tu orden)? Solo entonces mi mente encontrará sosiego y podré tolerar todas las dificultades y hacer bhajana de Śhrī Hari. 

Por entregarme al disfrute mundano, cultivé muchos hábitos desfavorables (al bhakti) en mi niñez y mi juventud, y debido a las reacciones de esos actos pecaminosos este cuerpo se ha vuelto un impedimento para el bhajana. 

Ahora, en mi vejez, afligido por las enfermedades de los cinco sentidos, ¿cómo puedo hacer bhajana? Llorando amargamente y lleno de ansiedad, yo me postro a tus pies de loto.

IDX.title: tuwā bhakti-anukūla
IDX.author: sacchidānanda bhaktivinoda ṭhākura
IDX.search: tuwa bhakti anukula je je karya haya parama jatane taha koribo nishchaya bhakti anukula jato visaya saṁsare koribo tahate rati indriyera dvare shunibo tomara katha jatana koriya dekhibo tomara dhama nayana bhoriya tomara prasade deha koribo posaṇa naivedya tulasi ghraṇa koribo grahaṇa kara dvare koribo tomara seva sada tomara vasati sthale bosibo sarvada tomara sevaya kama nijoga koribo tomara vidvesi jane krodha dekhaibo ei rupe sarva vrtti ara sarva bhava tuwa anukula ha ye labhuka prabhava tuwa bhakta anukula jaha jaha kori tuwa bhakti anukula boli  taha dhori bhakativinoda nahi jane dharmadharma bhakti anukula ta ra hau saba karma
IDX.verses: tuwā bhakti-anukūla je-je kārya haya parama-jatane tāhā koribo niśhchaya bhakti-anukūla jato viṣaya saṁsāre koribo tāhāte rati indriyera dvāre śhunibo tomāra kathā jatana koriyā dekhibo tomāra dhāma nayana bhoriyā tomāra prasāde deha koribo poṣaṇa naivedya-tulasī-ghrāṇa koribo grahaṇa kara-dvāre koribo tomāra sevā sadā tomāra vasati-sthale bosibo sarvadā tomāra sevāya kāma nijoga koribo tomāra vidveṣi-jane krodha dekhāibo ei-rūpe sarva-vṛtti āra sarva-bhāva tuwā anukūla ha’ye labhuka prabhāva tuwā bhakta-anukūla jāhā jāhā kori tuwā bhakti-anukūla boli’ tāhā dhori bhakativinoda nāhi jāne dharmādharma bhakti-anukūla tā’ra hau saba karma
IDX.translation_intro: From The Harmonist, January 1929. Edited by Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī.
IDX.en_translation:
Whatever activity is favourable for devotion to Thee I will most surely practise with the utmost care. 

For all things of this world that tend to devotion WIill I cherish liking by way of the portals of the senses. 

With care will I listen to Thy word, I will fully employ my eyes in beholding Thy dwelling place. 

I will nourish my body with food provided by Thy grace, I will smell the perfume of the tulasi of the offering. 

With my hands I will serve Thee always, In the place where Thou.dost ahide will I ever dwell. 

My desire I will employ in Thy service, I will show my anger to those who are hostile to Thee. 

May all my faculties and thoughts in this manner, Augment their influence by serving Thee. May I esteem what-so-ever I do in pursuance of Thy service As it tends to devotion to Thyself. 

Bhaktivinode knows neither good nor bad, May all his activities subserve devotion to Thee.
IDX.es_translation:
Realizaré con suma diligencia los actos que son favorables para el bhakti. 

Utilizaré todo aquello que sea favorable para el bhakti en este mundo por medio de mis sentidos físicos. 

Escucharé sinceramente las narraciones acerca de Ti y contemplaré Tu dhāma hasta que mis ojos queden saciados. 

Alimentaré mi cuerpo con Tu prasāda y me deleitaré con la fragancia de la hoja de tulasī que adornó esas ofrendas. 

Te serviré constantemente con mis manos y residiré siempre en los lugares donde se encuentra Tu morada. 

Amoldaré mis deseos a Tu servicio y mostraré mi ira contra quienes tienen envidia de Ti. 

Así, que cada una de mis inclinaciones y sentimientos adquieran un sentido pleno al dedicarlos favorablemente en Tu servicio. 

Todo lo que haga que sea favorable para Tus bhaktas, yo lo acepto como favorable para el bhakti a Ti. 

Bhaktivinoda no sabe de religión o de irreligión; que todas sus actividades sean simplemente favorables para el bhakti.

IDX.first_line: gurudeva! dayāmaya! prāṇera jātanā jānāba ki tomā
IDX.search: gurudeva dayamaya pranera jatana janaba ki toma hayecḣe jivana jantrana maya sri krsne bhajite nahi chahe mati visaya bhogete prabala asakti visayera asa nahi cḣade mana visayete sada dhaya krsna dasya bhuli mayare bhajinu apana svarupa kabhu na chintinu virupe svarupa bhavi mudha mana mayate akrsta haya dusta sanga fala na bujhinu haya sadhu kacḣe jete chitta nahi chaya asatera sange thakiya satata chitta hala vajrapraya kanaka kamini labha puja asa chahe mora chitta ara pratisthasa kirupe sodhita habe mora chita ei chinta sada haya tava krpakana amara sambala tava krpa vina nahi anya bala krpa kara prabho diya chid bala dasa toma pranamaya sadhu sange thaki cḣaya vega dami sri krsna charana sevi jena ami hena mati jache tava dasadhama bandi tava ranga paya ohe gurudeva tava sri charana sevi jena ami janama janama ei asirvada jachi abhajana tava pade sthana chaya
IDX.author: bhakti kumuda santa gosvāmī mahārāja
IDX.verses:
gurudeva! dayāmaya! 
prāṇera jātanā jānāba ki tomā 
hayecḣe, jīvana jantraṇā-maya 

śhrī-kṛṣṇe bhajite nāhi chāhe mati, 
viṣaya-bhogete prabalā āsakti, 
viṣayera āśhā nāhi cḣāḍe mana- 
viṣayete sadā dhāya 

kṛṣṇa-dāsya bhuli’ māyāre bhajinu, 
āpana svarūpa kabhu nā chintinu, 
virūpe svarūpa bhāvi’ mūḍha mana 
māyāte ākṛṣṭa haya 

duṣṭa-saṅga-fala nā bujhinu hāya, 
sādhu kācḣe jete chitta nāhi chāya, 
asatera saṅge thākiyā satata- 
chitta ha’la vajraprāya 

kanaka-kāminī-lābha-pūjā-āśhā, 
chāhe mora chitta āra pratiṣṭhāśhā, 
kirūpe śhodhita ha’be mora chita- 
ei chintā sadā haya 

tava kṛpākaṇa āmāra sambala, 
tava kṛpā vinā nāhi anya bala, 
kṛpā kara prabho diyā chid-bala, 
dāsa tomā praṇamaya 

sādhu-saṅge thāki’ cḣaya vega dami’ 
śhrī-kṛṣṇa-charaṇa sevi jena āmi; 
hena mati jāche tava dāsādhama 
bandi tava rāṅgā pāya 

ohe gurudeva! tava śhrī-charaṇa, 
sevi jena āmi janama janama, 
ei āśhīrvāda jāchi’ abhājana- 
tava pade sthāna chāya
IDX.en_translation:
O spiritual master! O merciful one! How can I tell you the anguish of my heart? My life has become full of suffering. 

My mind does not wish to worship Śrī Kṛṣṇa; it has a strong attachment to worldly enjoyments. My mind does not give up the hope for material things but constantly runs after them. 

Forgetting my service to Kṛṣṇa, I have worshiped illusion and never contemplated my true spiritual identity. Thinking my false identity to be my real self, my foolish mind is attracted to illusion. 

Alas, I did not understand the result of bad association; my mind does not want to go near the saintly. Constantly remaining with bad company, my heart has become hardened like a thunderbolt. 

My mind desires wealth, women, gain, worship, and prestige. How will my heart ever be purified? This thought is always present. 

A drop of your mercy is my only asset; without it, I have no other strength. Please bestow your mercy, O Lord, by giving me spiritual strength; your servant offers obeisances to you. 

Remaining in the association of the saintly and controlling the six urges of the senses, may I serve the lotus feet of Śrī Kṛṣṇa. The lowest of your servants begs for such a disposition, offering homage at your reddish feet. 

O spiritual master! May I serve your holy lotus feet birth after birth. Begging for this blessing, this unworthy soul desires a place at your feet.

IDX.first_line: gurudeva! kabe mora sei dina habe
IDX.search: gurudeva kabe mora sei dina habe mana sthira kari nirjane basiya krsna nama gaba jabe samsara fukara kane na pasibe deha roga dure rabe hare krsna bali gahite gahite nayane bahibe lora dehete pulaka udita hoibe premete karibe bhora gada gada vani mukhe bahiribe kanpibe sarira mama gharma muhurmuhuh vivarna hoibe stambhita pralaya sama niskapate hena dasa kabe habe nirantara nama gaba avese rahiya dehayatra kari tomara karuna paba
IDX.author: sacchidānanda bhaktivinoda ṭhākura
IDX.verses:
gurudeva! 
kabe mora sei dina habe? 
mana sthira kari’, nirjane basiyā, 
kṛṣṇa-nāma gā’ba jabe 
saṁsāra-fukāra, kāṇe nā paśhibe, 
deha-roga dūre ra’be 

‘hare kṛṣṇa’ bali’, gāhite gāhite, 
nayane bahibe lora 
dehete pulaka, udita hoibe, 
premete karibe bhora 

gada-gada vāṇī, mukhe bāhiribe, 
kaṅpibe śharīra mama 
gharma muhurmuhuḥ, vivarṇa hoibe, 
stambhita pralaya sama 

niṣkapaṭe hena, daśhā kabe ha’be, 
nirantara nāma gā’ba 
āveśhe rahiyā, dehayātrā kari’, 
tomāra karuṇā pā’ba
IDX.translation_intro: From The Harmonist, October 1930. Edited by Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī.
IDX.en_translation:
Gurudeva ! When will that day be mine ! When composing my mind Seated in seclusion, The Name of Krishna T will sing. The tumult of the world Will not penetrate the ear And malady of body will keep afar. 

As I say “Hare-Krishna”, By chanting the song Tears will flow in my eyes; The horripilation of joy Will manifest on the body And overwhelm with love. 

Voice pressed at the throat Will issue from the mouth, My body will tremble; Sweating every moment Pallor will appear And death like stupor. 

Oh! When without guile, Such will be any state I will constantly sing the Name! Remaining pervaded within, Performing the functions of body, I will gain thy mercy;
IDX.es_translation:
¡Oh, Gurudeva! ¿Cuándo llegará el día en el que, sentado en un lugar solitario y con la mente sosegada, cantaré los nombres de Śhrī Kṛṣṇa? Entonces ningún tema mundano penetrará en mis oídos y las enfermedades del cuerpo se mantendrán alejadas. 

De mis ojos brotarán lágrimas y mi vello se erizará mientras canto “Hare Kṛṣṇa” rebosante de prema. 

Las palabras se ahogarán en mi garganta, mi cuerpo temblará, transpirará repetidamente y palidecerá, y quedaré atónito y aturdido. 

¿Cuándo alcanzaré ese estado en el que cantaré constantemente los santos nombres? Absorto en éxtasis y haciendo solo lo necesario para mantener el cuerpo, en ese momento recibiré tu misericordia.

IDX.search: gurudeva kabe tava karuna prakase sri gauranga lila haya nitya tattva ei sudrdha visvase hari hari bali godruma kanane bhramiba darsana ase nitai gauranga advaita srivasa gadadhara pancha jana krsna nama rase bhasabe jagat kari maha sankirtana nartana vilasa mrdanga vadana suniba apana kane dekhiya dekhiya se lila madhuri bhasiba premera bane na dekhi abara se lila ratana kandi ha gauranga bali amare visayi pagala baliya angete dibeka dhuli
IDX.author: sacchidānanda bhaktivinoda ṭhākura
IDX.verses:
gurudeva! kabe tava karuṇā prakāśhe 
śhrī-gaurāṅga-līlā, haya nitya-tattva, 
ei sudṛḍha viśhvāse 
‘hari hari’ bali’, godruma-kānane, 
bhramiba darśhana-āśhe 

nitāi, gaurāṅga, advaita, śhrīvāsa, 
gadādhara—pañcha-jana 
kṛṣṇa-nāma-rase, bhāsā’be jagat, 
kari’ mahā-saṅkīrtana 

nartana-vilāsa, mṛdaṅga-vādana, 
śhuniba āpana kāṇe 
dekhiyā dekhiyā, se-līlā-mādhurī, 
bhāsiba premera bāṇe 

nā dekhi ābāra, se-līlā-ratana, 
kāṅdi ‘hā gaurāṅga’ bali’ 
āmāre viṣayī, pāgala baliyā, 
aṅgete dibeka dhūli
IDX.translation_intro: From The Harmonist, October 1930. Edited by Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī.
IDX.en_translation:
Gurudeva! When by the manifestation of thy mercy, “The Pastimes of Sri Gauranga Are eternal varities In this firm conviction, Reciting the Name of Hari, “Mid the garden of Godruma, I will roam for their sight. 

Nitai, Gauranga, Advaita, Sribas, Gadadhar,--all five, By the liquid sweetness of the Name of Krishna,  Overflood the world, Singing the high chant in unison, 

The Pastime of dance, Playing on the Mridanga, I will hear with my own ears; By the constant vision Of the Beauty of that Leela, I will be borne on the flood-tide of love. 

And presently again missing the sight Of the treasure of that Pastime As I weep and cry aloud the Name of Gauranga, The worldlings Proclaiming me mad Will throw the dust at my body.
IDX.es_translation:
¡Oh, Gurudeva! ¿Cuándo, por la manifestación de tu misericordia y con la profunda convicción de que los līlās de Śhrī Gaurāṅga son la verdad eterna, cantaré el nombre de Hari y vagaré por el bosque de Godruma aspirando presenciar esos līlās? 

Nitāi, Gaurāṅga, Advaita, Śhrīvāsa, y Gadādhara —estas cinco personalidades inundarán el universo con el néctar del nombre de Krsna mediante el mahā-saṅkīrtana. 

Escucharé con mis propios oídos los pasatiempos de la danza y el tañer de las mṛdaṅgas y, contemplando sin cesar la dulzura de esos pasatiempos, flotaré en una corriente de prema. 

Cuando pierda la visión de esos sublimes e incomparables pasatiempos, gritaré: “¡Hā Gaurāṅga!”. Los materialistas dirán que esoy loco y lanzarán polvo sobre mi cuerpo.

IDX.first_line: gurudeva! kṛpā bindu diyā kara ei dāse
IDX.search: gurudeva krpa bindu diya kara ei dase trnapeksa ati hina sakala sahane bala diya kara nija mane sprha hina sakale sammana karite sakati deha natha yatha yatha tabe ta gaiba harinama sukhe aparadha habe hata kabe hena krpa labhiya e jana krtartha hoibe natha sakti buddhi hina ami ati dina kara more atma satha yogyata vichare kicḣu nahi pai tomara karuna sara karuna na haile kandiya kandiya prana na rakhiba ara
IDX.author: sacchidānanda bhaktivinoda ṭhākura
IDX.verses:
gurudeva! 
kṛpā-bindu diyā, kara ei dāse, 
tṛṇāpekṣā ati hīna 
sakala-sahane, bala diyā kara, 
nija-māne spṛhā-hīna 

sakale sammāna, karite śhakati, 
deha nātha! yathā-yatha 
tabe ta’ gāiba, harināma-sukhe, 
aparādha ha’be hata 

kabe hena kṛpā, labhiyā e jana, 
kṛtārtha hoibe nātha! 
śhakti-buddhi-hīna, āmi ati dīna, 
kara more ātma-sātha 

yogyatā-vichāre, kicḣu nāhi pāi, 
tomāra karuṇā sāra 
karuṇā nā haile, kāṅdiyā kāṅdiyā, 
prāṇa nā rākhiba āra
IDX.translation_intro: From The Harmonist, June 1930. Edited by Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī.
IDX.en_translation:
Gurudeva! By administering a particle of thy mercy, Make this servant of Thine Infinitely more humble than a blade of grass. Imparting strength To bear all trials Make me unsolicitous of my own honour. 

Give me, my Lord, The strength to honour all In the manner that is due. It is only then that with joy I will sing the Name of Hari, And all offence will end. 

When will this person, Gaining such mercy, Be blessed, indeed, O Lord? Destitute of strength and wit, I am very low; May thou make me thine. 

To judge of my fitness, I find T have none, Thy mercy is essential. If thou art not merciful, I will not cease weeping Till life itself is spent out.
IDX.es_translation:
¡Oh, Gurudeva! Dame una gota de misericordia y haz que este sirviente sea más humilde que una brizna de hierba. Concédeme la fuerza para ser tolerante en todas las eventualidades y libérame de mi vanidad. 

Otórgame el poder para honrar a todas las entidades vivientes según su merecimiento. Solo entonces seré capaz de cantar los santos nombres de Śhrī Hari lleno de dicha y mis ofensas serán destruidas. 

¿Cuándo será mi vida un éxito por la bendición de tu misericordia? No poseo fuerza ni inteligencia y soy sumamente caído e indigno. Sé bondadoso, toma mi alma y aduéñate de mí. 

Si me examino, no hallo en mí ninguna cualidad. Tu misericordia es la esencia de mi existencia. Si no eres misericordioso, llorando sin cesar, dejaré de mantener mi vida.

gurudeva, kṛpā karke mujhko apanā lenā 
maīṅ śharaṇa paḍā terī, charaṇo mē jagah denā 

karuṇā-nidhi nāma terā, karuṇā barasāo tum 
soye hue bhāgya ko, he nātha jagāo tum 
merī nāva bhavara ḍole, use pāra lagā denā 

tum sukha ke sāgara ho, bhakti ke sahāre ho 
mere mana mē samāye ho, mujhe prāṇoṁ se pyāre ho 
nita mālā japū terī, mere doṣa bhulā denā 

maīṅ santo kā sevaka hūṅ, guru charaṇo kā dāsa hūṅ 
nahīṁ nātha bhulānā mujhe, is jaga mē akelā hūṅ 
tere dvār kā bhikhārī hūṅ, nahīṁ dil se bhulā denā
IDX.en_translation:
Gurudeva, be merciful and accept me as your own. I have fallen at your shelter, give me a place at your feet. 

Your name is the Ocean of Mercy, shower mercy upon me. O Lord, awaken my sleeping fortune. My boat is tossing in the whirlpool, take it across. 

You are the ocean of happiness, you are the support of devotion. You are contained in my mind, you are dearer to me than life. I chant your beads constantly, make me forget my faults. 

I am a servant of the saints, I am a servant of the Guru’s feet. Do not forget me, O Lord, I am alone in this world. I am a beggar at your door, do not forget me from your heart.

IDX.verses: gurudeve, vraja-vane, vraja-bhūmi-vāsī jane, śhuddha-bhakte, āra vipra-gaṇe iṣṭa-mantre, hari-nāme, yugala-bhajana-kāme, kara rati apūrva jatane dhari, mana, charaṇe tomāra jāni-yācḣi ebe sāra, kṛṣṇa-bhakti vinā āra, nāhi ghuche jīvera saṁsāra karma jñāna tapaḥ yoga, sakaloi ta’ karma-bhoga, karma cḣāḍāite keha nāre sakala cḣāḍiyā bhāi, śhraddhā-devīra guṇa gāi, jāṅ’ra kṛpā bhakti dite pāre cḣāḍi’ dambha anukṣaṇa, smara aṣṭa-tattva, mana, kara tāhe niṣkapaṭa rati sei rati-prārthanāya, śhrī-dāsa gosvāmi-pāya, e bhaktivinoda kare nati
IDX.en_translation:
To Gurudeva, in forests of Vraja, to the residents of Vraja, to pure devotees, and to the brāhmaṇas, With your chosen mantra, holy names of Hari, and with the desire for devotional service to the Divine Couple, apply unprecedented care and affection. 

Holding, O mind, to your feet, I have now understood the essence: without Kṛṣṇa bhakti, the cycle of birth and death of the living entity cannot cease. 

Fruitive action, knowledge, austerity, yoga - all are indeed reactions of karma. No one can escape karma. Leaving all else, O brother, I sing the glories of the goddess of faith, by whose mercy devotion can be given. 

Constantly abandoning pride, O mind, remember the eight principles and render sincere affection unto them. With that prayer for affection, this Bhaktivinoda Ṭhākura offers obeisances at the feet of Śrī Raghunātha Dāsa Gosvāmī.

ratna-vedī kata śhata

IDX.en_translation:
Alas, alas! When will Gaura-Nitāi, the two brothers, showing great mercy, appear to this fallen person? 

By the strength of Their mercy, in Navadvīpa-dhāma, I will see the beauty of Vraja. I will behold the delightful, blissful, charming groves that captivate the eyes. 

Near there is Śrī Lalitā-kuṇḍa, and hundreds of jeweled altars, where Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa continuously enjoy, expanding Their pastimes. 

Where the sakhīs assist in the pastimes and receive the happiness of various services, this maidservant, by the command of the sakhīs, runs here and there for service. 

I will string a garland of mālatī flowers and bring it, then place it in the hands of the sakhī. The sakhī will place it around the necks of Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa, and I will dance with great joy.
IDX.es_translation:
¿Cuándo derramarán los hermanos Gaura-Nitāi Su abundante misericordia sobre esta persona sumamente caída manifestándose ante ella? 

Por el poder de Su misericordia, podré ver el esplendor trascendental de Vraja en Navadvīpa y contemplaré con avidez el encantador Ānanda-sukhada-kuñja. 

Cerca de Ānanda-sukhada-kuñja se encuentra Śhrī Lalitā-kuṇḍa rodeado por cientos y cientos de sitiales enjoyados donde Śhrī Śhrī Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa expanden el incensante festival de Sus pasatiempos. 

Todas Sus sakhīs están allí para asistir en los pasatiempos saboreando la dicha de realizar diferentes clases de sevā. Esta sirvienta, que también se encuentra allí, va de un lado a otro ejecutando los deberes encomendados por su sakhī. 

Ensartaré una guirnalda de flores mālatī y la pondré en manos de mi sakhī. Ella la colocará alrededor de los cuellos de Śhrī Śhrī Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa y yo danzaré llena de éxtasis.

IDX.en_translation:
Oh, my Gaura-kiśora! When, out of mercy, will You, the thief of my heart, appear in Śrī-godruma-vana? 

Inside the joyful and pleasant grove, with Gadādhara on Your left, with a golden complexion and curly hair, dressed beautifully for dancing. 

As I gaze, Śrī Rādhā-Mādhava will shine forth in a beautiful form, dancing with the sakhīs, a charming garland around Your neck. 

Anaṅga-Mañjarī, being merciful, will hold this maidservant’s hand and present the sweetness of both to me. I will behold them with my eyes completely filled.
IDX.es_translation:
¡Oh, mi joven Gaura! ¡Oh, ladrón de corazones! ¿Cuándo mostrarás Tu misericordia apareciendo ante mí en el bosque de Godruma? 

Te encuentras en Ānanda-sukhada-kuñja con Śhrī Gadādhara Paṇḍita a Tu izquierda. Tu tez posee un resplandor dorado, Tu cabello es rizado, y llevas puesto el elegante atuendo de un bailarín. 

Mientras Te contemplo, Śhrī Śhrī Rādhā-Mādhava aparecerán e iluminarán brillantemente la escena. Acompañados por Sus sakhīs, danzarán adornados con encantadoras guirnaldas alrededor de Sus cuellos. 

Llena de compasión, Anaṅga Mañjarī tomará la mano de esta sirvienta y me ofrecerá con mucho afecto a la Pareja Divina. Entonces contemplaré la dulzura de ambos hasta que mis ojos estén plenamente satisfechos.

Yo adoro los pies de loto de los seis Gosvāmīs, por cuya misericordia todos los obstáculos son destruidos y todos los deseos son colmados. 

Soy el sirviente de quienes pertenecen a los seis Gosvāmīs. El polvo de sus pies de loto es mi quíntuple soporte. 

Mi aspiración vida tras vida es residir en compañía de devotos y servir sus pies de loto. 

Cuando los seis Gosvāmīs vivían en Vraja, revelaron los pasatiempos eternos de Śhrī Śhrī Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa. 

Con la mente absorta en los pies de loto de śhrī guru y los vaiṣṇavas, canta lleno de dicha los nombres de Śhrī Hari y adora a Vṛndāvana. 

Con la aspiración de obtener los pies de loto de śhrī guru y los vaiṣṇavas, Narottama dāsa canta harināma-saṅkīrtana.

O Lord Hari, O Lord Kṛṣṇa, I offer my obeisances to You, who are known as Yādava, Hari, Mādhava, and Keśava.

All glories to Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī, Sanātana Gosvāmī, Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa dāsa Gosvāmī, Śrīla Jīva Gosvāmī, Gopāla Bhaṭṭa Gosvāmī, and Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī.

This is my desire, that birth after birth I may live with those devotees who serve the lotus feet of these Six Gosvāmīs. 

When these Six Gosvāmīs lived in Vraja they revealed and explained the eternal pastimes of Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa.

You are the fish, tortoise, boar, and man-lion incarnations. You are Vāmana, the Son of Bhṛgu, and the Enemy of the demon race. You are Balarāma, Buddha, Kalki, and Nārāyaṇa. O Lord Janārdana! O Enemy of Kaṁsa! 

O Keśava! O Mādhava! O Yādava! O Lord of the Yadus! O Destroyer of the demons! O Remover of sorrow! O Son of Śūra! O Moon of Goloka! O Moon of Gokula! O Bearer of the mace! O You whose flag bears Garuḍa! O Savior of the elephant! O Enemy of Mura! 

O Supreme Person! O Supreme Controller! O Master! O Supreme Brahman! O Supreme Being! O Enemy of the Agha demon! Have mercy on the distressed, O Son of Devakī! Please remove my evil thoughts and grant me supreme bliss.

IDX.translation_intro: Śrīla A.C. Bhaktivedānta Swami Prabhupāda, Mahā-mantra essay written in December 1966 in New York City
IDX.en_translation:
The sixteen words Hare Kṛṣṇa, Hare Kṛṣṇa, Kṛṣṇa Kṛṣṇa, Hare Hare Hare Rāma, Hare Rāma, Rāma Rāma, Hare Hare are especially meant for counteracting the contaminations of Kali. After searching through all the Vedas, you will not find a better means of self-realization for this age. This transcendental vibration by chanting of: Hare Kṛṣṇa Hare Kṛṣṇa Kṛṣṇa Kṛṣṇa Hare Hare Hare Rāma Hare Rāma Rāma Rāma Hare Hare, is the sublime method of reviving our Kṛṣṇa consciousness. As living spiritual souls we are all originally Kṛṣṇa conscious entities, but due to our association with matter from time immemorial, our consciousness is now polluted by the material atmosphere.
In this polluted concept of life, we are all trying to exploit the resources of material nature, but actually we are becoming more and more entangled in her complexities. This illusion is called māyā — or hard struggle for existence for winning over the stringent laws of material nature.
This illusory struggle against the material nature can at once be stopped by the revival of our Kṛṣṇa consciousness. Kṛṣṇa consciousness is not an artificial imposition on the mind. This consciousness is the original energy of the living entity. When we hear the transcendental vibration, this consciousness is revived, and the process is recommended by authorities for this age.
By practical experience, also, we can perceive that by chanting this maha-mantra, or “the great chanting for deliverance,” one can at once feel transcendental ecstasy from the spiritual stratum. When one is factually on the plane of spiritual understanding, surpassing the stages of sense, mind, and intelligence, one is situated on the transcendental plane.
This chanting of Hare Kṛṣṇa, Hare Kṛṣṇa, Kṛṣṇa Kṛṣṇa, Hare Hare, Hare Rāma, Hare Rāma, Rāma Rāma, Hare Hare is directly enacted from the spiritual platform, surpassing all lower stages of consciousness, namely sensual, mental, and intellectual. There is no need of understanding the language of the mantra, nor there is any need of mental speculation, nor an intellectual adjustment for chanting this Mahā-mantra. It springs automatically from the spiritual platform, and as such anyone can take part in this transcendental sound vibration without any previous qualification and feel the ecstasy. We have seen it practically —even a child can take part in the chanting, or even a dog can take part in it.
The chanting should be heard from the lips of a pure devotee of the Lord so that immediate effect can be achieved. As far as possible chanting from the lips of pure devotee should be avoided as much as milk touched by lips of a serpent causes poisonous effect.
The word Harā is a form of addressing the energy of the Lord. Kṛṣṇa and Rāma are forms of addressing directly the Lord, and They mean “the highest pleasure-eternal.” Harā is the supreme pleasure potency of the Lord. This potency, when addressed as Hare, helps us in reaching the supreme Lord.
The material energy, called as māyā, is also one of the multipotencies of the Lord as much as we are also marginal potency of the Lord. The living entities are described as superior energy than matter. When the superior energy is in contact with inferior energy, it becomes an incompatible situation. But when the supreme marginal potency is in contact with the spiritual potency, Harā, it becomes the happy, normal condition of the living entity.
The three words, namely Harā, Kṛṣṇa, and Rāma, are the transcendental seeds of the Mahā-mantra, and the chanting is the spiritual call for the Lord and His internal energy, Harā, for giving protection to the conditioned soul. The chanting is exactly like genuine crying by the child for mother. Mother Harā helps in achieving the grace of the supreme father Hari, or Kṛṣṇa and the Lord reveals Himself to such a sincere devotee. No other means therefore of spiritual relization is as effective in this age as chanting the Mahā-mantra: Hare Rāma, Hare Rāma, Rāma Rāma, Hare HareHare Kṛṣṇa Hare Kṛṣṇa Kṛṣṇa Kṛṣṇa Hare Hare Hare Rāma Hare Rāma Rāma Rāma Hare Hare.

Hare Kṛṣṇa Hare (Refrain) 

Oh, what a Name Nitāi has brought! Nitāi has brought the Name to the marketplace of the Name, And He is giving that Name for the price of faith. 

Hare Kṛṣṇa Hare Kṛṣṇa Kṛṣṇa Kṛṣṇa Hare Hare, Hare Rāma Hare Rāma Rāma Rāma Hare Hare 

Nitāi, seeing the fallen condition of the souls to be so wretched, Has brought the Name all the way from Vraja. 

This Name is chanted by Śiva with his five mouths. (This sweet Hari-nāma) 

This Name is chanted by Brahmā with his four mouths. (This sweet Hari-nāma) 

This Name is chanted by Nārada on his vīṇā. (This sweet Hari-nāma) 

By a mere reflection of this Name (nāmābhāsa), Ajāmila went to Vaikuṇṭha. 

Bhaktivinoda says: “Constantly chanting this holy name, let us go to Vraja!”

Chant “Hari! Hari! Hari!” O brother! Gaurāṅga and Nitāi have brought the Holy Name. 

Seeing our distress, they brought this Name, for without the Holy Name, the soul has no other wealth. Even the great sinners Jagāi and Mādhāi were purified by it. 

Falsely bound by illusion, we spend our lives; saying “I” and “mine” and driven by desire, where else shall we go? 

There is no end to desire! Therefore, chant “Hari!” and throw ashes on the face of desire. Freedom from desire is true happiness; giving up the quest for enjoyment and liberation, we sing the Holy Name. 

Becoming pure in being, we attain all fruits through the power of the Name without even asking. Giving up the effort for trivial results, Bhaktivinoda says: let us go, casting away the offenses to the Holy Name.

I will go to the city of the King of Vraja and become the ankle bells of the cowherd girls, sweetly jingling at their feet. 

I will behold the sweet beauty of the forms of Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa, filling my eyes, and I will remain at every entrance of the groves. 

In the forest are joyful pastimes with a gathering of cowherd boys; I will smear myself with the dust of their feet. 

O residents of Vraja, please fulfill my heart’s desire! When will I hear the flute of Śrī Kṛṣṇa again? 

At the time of death, I will place this body in the waters of the Yamunā and float away while chanting, “All glories to Rādhā and Govinda!”

Here comes Gaurāṅgacānda, disheveled in ecstatic love. With Nitāi and Advaita, He entered Godruma.

Todos los sufrimientos de los residentes de Godruma han desaparecido hoy, pues vino Śhrī Gaurāṅga con todos Sus devotos e hizo surgir el mercado del santo nombre. 

Caminando por la tierra de Nadiyā, Śhrī Gaurāṅga llegó al mercado del santo nombre. Śhrī Gaura llegó al mercado junto con Nitāi. 

Enloquecido de éxtasis, Nitāi danza en los campos de Godruma. Debido al prema, Nitāi mueve Sus poderosos brazos como un desafiante luchador, haciendo que el universo entero quede sobrecogido de éxtasis. 

¡Vengan todos y vean! Los vaiṣṇavas, encabezados por Advaita Āchārya, están danzando a orillas del Gaṅgā y yendo de un ghāta a otro. Al presenciar la escena, la malvada personalidad de Kali se llena de angustia y corre a ponerse a salvo. 

¡Qué indescriptible felicidad embargaba a todas las jīvas cuando Śhrī Gaura-chandra danzaba! Al ver y escuchar estos pasatiempos, los corazones de los ateos se quebrantan.

I will chant the names of Hari and behold Madana-mohana. In such as state, I shall travel the path to Vraja. 

I will go to the land of Vraja, become the anklet with small bells on the feet of the gopīs and will there chime sweetly. 

I will gaze upon the sweet beauty of Śrī Śrī Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa to the full satisfaction of my eyes, and I will stand at the entrance of Their pastime groves. 

Charming pastimes will take place in the forests of Vraja, in the playful assembly of the cowherd boys. I will smear the dust of their lotus feet on my body. 

O residents of Vraja, please fulfill my heart’s desire! Oh, when will I hear the sound of Kṛṣṇa’s flute? 

When the time comes for this body’s demise, I will place it in the waters of the Yamunā, and as it floats, I will chant, “All glories to Rādhā-Govinda!” 

Narottama dāsa laments: “My desires are not been fulfilled. Oh, when will I attain reside in Vraja?”
IDX.es_translation:
Cantaré los nombres de Hari y contemplaré a Madana-mohana, y en esa condición transitaré el camino que conduce a Vraja. 

Iré a la tierra de Vraja y me convertiré en el nūpura (tobillera con campanillas) de las gopīs, y entonces repicaré dulcemente [a sus pies de loto]. Contemplaré la dulce belleza de Śhrī Śhrī Rādhā y Kṛṣṇa a plena satisfacción de mis ojos, y permaneceré a la entrada de Sus nikuñjas (arboledas de pasatiempos). 

En los bosques de Vraja, en la gozosa asamblea de los pastorcillos, transcurrirán encantadores pasatiempos. Cubriré mi cuerpo con el polvo de sus pies de loto. ¡Oh, residentes de Vraja, colmen por favor el deseo de mi corazon! ¿Cuándo escucharé el sonido de la flauta de Kṛṣṇa? 

Cuando llegue el momento de abandonar este cuerpo, lo colocaré en las aguas del Yamunā y, mientras flota, cantaré: “Toda gloria a Rādhā-Govinda”. Narottama dāsa se lamenta: “Mis deseos no están siendo satisfechos. ¿Cuándo residiré en Vraja?”

O Hari! O Rāma! O Nārāyaṇa, please deliver this fallen soul. 

I do not seek wealth, followers, fame, nor even the blessing of liberation. By Your grace, O Lord, please make me Your own. 

You are the Master of the universe, and everything belongs to You. You alone are the Giver, O Lord; who else can truly give? 

Thinking “mine,” I am full of false ego. If You make me Your servant, that ego will come to an end. 

Due to the faults of my past actions, wherever I may reside—whether in heaven or in hell—please grant me this grace: that I may never forget You.

Grant me the company of Your devotees at all times, so that I may always hear Your Holy Names and glories with my ears.

Salutations to Hari, Kṛṣṇa, and the descendant of Yadu! Salutations to Mādhava and Keśava! 

Gopāla, Govinda, Rāma, and Śrī Madhusūdana! The lifter of Govardhana Hill, the Lord of the gopīs, and the one who enchants Cupid! 

Śrī Caitanya, Nityānanda, Śrī Advaita the protector (and His consort, Śrī Sītā Ṭhākurāṇī)! Hari, the spiritual master, the devotee, the scripture, and the Gītā! 

Śrī Rūpa, Śrī Sanātana, Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa, Śrī Jīva, Gopāla Bhaṭṭa, and Raghunātha dāsa. 

I offer my obeisances to the lotus feet of these six spiritual masters, by which the destruction of obstacles and the fulfillment of desires occur. 

Whoever follows these six masters—I am their servant. The dust of their lotus feet is my very sustenance. 

To serve their feet and reside with the devotees—this is my desire, birth after birth. 

When these six masters resided in Vraja, they revealed the eternal pastimes of Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa. 

Joyfully chant the name of Hari and worship Vṛndāvana, immersing your mind in the lotus feet of the spiritual master and the devotees. 

Taking hope in the lotus feet of the spiritual master and the devotees, Narottama dāsa sings this congregational chanting.
IDX.es_translation:
Yo Te ofrezco praṇāma,¡Oh, Hari! ¡Oh, Kṛṣṇa! ¡Oh, Yādava! ¡Oh, Mādhava! ¡Oh, Keśhava! 

¡Oh, Gopāla, Govinda, Rāma, Śhrī Madhusūdana! ¡Oh, Giridhārī, Gopīnātha, Madana-mohana! 

[Yo ofrezco praṇāma a] Śhrī Chaitanya, Nityānanda, y Śhrī Advaita —nuestros sustentadores— junto con Hari, guru, los vaiṣṇavas, el Bhāgavata Purāṇa y el Bhagavad-gītā. 

[Yo ofrezco praṇāma a] Los Gosvāmīs Śhrī Rūpa, Śhrī Sanātana, Śhrī Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa, Śhrī Jīva, Śhrī Gopāla Bhaṭṭa y Śhrī Raghunātha dāsa. 

Yo adoro los pies de loto de los seis Gosvāmīs, por cuya misericordia todos los obstáculos son destruidos y todos los deseos son colmados. 

Soy el sirviente de quienes pertenecen a los seis Gosvāmīs. El polvo de sus pies de loto es mi quíntuple soporte. 

Mi aspiración vida tras vida es residir en compañía de devotos y servir sus pies de loto. 

Cuando los seis Gosvāmīs vivían en Vraja, revelaron los pasatiempos eternos de Śhrī Śhrī Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa. 

Con la mente absorta en los pies de loto de śhrī guru y los vaiṣṇavas, canta lleno de dicha los nombres de Śhrī Hari y adora a Vṛndāvana. 

Con la aspiración de obtener los pies de loto de śhrī guru y los vaiṣṇavas, Narottama dāsa canta harināma-saṅkīrtana.

When will I fill my belly drinking the water of the Yamunā, which is like nectar? When, bathing with curiosity in the waters of Rādhā-kuṇḍa, will I lie down at Śyāma-kuṇḍa? 

I will wander in the twelve forests, in all the places of playful pastimes, rolling on the ground in the ecstasy of love. I will ask each and every person at the places of the residents of Vraja, and I will submit my petition holding their feet.

IDX.verses: hari hari kabe mora habe hena dina vimala vaiṣṇave, rati upajibe, vāsanā hoibe kṣīṇa antara-bāhire, sama vyavahāra, amānī mānada ha’ba kṛṣṇa-saṅkīrtane, śhrī-kṛṣṇa-smaraṇe, satata majiyā ra’ba e dehera kriyā, abhyāse kariba, jīvana jāpana lāgi’ śhrī-kṛṣṇa-bhajane, anukūla jāhā, tāhe ha’ba anurāgī bhajanera jāhā, pratikūla tāhā, dṛḍhabhāve teyāgiba bhajite bhajite, samaya āsile, e deha cḣāḍiyā diba bhakativinoda, ei āśhā kari’, basiyā godruma-vane prabhu-kṛpā lāgi’, vyākula antare, sadā kāṅde saṅgopane
IDX.en_translation:
Hari Hari, when will that day be mine? When affection for pure Vaiṣṇavas will arise, And desires will become weak. 

Inside and outside, my behavior will be consistent, I will become one who desires no respect for myself but offers all respect to others. In congregational chanting of Kṛṣṇa’s names, and in remembering Śrī Kṛṣṇa, I will always remain immersed. 

The activities of this body, I will perform out of habit, For the sake of maintaining life. That which is favorable to devotional service to Śrī Kṛṣṇa, To that I will become attached. 

That which is unfavorable to devotional service, That I will firmly give up. While performing devotional service, when the time comes, I will give up this body. 

Bhaktivinoda, cherishing this hope, Sitting in Godruma-vana, For the Lord’s grace, with an anxious heart, He always weeps secretly.
IDX.es_translation:
¡Oh, Hari! ¿Cuándo llegará el día en que desarrollaré el apego por los vaiṣṇavas de corazón puro mediante el cual mis deseos materiales serán subyugados? 

Entonces no habrá ya disparidad entre mi conducta interna y externa, no desearé recibir honores sino que ofreceré respeto a los demás, y estaré siempre absorto recordando a Kṛṣṇa y cantando Sus nombres. 

Realizaré mis actividades corporales como un hábito, tan solo para mantener la vida, y me apegaré exclusivamente a lo que es favorable para el bhajana de Śhrī Kṛṣṇa. 

Rechazaré rotundamente lo que es desfavorable para el bhajana. Y siempre absorto en bhajana, cuando llegue el momento de abandonar este cuerpo lo haré sin reparos. 

Bhaktivinoda reside en el bosque de Godruma con estas aspiraciones. Él siempre llora en un lugar solitario ansiando recibir la misericordia del Señor.

IDX.first_line: hari hari! kabe mora hoibe sudina
IDX.search: hari hari kabe mora hoibe sudina govardhana girivare parama nibhrte ghare rai kanu karaiba sayana bhrngarera jale ranga charana dhoyaiba mucḣaba apana chikure kanaka samputa kari karpura tambula puri jogaiba duhuka adhare priya sakhi gana sange sevana kariba range charana seviba nija kare duhuka kamala dithi kautuke heraba duhu anga pulaka antare mallika malati juthi nana fule mala ganthi kabe diba dohara galaya sonara katora kari karpura chandana bhari kabe diba dohakara gaya ara kabe emana habe duhu mukha nirakhiba lilarasa nikunja sayane sri kundalatara sange keli kautuka range narottama karibe sravane
IDX.author: narottama-dāsa ṭhākura
IDX.verses: hari hari! kabe mora hoibe sudina govardhana girivare, parama nibhṛte ghare, rāi kānu karāiba śhayana bhṛṅgārera jale rāṅgā-, charaṇa dhoyāiba, mucḣaba āpana chikure kanaka-sampuṭa kari’, ‘karpūra tāmbūla pūri’ jogāiba dūhuka adhare priya-sakhī-gaṇa-saṅge, sevana kariba raṅge, charaṇa seviba nija kare dūhuka kamala-diṭhi, kautuke heraba, dūhu aṅga pulaka antare mallikā mālatī jūthi, nānā fule mālā gāṅthi, kabe diba dohāra galāya soṇāra kaṭorā kari, kārpūra chandana bhari’, kabe diba dohākāra gāya āra kabe emana habe, dūhu-mukha-nirakhiba, līlārasa nikuñja-śhayane śhrī-kundalatāra saṅge, keli-kautuka raṅge, narottama karibe śhravaṇe
IDX.en_translation:
O Lord Hari! When will my auspicious day come? On Govardhana Hill, in a most secluded place, I will make Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa lie down to rest. 

With water from a jeweled pitcher I will wash Their reddish lotus feet and wipe them with my own hair. Taking a golden casket and filling it with camphor and betel, I will offer it to Their lips. 

With my dear companions I will serve Them joyfully, serving Their lotus feet with my own hands. I will behold Their lotus-like glances with delight, and Their forms will cause ecstasy within my heart. 

When will I string garlands of jasmine and various other flowers and place them around Their necks? Taking a golden cup and filling it with camphor and sandalwood paste, when will I anoint Their bodies? 

And when will it happen that I will gaze upon Their faces, reveling in the nectar of Their pastimes as They recline in the secluded grove? With Śrī Kundalatā, in the joy of playful sport, Narottama will listen.
IDX.es_translation:
¡Oh, Hari! ¿Cuándo llegará ese auspicioso día en que serviré a Śhrī Śhrī Rādhā-Kṛsṇa desbordante de prema? 

Acompañado de instrumentos musicales, cantaré dulces melodías. Lleno de éxtasis, entonaré cantos en alabanza de la forma y las cualidades de la Pareja Divina. 

Cuando cante “Rādhikā-Govinda” lloraré intensamente y mi cuerpo entero quedará empapado con las lágrimas que brotarán de mis ojos. 

¡Oh, Rūpa Gosvāmī y Sanātana Gosvāmī! ¡Oh, Śhrī Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī! ¡Oh Śhrī Jīva Gosvāmī, mi vida y mi alma! ¡Denme su misericordia ahora! 

¡Oh, Lalitā y Viśhākhā! ¡Oh Śhrīdāma, Subala y demás amigos con sakhya-bhāva! ¡Denme su misericordia ahora! 

Todos ustedes juntos, sean por favor misericordiosos y permitan que mis deseos se cumplan. Narottama dāsa ora así constantemente.

IDX.first_line: hari hari! kabe mora hoibe sudine
IDX.search: hari hari kabe mora hoibe sudine kelikautuka range kariba sevane lalita visakha sane jateka sangira gane mandali kariba doha meli rai kanu kare dhari nrtya kare firi firi nirakhi gonaba kutuhali alasa visrama ghare govardhana girivare raikanu karibe sayana narottama dasa kaya ei jena mora haya anuksana charana sevana
IDX.author: narottama-dāsa ṭhākura
IDX.verses: hari hari! kabe mora hoibe sudine kelikautuka raṅge kariba sevane lalitā-viśhākhā sane, jateka saṅgīra gaṇe, maṇḍalī kariba doha meli’ rāi kānu-kare dhari’, nṛtya kare firi’ firi’, nirakhi’ goṅā’ba kutūhalī alasa-viśhrāma-ghare, govardhana-girivare, rāikānu karibe śhayana narottama-dāsa kaya, ei jena mora haya, anukṣaṇa charaṇa sevana
IDX.en_translation:
Hari Hari! When will I have that auspicious day when I will perform service in the playful pastimes? 

With Lalitā and Viśākhā, and all the group of companions, I will make a circle, bringing the Two together. Holding the hands of Rāi and Kānu, They will dance round and round; I will pass the time watching with curiosity. 

In the house of leisurely rest, on the best of hills, Govardhana, Rāi and Kānu will lie down. Narottama Dāsa says: May this be mine—service to the feet at every moment.

IDX.first_line: hari hari! kata dine hena daśhā haba
IDX.search: hari hari kata dine hena dasa haba sri rasa manjari sange sri mani manjari range sri rupera anuga haiba susitala vrndavana ratnavedi susobhana tahe manimaya simhasana hema nila kantidhara rai kanu sundara tahe basaiba duijana sakhira adesa habe chamara dhulaba kabe tambula jogaba chanda mukhe anandita haba sada suddha bhave prema katha duhara piriti rasa sukhe mallika malati juthi nana fule mala ganthi paraiba duhara galaye rasera alasa kale basiya charana tale sevana kariba duhara paye radha krsna pranapati jivane marane gati iha vine ara nahi mane sri krsna chaitanya prana svarupa rupa sanatana narottama ei nivedana
IDX.author: narottama-dāsa ṭhākura
IDX.verses: hari hari! kata dine hena daśhā haba śhrī-rāsa-mañjarī saṅge śhrī-maṇi-mañjarī rāṅge śhrī-rūpera anugā haiba suśhītala vṛndāvana ratnavedī suśhobhana tāhe maṇimaya siṁhāsana hema nīla-kāntidhara rāi-kānu sundara tāhe basāiba duijana sakhīra ādeśha habe chāmara ḍhulāba kabe tāmbula jogāba chāṅda-mukhe ānandita ha’ba sadā śhuddha-bhāve prema-kathā duhāra pīriti rasa-sukhe mallikā mālatī jūthī nānā fule mālā gāṅthi parāiba duhāra galāye rasera ālasa kāle basiyā charaṇa tale sevana kariba duhāra pāye rādhā-kṛṣṇa prāṇapati jīvane maraṇe gati ihā vine āra nāhi mane śhrī-kṛṣṇa-chaitanya-prāṇa svarūpa-rūpa-sanātana narottama ei nivedana
IDX.en_translation:
O Lord Hari! When will I achieve such a state? In the company of Śrī Rāsa-mañjarī and Śrī Maṇi-mañjarī, I will become a follower of Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī. 

In the very cool and beautiful Vṛndāvana, on a beautiful, jewel-studded altar, I will see a jewel-studded throne. Upon that throne, I will seat the beautiful Divine Couple, who have golden and dark-blue complexions. 

When will I receive the order of the gopī friends to fan Them with a whisk? When will I offer betel nuts to Their moon-like faces? I will always be joyful, purely devoted to topics of divine love and the happiness of Their mutual affection. 

Stringing garlands of various jasmine flowers, I will place them around Their necks. When They are resting, I will sit at Their lotus feet and render service to both of Them. 

Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa are the Lords of my life, my only shelter in life and in death. Without Them, nothing else remains in my mind. Svarūpa Dāmodara, Rūpa Gosvāmī, and Sanātana Gosvāmī are the very life of Lord Caitanya. This is the humble prayer of Narottama Dāsa.

IDX.first_line: hari hari! ki mora karama abhāga
IDX.search: hari hari ki mora karama abhaga vifale jivana gela hrdaye rahila sela nahi bhela hari anuraga jajna dana tirtha snana punya karma japa dhyana akarane saba gela mohe bujhilama mane hena upahasa haya jena vastrahina alankara dehe sadhu mukhe kathamrta suniya vimala chita nahi bhela aparadha karana satata asatsanga sakali hoila bhanga ki kariba aile samana sruti smrti sada rabe suniyacḣi ei sabe haripada abhaya sarana janama loiya sukhe krsna na balinu mukhe na karinu se rupa bhavana radha krsna duhu paya tanu mana rahu taya ara dure jauka vasana narottama dase kaya ara mora nahi bhaya tanu mana sampinu apana
IDX.author: narottama-dāsa ṭhākura
IDX.verses: hari hari! ki mora karama abhāga vifale jīvana gela, hṛdaye rahila śhela, nāhi bhela hari-anurāga jajña, dāna, tīrtha-snāna, puṇya-karma, japa, dhyāna, akāraṇe saba gela mohe bujhilāma mane hena, upahāsa haya jena, vastrahīna alaṅkāra dehe sādhu-mukhe kathāmṛta, śhuniyā vimala chita, nāhi bhela aparādha-kāraṇa satata asatsaṅga, sakali hoila bhaṅga, ki kariba āile śhamana śhruti-smṛti sadā rabe, śhuniyācḣi ei sabe, haripada abhaya śharaṇa janama loiyā sukhe, kṛṣṇa nā balinu mukhe, nā karinu se-rūpa bhāvana rādhā-kṛṣṇa dūhu pāya, tanu mana rahu tāya, āra dūre jāuka vāsanā narottama dāse kaya, āra mora nāhi bhaya, tanu-mana saṁpinu āpanā
IDX.en_translation:
O Lord Hari! What unfortunate destiny is mine! My life passed in vain, and a spear remained in my heart, for I did not attain affection for You. 

Sacrifice, charity, bathing in holy places, pious activities, chanting, and meditation—all were lost fruitlessly due to illusion. I realize now that it was like a mockery, like wearing decorations on a body without clothes. 

From the mouths of the saints I heard the nectar of Your words, yet with my impure heart, I did not avoid committing offenses. Constant association with the impious broke everything; what will I do when the messenger of death arrives? 

The scriptures will always declare that Your feet are a fearless shelter—I have heard all of this. Though born in comfort, I did not utter Kṛṣṇa’s name, nor did I meditate on His form. 

May my body and mind remain at the feet of Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa, and may all other desires depart far away. Narottama dāsa says: I have no more fear, for I have surrendered my body and mind completely.

IDX.first_line: hari hari! kṛpā kari’ rākha nija pade
IDX.search: hari hari krpa kari rakha nija pade kama krodha cḣaya jane lana fire nanasthane visaya bhunjaya nanamate hoiya mayara dasa kari nana abhilasa tomara smarana gela dure artha labha ei ase kapata vaisnava vese bhramiya bulaye ghare ghare aneka duhkhera pare layecḣile vrajapure krpadora galaya bandhiya daivamaya balatkare khasaiya sei dore bhava kupe dileka dariya punah jadi krpa kari e janara kese dhari taniya tulaha vraja dhame tabe se dekhiye bhala natuba parana gela kahe dina dasa narottame
IDX.author: narottama-dāsa ṭhākura
IDX.verses: hari hari! kṛpā kari’ rākha nija pade kāma-krodha cḣaya jane, lañā fire nānāsthāne, viṣaya-bhuñjāya nānāmate hoiyā māyāra dāsa, kari’ nānā abhilāṣa, tomāra smaraṇa gela dūre artha-lābha ei āśhe, kapaṭa vaiṣṇava-veśhe, bhramiyā bulaye ghare ghare aneka duḥkhera pare, layecḣile vrajapure, kṛpāḍora galāya bāndhiyā daivamāyā balātkāre, khasāiyā sei ḍore, bhava-kūpe dileka ḍāriyā punaḥ jadi kṛpā kari’, e janāra keśhe dhari’, ṭāniyā tulaha vraja-dhāme tabe se dekhiye bhāla, natubā parāṇa gela, kahe dīna dāsa narottame
IDX.en_translation:
O Lord Hari! Please bestow Your mercy and keep me at Your feet. Lust, anger, and the other four enemies take me and drag me to various places, making me enjoy material things in various ways. 

Becoming a servant of illusion and following various desires, Your remembrance went far away. In the hope of gaining wealth and wearing the guise of a deceitful devotee, I wander from house to house. 

After much suffering, You had taken me to the town of Vraja, tying a rope of mercy around my neck. But the divine energy of illusion forcefully untied that rope and threw me back into the well of material existence. 

Again, if You bestow mercy, catching me by the hair and pulling me up to Vrajadhāma—then it will be good. Otherwise, my life is lost. So says the humble servant Narottama.
IDX.es_translation:
¡Oh, Śhrī Hari! (¡Oh, Śhrī Govinda! ¡Oh, Śhrī Gopīnātha!) Ten misericordia de mí y mantenme siempre a Tus pies de loto. Seis adversarios encabezados por la lujuria y la ira tiran de mí hacia diferentes lugares y me obligan a satisfacer mis deseos de distintas maneras. 

Me he vuelto un sirviente de Māyā y tengo multitud de deseos materiales, y por ese motivo mi remembranza de Ti se ha ido muy lejos. Disfrazado de vaiṣṇava, voy de una casa a otra con el deseo de colectar dinero. 

Tras padecer un sinfín de miserias, ataste Tu soga de misericordia alrededor de mi cuello y me trajiste a Vraja, pero luego māyā desató esa soga por la fuerza y me lanzó al pozo de la existencia material. 

Si agarras misericordiosamente a esta persona del cabello y la sitúas de nuevo en Vraja, se salvará; de otro modo será el fin de su existencia. Así ora el caído e indigno Narottama dāsa.

IDX.search: hari hari vifale janama gonainu manusya janama paiya radha krsna na bhajiya janiya suniya visa khainu golokera prema dhana harinama sankirtana rati na janmila kene tayasamsara visanale divanisi hiya jvale judaite na kainu upaya vrajendra nandana jei sachi suta haila sei balarama hoila nitaidina hina jata cḣila hari name uddharila tara saksi jagai madhai ha ha prabhu nandasuta vrsabhanu sutayuta karuna karaha eibara narottama dasa kaya na thelio rangapaya toma vina ke acḣe amara
IDX.author: narottama-dāsa ṭhākura
IDX.verses: hari hari! vifale janama goṅāinu manuṣya-janama pāiyā, rādhā-kṛṣṇa nā bhajiyā, jāniyā śhuniyā viṣa khāinu golokera prema-dhana, harināma-saṅkīrtana, rati nā janmila kene tāyasaṁsāra-viṣānale, divāniśhi hiyā jvale, juḍāite nā kainu upāya vrajendra-nandana jei, śhachī-suta haila sei, balarāma hoila nitāidīna hīna jata cḣila, hari-nāme uddhārila, tā’ra sākṣī jagāi-mādhāi hā hā prabhu nandasuta, vṛṣabhānu-sutāyuta, karuṇā karaha eibāra narottama-dāsa kaya, nā ṭhelio rāṅgāpāya, tomā vinā ke ācḣe āmāra
IDX.en_translation:
Hari Hari! I spent my life in vain. Having obtained a human birth, not worshipping Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa, I knowingly drank poison. 

The treasure of Goloka’s love, the saṅkīrtana of Hari’s Name—why did I not develop attachment for it? My heart burns day and night in the poisonous fire of worldly existence; I did not make a way to cool it. 

He who is Vrajendra-nandana became Śacī-suta; Balarāma became Nitāi. He delivered all the lowly and destitute by the Holy Name; Jagāi and Mādhāi are the witnesses to that. 

Alas, alas! O Lord, Son of Nanda, along with the daughter of Vṛṣabhānu, be merciful this time. Narottama Dāsa says: Do not push me away from Your reddish feet; who do I have except You?

IDX.first_line: hari he! 1 prapañche paḍiyā agati hoiyā
IDX.search: hari he 1 prapanche padiya agati hoiya na dekhi upaya ara agatira gati charane sarana tomaya karinu sara karama geyana kicḣu nahi mora sadhana bhajana nai tumi krpamaya ami ta kangala ahaituki krpa chai vakya mano vega krodha jihva vega udara upastha vega miliya e saba samsare bhasaye ditecḣe paramodvega aneka jatane se saba damane cḣadiyacḣi asa ami anathera natha daki tava nama ekhana bharasa tumi
IDX.author: sacchidānanda bhaktivinoda ṭhākura
IDX.verses:
hari he! (1) 
prapañche paḍiyā, agati hoiyā, 
nā dekhi’ upāya āra 
agatira gati, charaṇe śharaṇa, 
tomāya karinu sāra 

karama geyāna, kicḣu nāhi mora, 
sādhana-bhajana nāi 
tumi kṛpāmaya, āmi ta’ kāṅgāla, 
ahaitukī kṛpā chāi 

vākya-mano-vega, krodha-jihvā-vega, 
udara-upastha-vega 
miliyā e-saba, saṁsāre bhāsāye, 
ditecḣe paramodvega 

aneka jatane, se-saba damane, 
cḣāḍiyācḣi āśhā āmi 
anāthera nātha, ḍāki tava nāma, 
ekhana bharasā tumi
IDX.translation_intro: From The Harmonist, March 1929. Edited by Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī.
IDX.en_translation:
Hari! Fallen into this world, Rendered helpless, I find no other way of deliverance, Guide of the guideless! The Refuge of Thy feet I seek as essential. 

Capacity for work or Knowledge I have none; I neither serve Thee nor try. Thou art full of mercy, I am destitute, indeed; Thy causeless mercy I crave. 

The activities of speach and mind, Anger, palate, The stomach and organ of generation,- All these joining together, Casting me adrift on the stream of the world, Are giving me great trouble. 

The hope of subduing them, By using every care, I have given up. Lord of the lordless! I call upon Thy Name. Thou art now the Hope.
IDX.es_translation:
¡Oh Hari! Tras haber caído en el mundo material de cinco elementos y sentirme ofuscado, no veo más consuelo que el refugio de Tus pies, pues Tú eres el refugio de los desamparados. Ahora Tú lo eres todo para mí. 

No poseo ni buenas obras ni sabiduría, y tampoco puedo hacer sādhana-bhajana. Tú eres benévolo y yo caído; por tanto, solicito Tu misericordia sin causa. 

Los impulsos del habla, la mente, la ira, la lengua, el estómago y los genitales se han congregado, me han dejado a la deriva en el océano de la vida mundana y me están causando una terrible ansiedad. 

Tras intentar diligentemente dominar esos impulsos, finalmente he abandonado toda esperanza. ¡Oh, Señor de los desamparados! Ahora invoco Tu nombre, pues Tú eres mi única esperanza.
