IDX.verses: jaya jaya nityānanda rohiṇī-kumāra patita uddhāra lāgi’ du’bāhu pasāra gada gada madhura madhura ādho bola jā’re dekhe tā’re preme dhari’ deya kola ḍagamaga lochana ghuraye nirantara sonāra kamale jena firaye bhramara dayāra ṭhākura nitāi para-duḥkha jāne hari-nāmera mālā gāṅthi’ dila jagajane pāpī-pāṣaṇḍī jata karila dalana dīna-hīna-jane kailā prema vitaraṇa ‘āhā re gaurāṅga’-bali’ paḍe bhūmitale śharīra bhijila nitāira nayanera jale vṛndāvana-dāsa mane ei vichārila dharaṇī upare kibā sumeru paḍila
IDX.en_translation:
Glory, glory to Nityānanda, the Son of Rohiṇī! He spreads His two arms to deliver the fallen. 

Choked up, sweet, sweet broken words; whomever He sees, He holds him with love and embraces him. 

His overwhelmed eyes roll constantly; as if a bee wanders in a golden lotus. 

The merciful Lord Nitāi knows the pain of others; He strung a garland of the Holy Name and gave it to the people of the world. 

He crushed all the sinners and atheists; He distributed love to the lowly and destitute people. 

Saying “Alas! O Gaurāṅga!”, He falls to the ground; Nitāi’s body became wet with the water of His eyes. 

Vṛndāvana Dāsa considered this in his mind: Has Sumeru fallen upon the earth?
IDX.es_translation:
¡Toda gloria a Śhrī Nityānanda Prabhu, el hijo de Rohiṇī! Él extiende Sus dos brazos para liberar a las almas caídas. 

Con la voz entrecortada, Él balbucea dulcemente y abraza amorosamente a todo el que ve. 

Desbordante de prema, Sus ojos se mueven inquietos como abejorros revoloteando sobre un loto dorado. 

Consciente del sufrimiento de los demás, Śhrī Nitāi, el misericordioso Señor, ha ensartado la guirnalda de los santos nombres y se la ha entregado a las gentes de este mundo. 

Ha subyugado a los pecadores y a los ateos, pero ha otorgado prema a los pobres y a los humildes. 

Exclamando en voz alta:, “¡Oh, Gaurāṅga!”, Él cae al suelo y Su cuerpo entero queda empapado con las lágrimas que brotan de Sus ojos. 

En su corazón, Vṛndāvana dāsa considera que Śhrī Nityānanda Prabhu es como el monte Sumeru cayendo sobre la tierra.

IDX.en_translation:
All glories, all glories to Nityānanda, Advaita, and Gaurāṅga! Glory to Nitāi-Gaurāṅga! Glory to Nitāi-Gaurāṅga! 

Glory to the Son of Yaśodā, the Son of Śacī, Gaura-candra! Glory to the Son of Rohiṇī, Balarāma, Nityānanda! 

Glory to the Avatar of Mahāviṣṇu, Śrī Advaitacandra! Glory to Gadādhara, Śrīvāsa, and the group of Gaura’s devotees! 

Glory to Svarūpa, Rūpa, Sanātana, Rāya Rāmānanda! Glory to the residents of Khaṇḍa—Narahari, Murāri, Mukunda! 

Glory to Rāya Bhavānanda, who dances with five sons! Glory to Sena Śivānanda, who dances with three sons! 

Glory to the twelve Gopālas and the sixty-four Mahantas! All of you, mercifully give the lotus feet of Gaura.
IDX.es_translation:
¡Toda gloria a Nityānanda Prabhu, Advaita Āchārya y Gaurāṇga Mahāprabhu! A Nitāi y Gaurāṅga, toda gloria. ― ¡Toda gloria a Nitāi y Gaurāṅga! 

Toda gloria al hijo de Śhachī, Gaura-chandra, que no es diferente del hijo de Yaśhodā. Toda gloria a Nityānanda Prabhu, que no es diferente de Balarāma, el hijo de Rohiṇī. 

Toda gloria a Advaita-chandra, la encarnación de Mahā-Viṣṇu. Toda gloria a Gadādhara Paṇḍita, Śhrīvāsa Ṭhākura y la multitud de devotos de Gaura-chandra. 

Toda gloria a Svarūpa Dāmodara, Rūpa Gosvāmī, Sanātana Gosvāmī y Rāmānanda Rāya. Toda gloria a los residentes de (Śhrī) Khaṇḍa ― Narahari Sarakāra, Murāri Gupta, y Mukunda Datta. 

Toda gloria a Bhavānanda Rāya, que danza en éxtasis junto con sus cinco hijos. Toda gloria a Śhivānanda Sena, que también danza acompañado de sus tres hijos. 

Toda gloria a los doce pastorcillos asociados de Nityānanda Prabhu y a los sesenta y cuatro grandes asociados de Mahāprabhu. Suplico a todos que me otorguen misericordiosamente los pies de loto de Śhrī Gaura.

IDX.en_translation:
All glories, all glories! Beholding the ārati of Prabhupāda, who bestows eternal service at Yogapīṭha in Māyāpura. 

The enchanting fragrance of his preaching acts like incense, captivating the bees of the bound and liberated souls, and the entire moving and non-moving world. 

Igniting the lamp of Bhaktisiddhānta (devotional conclusions) in the world, the flame of service in the five mellows shines brightly within it. 

Just as the five great lamps serve as five great lights, they destroy the darkness of the three worlds—ignorance and wicked intelligence. 

The current of Bhaktivinoda flows like water from a conchshell; it flows incessantly, with no obstruction. 

The bell, consisting of all instruments, rings at all times; the great mṛdaṅga plays, supremely sweet. 

On his broad forehead shines a bright tilaka, and a necklace of tulasī beads glitters on his neck. 

His long arms reach down to his knees, his body is tall, and his complexion is like molten gold—supremely beautiful. 

A smile filled with affection is on his charming, graceful face; his bodily effulgence shines like the eternal full moon. 

Wearing the saffron cloth of the renounced order, he cleared the cloud-covered Gauḍīya sky. 

How many groves he has created with the flowers of devotion; the whole universe is enchanted by their beauty and fragrance. 

In the vision of service, Narahari waves the cāmara, and Keśava sings the nīrājana with great joy.
IDX.es_translation:
Toda gloria, toda gloria a la ceremonia del ārati de Śhrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Prabhupāda que estoy contemplando y que concede [a quienes lo observan] el servicio eterno en el Yoga-pīṭha de Māyāpura. 

La dulce y cautivadora fragancia del incienso de su prédica se propaga por doquier y atrae a todos los seres liberados y condicionados, tanto móviles como inmóviles, como si de un enjambre de abejas se tratara.. 

Él iluminó al universo entero con la lámpara de las conclusiones filosóficas del servicio devocional puro. Dicha lámpara está integrada por las llamas del sevā en los cinco rasas. 

Dondequiera que se encuentren esas cinco grandes llamas, hay cinco grandes halos de luz que destruyen la ignorancia y la inteligencia perversa en los tres mundos. 

La corriente de agua de la caracola es la corriente de las enseñanzas de Śhrīla Bhaktivinoda Ṭhākura que fluye continuamente y no puede ser detenida. 

La campana, que contiene todos los sonidos musicales, resuena perpetuamente, pero la música del bṛhat-mṛdaṅga (la publicación de escrituras sagradas) despliega la dulzura más grande. 

Un resplandeciente tilaka adorna su amplia frente, y alrededor de su cuello brilla un collar de cuentas de tulasī. 

Él es supremamente hermoso, con sus largos brazos que se extienden hasta sus rodillas, su elevada estatura y su tez dorada. 

Su encantador y atractivo rostro muestra una sonrisa llena de afecto, y la belleza de su piel es como una perpetua luna llena. 

Ataviado con una vestimenta del color del alba que simboliza los principios religiosos del sannyāsā, él liberó al cielo Gauḍīya de las nubes de las concepciones erróneas [y estableció la doctrina del bhakti puro]. 

Las numerosas glorietas [sus templos] constituidas por flores del bhakti [sus devotos] cautivan al universo entero con su fragancia y belleza. 

Śhrī Narahari Prabhu, el sirviente ideal, abanica con una cāmara, mientras Keśhava (Śhrīla Bhakti Prajñāna Keśhava Gosvāmī Mahārāja) canta esta canción de ārati con gran placer.

IDX.author: sacchidānanda bhaktivinoda ṭhākura
IDX.verses: jaya jaya rādhā-kṛṣṇa-yugala milana ārati karaye lalitādi sakhī-gaṇa madana-mohana-rūpa tri-bhaṅga-sundara pītāmbara śhikhi-puccḣa-chūḍā manohara lalita-mādhava-vāme vṛṣabhānu-kanyā (su)nīla-vasanā gaurī rūpe guṇe dhanyā nānā-vidha alaṅkāra kare jhalamala hari-mano-vimohana vadana ujjvala viśhākhādi sakhī-gaṇa nānā rāge gāya priya-narma-sakhī jata chāmara ḍhulāya (chāmara ḍhulāya re) (rādhā-kṛṣṇera ārati-kāle, chāmara ḍhulāya re) (‘jaya rādhe, śhrī rādhe’ bole, chāmara ḍhulāya re) (lalitā-viśhākhā-ādi, chāmara ḍhulāya re) śhrī-rādhā-mādhava-pada-sarasija-āśhe bhakativinoda sakhī-pade sukhe bhāse
IDX.en_translation:
All glories, all glories to the union of the Divine Couple, Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa! Lalitā and the other friends perform the āratī. 

Kṛṣṇa, whose form enchants even Cupid, is beautiful with His three-fold bending posture. He is adorned with yellow garments and a charming crest of peacock feathers. 

To the left of charming Mādhava stands the daughter of Vṛṣabhānu. Dressed in blue garments, fair-complexioned, she is blessed with beauty and excellent qualities. 

Various kinds of ornaments glitter. Their radiant faces captivate Hari’s mind. 

Viśākhā and the other friends sing in various melodies. All the intimate joking friends wave the whisks. 
<highlight>(They gently wave the cāmaras. During the ārati of Śrī Śrī Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa, they gently wave the cāmaras. Crying, “All glories to Rādhe! Śrī Rādhe!” they gently wave the cāmaras. Lalitā, Viśākhā, and the other sakhīs gently wave the cāmaras.)</highlight> 

With hope for the lotus feet of Śrī Rādhā and Mādhava, Bhaktivinoda joyfully floats in the mood of a female friend.
IDX.es_translation:
¡Toda gloria a la unión de la Divina Pareja, Śhrī Śhrī Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa! Dirigidas por Lalitā-devī, las sakhīs ejecutan Su ārati. 

Colocado en Su hermosa postura curvada en tres lugares, Kṛṣṇa, el encantador de Cupido, viste con ropas de seda amarilla y una corona de plumas de pavo real, y cautiva así las mentes de todos. 

A la izquierda del encantador Mādhava se encuentra la hermosa hija del rey Vṛṣabhānu, Śhrīmatī Rādhikā. Está ataviada con un sari azul oscuro, Su tez es como el oro fundido y Su belleza y Sus cualidades son incomparables. 

Está adornada con diversos y refulgentes ornamentos, y Su radiante rostro encanta la mente de Śhrī Hari. 

Viśhākhā dirige a todas las sakhīs en el canto de diversas melodías, mientras otras priya-narma-sakhīs abanican a la Divina Pareja con chāmaras. 

Bhaktivinoda Thākura nada en un océano de dicha a los pies de loto de las sakhīs con la esperanza de alcanzar los pies de loto de Śhrī Śhrī Rādhā-Mādhava.

IDX.en_translation:
All glories to Rādhā-Mādhava, the life-treasure of Jayadeva Gosvāmī! All glories to Rādhā-Mādhava! 

All glories to Rādhā-Madanagopāla, the life-treasure of Advaita Āchārya! All glories to Rādhā-Madanagopāla! 

All glories to Rādhā-Govinda, the life-treasure of Rūpa Gosvāmī! All glories to Rādhā-Govinda! 

All glories to Rādhā-Madanamohana, the life-treasure of Sanātana Gosvāmī! All glories to Rādhā-Madanamohana! 

All glories to Rādhā-Gopīnātha, the life-treasure of Madhu Paṇḍita! All glories to Rādhā-Gopīnātha! 

All glories to Rādhā-Dāmodara, the life-treasure of Jīva Gosvāmī! All glories to Rādhā-Dāmodara! 

All glories to Rādhā-Ramaṇa, the life-treasure of Gopāla Bhaṭṭa Gosvāmī! All glories to Rādhā-Ramaṇa! 

All glories to Rādhā-Vinoda, the life-treasure of Lokanātha Gosvāmī! All glories to Rādhā-Vinoda! 

All glories to Rādhā-Giridhārī, the life-treasure of Raghunātha Dāsa Gosvāmī! All glories to Rādhā-Giridhārī! 

All glories to Rādhā-Śyāmasundara, the life-treasure of Śyāmānanda Prabhu! All glories to Rādhā-Śyāmasundara! 

All glories to Rādhākānta, the life-treasure of Vakreśvara Paṇḍita! All glories to Rādhākānta! 

All glories to Gāndharvikā-Giridhārī, the life-treasure of Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Prabhupāda! 

All glories to Rādhā-Vinoda-Bihārī, the life-treasure of Śrīla Bhakti Prajñāna Keśava Gosvāmī Mahārāja! 

All glories to Rādhā-Ramaṇa-Bihārī, the life-treasure of Śrīla Bhaktivedānta Nārāyaṇa Gosvāmī Mahārāja!
IDX.es_translation:
¡Toda gloria a Rādhā-Mādhava, el tesoro del corazón de Śhrī Jayadeva Gosvāmī!

IDX.en_translation: Victory, victory to Rādhā-ramaṇa! Chant the Holy Name of Lord Hari! Victory, victory to Rādhā-ramaṇa! Chant the Holy Name of Lord Hari! Victory, victory to Rādhā-ramaṇa! Chant the Holy Name of Lord Hari!

IDX.en_translation:
All glories, all glories to Rādhe, Kṛṣṇa, Govinda! Rādhe Govinda, Rādhe Govinda! 

All glories, all glories to Śyāmasundara, Madana-mohana, the Moon of Vṛndāvana! All glories, all glories to Rādhā-ramaṇa, Rāsa-vihārī, the bliss of Gokula! 

All glories, all glories to the Queen of the Rāsa, Vinodinī, the Moon of the family of Bhānu! All glories, all glories to the multitude of sakhīs headed by Lalitā and Viśākhā! 

All glories, all glories to Śrī Rūpa Mañjarī, Rati Mañjarī, Anaṅga Mañjarī! All glories, all glories to Paurṇamāsī, Yogamāyā! Glory to Vīrā and her group! 

All of you together be merciful; I am very wicked. Please be merciful and give me the lotus feet of the Couple.
IDX.es_translation:
Toda gloria a Rādhā y Kṛṣṇa, que dan placer a las vacas, los gopas y las gopīs. 

Toda gloria a Kṛṣna, que tiene una hermosa tez oscura. Él encanta a Cupido y es la luna de Vṛndāvana. Toda gloria a aquel que se deleita con Rādhā, disfruta con el rāsa-līlā y es la dicha de Gokula. 

Toda gloria a Rādhā, que es la soberana de la danza rāsa, la personificación del placer de Kṛṣṇa y la luna de la dinastía de Vṛṣabhānu Mahārāja. Toda gloria a todas las sakhīs encabezadas por Lalitā y Viśhākhā. 

Toda gloria a Śhrī Rūpa Mañjarī, Rati Mañjarī y Anaṅga Mañjarī. Toda gloria a Paurṇamāsī Yogamāyā. Toda gloria al grupo [de mensajeros de la Pareja Divina] de Vīrā-devī [y Vṛndā-devī]. 

Sean compasivos conmigo, pues soy extremadamente pobre. Concédanme por favor [el servicio de] los pies de loto de la Pareja Divina.

advaita-charaṇe mora ei namaskāra 
tāna priya, tāṅhe mati rahuka āmāra”
IDX.en_translation:
All glories, all glories to Śrī Advaita, the patita-pāvana! Please deliver all of us who are fallen. 

Kṛṣṇa never allows His resolve to be otherwise; He can directly manifest Kṛṣṇa in all respects. 

Whose words Kṛṣṇa-candra obeys; by remembering You, all bondage is released. 

Whose command Yama, Kāla, and Mṛtyu obey; whose lotus feet are desired by the greatest yogeśvaras and munīśvaras. 

Who in this world can truly know such a person as You? Only by Your mercy can one attain the fruit of devotion. 

You are the treasurer of devotion; without Your giving devotion, who can attain Kṛṣṇa-bhakti, a Kṛṣṇa-bhakta, or Kṛṣṇa Himself? 

Please sincerely bestow upon me Kṛṣṇa-bhakti, so that in birth after birth, I may never forget Kṛṣṇa. 

To the lotus feet of Advaita, I offer this namaskāra; may my mind remain fixed on Him, who is so dear.

IDX.author: sacchidānanda bhaktivinoda ṭhākura
IDX.verses:
jaya jaya śhrī-chaitanya patita-pāvana, 
jaya nityānanda prabhu anātha-taraṇa 

jaya jayādvaitachandra kṛpāra sāgara 
jaya rūpa-sanātana jaya gadādhara 

śhrī-jīva gopāla-bhaṭṭa raghunātha-dvaya 
jaya vraja-dhāma-vāsī vaiṣṇava-nichoya 

jaya jaya navadvīpa-vāsī bhakta-gaṇa 
sabe mili’ kṛpā more kara vitaraṇa 

nikhila-vaiṣṇava-jana dayā prakāśhiyā 
śhrī-jāhnavā-pade more rākhaha ṭāniyā 

āmi to’ durbhaga ati vaiṣṇava nā chini 
more kṛpā karibena vaiṣṇava āpani 

śhrī-guru-charaṇe more bhakti kara dāna 
je charaṇa-bale pāi tattvera sandhāna 

brāhmaṇa sakala kari’ kṛpā mora prati 
vaiṣṇava-charaṇe more deha dṛḍha-mati 

uccḣa nīcha sarva-jīva charaṇe śharaṇa 
loilāma āmi dīna hīna akiñchana 

sakalake kariyā kṛpā deha’ more vara 
vaiṣṇave karuṇā ei granthera ādara 

grantha-dvārā vaiṣṇava-janera kṛpā pāi 
vaiṣṇava-kṛpāya kṛṣṇa-lābha haya bhāi 

vaiṣṇava-vimukha jā’re tāhāra jīvana 
nirarthaka jāna’ bhāi prasiddha vachana 

śhrī-vaikuṇṭha-dhāme ācḣe niḥśhreyasa vana 
tāhe śhobhā pāya kalpa-taru agaṇana 

tāhā mājhe e kalyāṇa-kalpa-taru-rāja 
nitya-kāla nitya-dhāme karena virāja 

skandha-traya ācḣe tā’ra apūrva darśhana 
upadeśha upalabdhi uccḣvāsa gaṇana 

su-bhakti-prasūna tāhe ati śhobhā pāya 
kalyāṇa nāmaka fala agaṇana tāya 

je sujana e viṭapī karena āśhraya 
kṛṣṇa-sevā-su-kalyāṇa-fala tāṅ’ra haya 

śhrī-guru-charaṇa-kṛpā-sāmarthya labhiyā 
e hena apūrva vṛkṣa dilāma āniyā 

ṭāniyā ānite vṛkṣa e karkaśha mana 
naśhilo ihāra śhobhā śhuno sādhu-jana 

tomāra sakala ha-o e vṛkṣera mālī 
śhraddhā-vari diyā punaḥ kara rūpaśhālī 

falibe kalyāṇa-fala yugala-sevana 
kariba sakale mili’ tāhā āsvādana 

nṛtya kari’ hari bala’ khāo sevā-fala 
bhakti-bale kara’ dūra kutarka-anala
IDX.en_translation:
All glories, all glories to Śrī-caitanya, the savior of the fallen! All glories to Nityānanda Prabhu, the deliverer of the helpless! 

All glories, all glories to Advaitacandra! 

All glories to Śrī Jīva residing in Braja-dhāma! 

All glories, all glories to the devotee community residing in Navadvīpa! All of you together, please bestow your mercy upon me. 

By manifesting mercy, all Vaiṣṇavas, Please pull me and keep me at the feet of Śrī Jāhnavā Devī. 

I am very unfortunate and do not recognize any Vaiṣṇava; May you, the Vaiṣṇavas, show mercy upon me. 

Please bestow devotion upon me at the feet of my Śrī-guru, By the strength of those feet, I obtain the understanding of truth. 

May all Brāhmaṇas show mercy towards me, And grant me firm faith at the feet of the Vaiṣṇavas. 

High and low, all living entities take shelter at their feet, I, who am poor, fallen, and insignificant, have taken that shelter. 

All of you, showing mercy, please grant me this boon: Compassion towards Vaiṣṇavas, and adoration for this book. 

Through this book, I receive the mercy of the Vaiṣṇavas, the attainment of Kṛṣṇa occurs, O brother! 

Know, O brother, that the life of one who is averse to Vaiṣṇavas Is useless; this is a famous saying. 

In Śrī-Vaikuṇṭha-dhāma there is a forest of supreme welfare, In which innumerable wish-fulfilling trees shine beautifully. 

Among them, this king of wish-fulfilling trees named Kalyāṇa, Eternally resides in the eternal abode, shining brightly. 

It has three branches, a wonderful sight: Instruction, realization, and expression of ecstasy. 

Beautiful flowers of devotion greatly enhance its beauty, And innumerable fruits named Kalyāṇa are found there. 

For any good person who takes shelter of this tree, The excellent fruit of service to Kṛṣṇa becomes his. 

Having obtained the power of the mercy of the feet of my Śrī-guru, I have brought such an uncommon tree here. 

To pull and bring this tree, my harsh mind Destroyed its beauty; please listen, O saintly people! 

May all of you become the gardeners of this tree, And by offering the water of faith, make it beautiful again. 

It will bear the auspicious fruit of yugala-sevana; We will all together relish that. 

Dance, chant “Hari”, and partake of the fruit of service; By the strength of devotion, drive far away the fire of bad arguments.

IDX.author: vaiṣṇava-dāsa
IDX.verses: jaya jaya śhrī-guru, prema-kalpataru, adbhuta jāṅko parakāśhahiyā ageyāna, timiravara jñāna-, suchandra kiraṇe karu nāśha iha lochana ānanda-dhāmaayāchita mo-hena, patita heri jo pahū, jāchi deyala harināma duramati agati, satata asate mati, nāhi sukṛti laba leśhaśhrī-vṛndāvana, yugala-bhajana-dhana, tāhe karala upadeśha niramala-gaura-, premarasa siñchane, pūrala jagajana āśhaso charaṇāmbuje, rati nāhi hoyala, royata vaiṣṇava-dāsa
IDX.en_translation:
All glories to the spiritual master, the wish-fulfilling tree of divine love, whose manifestation is wondrous. The darkness of ignorance in the heart is destroyed by the rays of the beautiful moon of his knowledge. 

He is the abode of joy for these eyes. Without being asked, and seeing a fallen soul like me, he mercifully gave the Holy Name. 

I am of wicked mind and without any goal; my thoughts are always fixed on the mundane. I do not possess even a trace of pious merit. Yet he gave me the instruction to attain Vṛndāvana and the treasure of worshiping the Divine Couple. 

By sprinkling the pure nectar of divine love, he fulfilled the hopes of the people of the world. In those lotus feet I have no attachment—so cries Vaiṣṇava dāsa.
IDX.es_translation:
Toda gloria a śhrī guru, el árbol de los deseos del prema, cuya manifestación es sumamente extraordinaria. Él destruye la vasta oscuridad de la ignorancia del corazón con refulgentes rayos de conocimiento. 

Sus ojos son la morada de la bienaventuranza. Cuando vio a una persona tan caída como yo, esa personalidad me dio harināma voluntariamente, sin pedírselo yo siquiera. 

Aunque soy indigno y estoy desvalido, mi mente se halla siempre absorta en asuntos mundanos y no poseo ni un ápice de méritos devocionales, él me instruye acerca de Śhrī Vṛndāvana y del tesoro del bhajana a la Pareja Divina. 

Inundando al mundo con el néctar puro del gaura-prema, śhrī guru colma las esperanzas de todos. Vaiṣṇava dāsa llora porque no ha desarrollado rati por sus pies de loto.

IDX.author: rādhāmohana dāsa
IDX.verses: jaya jaya śhrī-kṛṣṇachaitanya dayāsindhu patita uddhāra hetu jaya dīna-bandhu jaya premabhaktidātā, dayā kara more dante tṛṇa dhari’ ḍāke e-dāsa pāmare pūrvete sākṣāt jata pātakī tārilā se vichitra nahe jāte avatāra kailā mo-hena pāpiṣṭhe ebe karaha uddhāra āśhcharya dayāla-guṇa ghuṣuka saṁsāra vichāra karile muñi nahe dayāpātra āpana svabhāva-guṇe karaha kṛtārtha viśheṣa pratijñā śhuni’ ei kaliyuge ei bharasāya rādhāmohana dayā māge
IDX.en_translation:
All glories, all glories to Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya, an ocean of mercy! All glories to the Friend of the distressed, for delivering the fallen! 

All glories to the giver of loving devotion! Please bestow Your mercy upon me. This fallen servant calls out, holding a blade of grass in his teeth. 

In the past, You directly delivered many sinful persons. This is not surprising, for You have appeared as an incarnation specifically for that purpose. 

Now, please deliver a wretch as sinful as me. Let Your astonishingly merciful qualities be proclaimed throughout the entire world. 

Upon reflection, I am not worthy of Your mercy. Please fulfill me by Your own merciful nature and divine qualities. 

Hearing Your special promise in this Age of Kali, and with this hope alone, Rādhāmohana begs for Your mercy.

IDX.en_translation:
All glories to Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya and Nityānanda! All glories to Advaitacandra, and all glories to the assembly of Lord Gaura’s devotees! 

Please, all of you together, bestow your mercy; do not disdain this fallen and degraded soul. 

In these three worlds, Your lotus feet are the essence; reflecting in my mind, I see that there is no other shelter. 

In the hope of attaining those feet, distress arises in my mind; with an anxious heart, I always lament. 

How will I attain them? I find no way. I cannot even remember the lotus feet of Prabhu Lokanātha. 

You are indeed a merciful Lord; please glance upon me just once and remove the darkness from Narottama’s heart.

IDX.search: jaya jaya sri srivasa thakura pandita narada kheyati jara bhuvana vidita ki kahiba srivasera udara charitra tribhuvana haya jara smarane pavitra satya sevilena chaitanyere srinivasa janra ghare chaitanyera sakala vilasa krsna avatara jena vasudeva ghare jateka vihara saba nandera mandire jagannatha ghare haila gaura avatara srivasa pandita grhe jateka vihara sarvavaisnavera priya pandita srivasa tana badi gele matra sabara ullasa ki kahiba srivasera bhagyera mahima janra dasadasira bhagyera nahi sima chari vede janre dekhibare abhilasa taha dekhe srivasera jata dasi dasa putrasoka na janila je gauranga preme bhase aro sri krsnera sankirtana vane e saba samsara duhkha tanhara ki daya je tanhare smare seha kabhu nahi paya srivasera charane rahuka namaskara gaura chandra nityananda nandana janhara

IDX.verses:
jaya jaya śhrī-śhrīvāsa ṭhākura paṇḍita 
nārada-kheyāti jā’ra bhuvana vidita 

“ki kahiba śhrīvāsera udāra charitra 
tribhuvana haya jāra smaraṇe pavitra 

satya sevilena chaitanyere śhrīnivāsa 
jāṅra ghare chaitanyera sakala vilāsa 

kṛṣṇa-avatāra jena vasudeva-ghare 
jateka vihāra saba-nandera mandire 

jagannātha-ghare haila gaura-avatāra 
śhrīvāsa-paṇḍita-gṛhe jateka vihāra 

sarvavaiṣṇavera priya paṇḍita śhrīvāsa 
tāna bāḍī gele mātra sabāra ullāsa 

ki kahiba śhrīvāsera bhāgyera mahimā 
jāṅra dāsadāsīra bhāgyera nāhi sīmā 

chāri vede jāṅre dekhibāre abhilāṣa 
tāhā dekhe śhrīvāsera jata dāsī-dāsa 

putraśhoka nā jānila je gaurāṅga-preme 
bhāse āro śhrī-kṛṣṇera saṅkīrtana-vāṇe 

e saba saṁsāra-duḥkha tāṅhāra ki dāya 
je tāṅhāre smare seha kabhu nāhi pāya 

śhrīvāsera charaṇe rahuka namaskāra 
gaura-chandra-nityānanda-nandana jāṅhāra’’
IDX.en_translation:
All glories, all glories to Śrī Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura Paṇḍita, whose fame is known throughout the world like that of Nārada. 

What can I say about the magnanimous character of Śrīvāsa? By remembering him, the three worlds become pure. 

Indeed, Śrīnivāsa served Caitanya. In his house were all the pastimes of Caitanya. 

Just as the incarnation of Kṛṣṇa was in Vasudeva’s house, but all His many pastimes were in Nanda’s temple. 

In Jagannātha’s house was the incarnation of Gaura, but all His many pastimes were in Śrīvāsa Paṇḍita’s home. 

Śrīvāsa is dear to all Vaiṣṇavas. Just by going to his house, everyone becomes joyful. 

What can I say about the glory of Śrīvāsa’s fortune? There is no limit to the fortune of his servants and maidservants. 

He whom the four Vedas desire to see, Him see all the servants and maidservants of Śrīvāsa. 

He did not feel the sorrow of his son in that love for Gaurāṅga. He rather floated in the current of Śrī Kṛṣṇa’s saṅkīrtana. 

What concern are all these worldly miseries to him? Whoever remembers him also never experiences them. 

Let my obeisances remain at the feet of Śrīvāsa, he whose sons are Gaura-candra and Nityānanda.

IDX.verses:
jaya jaya sundara nanda-kumāra 
saurabha-saṅkaṭa-, vṛndāvana-taṭa-, 
vihita-vasanta-vihāra 

abhinava-kuṭmala-, guccḣa-samujjvala-, 
kuñchita-kuntala-bhāra 
praṇayi-janerita-, vandana-sahakṛta-, 
chūrṇita-vara-ghanasāra 

chaṭula-digañchala-, rachita-rasoccḣala-, 
rādhā-madana-vikāra 
bhuvana-vimohana-, mañjula-nartana, 
gati-valgita-maṇihāra 

adhara-virājita-, mandatara-smita-, 
lobhita-nija-parivāra 
nija-vallavajana-, suhṛt-sanātana-,

IDX.en_translation:
Glory, glory to the beautiful Nanda-kumāra (son of Nanda)! On the banks of Vṛndāvana, filled with fragrance, He performs His spring pastimes (vihāra). 

His curly hair is adorned with fresh buds and radiant bunches of flowers. He is worshipped by His beloved devotees and powdered with excellent camphor. 

His playful glances, overflowing with sweet mellows (rasa), stir the Cupid (Madana) of Rādhā. His beautiful dance enchants the world, and His jewel necklace sways with His movements. 

A gentle smile graces His lips, captivating His own family (parivāra). He is the delightful avatāra (descent) who resides in the hearts of His own cowherd people (vallavajana) and eternal friends (suhṛt sanātana).

jaya jaya vallavarāja-kumāra 
rādhā-vakṣasi hari-maṇihāra 

apaghana-ghaṭita-ghusṛṇa-ghanasāra 
piñcḣa-khachita-kuñchita-kachabhāra 

rādhā-dhṛtihara-muralī-tāra 
nayanāñchalakṛta-madana-vikāra 

rasa-rañjita-rādhā-parivāra

IDX.en_translation:
All glories, all glories to the Prince of the cowherd king! He is the captivating jewel necklace on Rādhā’s chest. 

His body is smeared with musk and camphor. His curly hair is adorned with a peacock feather. 

The sound of His flute steals Rādhā’s patience. The corners of His eyes create the god of love’s emotional disturbances. 

He enchants Rādhā’s companions with His mellows. He sports in the heart of Sanātana.

IDX.verses: jaya nanda-nandana, gopī-jana-vallabha, rādhānāyaka nāgara śhyāma so śhachī-nandana, nadīyā-purandara, sura-munigaṇa-manomohana dhāma jaya nija-kāntā-, kānti kalevara, jaya jaya preyasī-bhāva-vinoda jaya vraja-sahacharī-, lochana-maṅgala, jaya nadīyāvāsi-nayana-āmoda jaya jaya śhrīdāma, sudāma-subalārjuna, premavardhana navaghana rūpa jaya rāmādi sundara, priya sahachara, jaya jaga-mohana gaura anupa jaya atibala bala-, rāma-priyānuja, jaya jaya śhrī-nityānanda-ānanda jaya jaya sajjana-, gaṇa-bhaya-bhañjana, govindadāsa āśha anubandha
IDX.en_translation:
All glories to the son of Nanda, the beloved of the gopīs, the hero of Rādhā, the clever dark-complexioned Lord. He is the son of Śacī, the chief of Nadiyā, and the captivating abode for the minds of gods and sages. 

All glories to Him whose body possesses the luster of His own beloved; all glories to the enjoyment of His beloved’s sentiments. All glories to the auspiciousness for the eyes of the companions of Vraja; all glories to the delight for the eyes of the residents of Nadiyā. 

All glories to Śrīdāma, Sudāma, Subala, and Arjuna—His form like a fresh monsoon cloud increases divine love. All glories to beautiful Balarāma and the dear companions; all glories to the incomparable Gaura, who enchants the universe. 

All glories to the one of immense strength, the beloved younger brother of Balarāma; all glories to the joy of Śrī Nityānanda. All glories to the one who removes the fears of the saintly devotees; this is the hope and attachment of Govinda dāsa.
IDX.es_translation:
Toda gloria al hijo de Nanda Mahārāja, el amado de las gopīs y el héroe de Rādhā, el galante Śyāma. Él apareció como el hijo de Śhachī y es el monarca de Nadīyā. Él es la morada de toda la belleza que encanta las mentes de los semidioses y los sabios. 

Toda gloria a aquel que ha adornado Su cuerpo con el radiante color de Su amada. Toda gloria a aquel que se embelesa con los bhāvas de aquella a quien más quiere. Toda gloria a aquel que proporciona felicidad a los ojos de las doncellas de Vraja. Toda gloria a aquel que deleita los ojos de los residentes de Nadīyā. 

Toda gloria a Śhrīdāma, Sudāmā, Subala y Arjuna, cuyas formas son como nubes de lluvia recientes que incrementan el océano del prema. Toda gloria a Ramāi Paṇḍita, Śhrīvāsa y sus apuestos hermanos, que son todos acompañantes queridos de Mahāprabhu. Toda gloria al incomparable Gaura que cautiva al universo entero. 

Toda gloria al extremadamente poderoso y querido hermano menor de Balarāma (Kṛṣṇa). Toda gloria a aquel que es la dicha de Śhrī Nityānanda Prabhu (Gaurāṅga). Toda gloria a esos dos que erradican los temores de los devotos. Las esperanzas y aspiraciones de Govinda dāsa descansan en Ellos.

IDX.author: sacchidānanda bhaktivinoda ṭhākura
IDX.verses:
(jaya) rādhā-mādhava (jaya) kuñja-vihārī 
(jaya) gopī-jana-vallabha (jaya) giri-varadhārī 
(jaya) yaśhodā-nandana, (jaya) vraja-janarañjana, 
(jaya) jāmunatīra-vanachārī
IDX.translation_intro: <highlight>‘Normalmente se canta ‘jaya’ antes de cada nombre. Ej.: “(jaya) rādhā-māhava (jaya) kuñja-bihārī.”</highlight>
IDX.en_translation: Rādhā-Mādhava is the enjoyer of pastimes in the groves. He is the beloved of the gopīs and the lifter of Govardhana Hill. He is the son of Mother Yaśodā, the delighter of the inhabitants of Vraja, and the wanderer in the forests along the banks of the Yamunā.
IDX.es_translation: Śhrī Kṛṣṇa es el amado de Śhrī Rādhā y el disfrutador de pasatiempos en los bosques de Vraja. Él es el ser más querido para las gopīs y quien levantó la colina de Govardhana. Es el amado hijo de Madre Yaśhodā, da placer a los residentes de Vraja y pasea por los bosques a orillas del río Yamunā.

IDX.first_line: jaya rādhe jaya kṛṣṇa jaya vṛndāvana
IDX.search: jaya radhe jaya krsna jaya vrndavana sri govinda gopinatha madanamohana syama kunda radha kunda giri govardhana kalindi yamuna jaya jaya mahavana kesighata vamsivata dvadasa kanana janha saba lila kaila sri nanda nandana sri nanda yasoda jaya jaya gopagana sridamadi jaya jaya dhenu vatsagana jaya vrsabhanu jaya kirtida sundari jaya paurnamasi jaya abhiranagari jaya jaya gopisvara vrndavana majha jaya jaya krsna sakha batu dvijaraja jaya ramaghata jaya rohininandana jaya jaya vrndavana vasi jata jana jaya dvija patni jaya nagakanyagana bhaktite janhara paila govinda charana sri rasamandala jaya jaya radhasyama jaya jaya rasa lila sarva manorama jaya jayojjvalarasa sarvarasa sara parakiyabhave jaha vrajete prachara sri jahnava pada padma kariya smarana dina krsna dasa kahe nama sankirtana

IDX.verses: jaya rādhe, jaya kṛṣṇa, jaya vṛndāvana śhrī-govinda gopīnātha madanamohana śhyāma-kuṇḍa rādhā-kuṇḍa giri-govardhana kālindī yamunā jaya, jaya mahāvana keśhīghāṭa vaṁśhīvaṭa dvādaśha-kānana jāṅhā saba līlā kaila śhrī-nanda-nandana śhrī-nanda-yaśhodā jaya, jaya gopagaṇa śhrīdāmādi jaya, jaya dhenu-vatsagaṇa jaya vṛṣabhānu, jaya kīrtidā-sundarī jaya paurṇamāsī, jaya ābhīranāgarī jaya jaya gopīśhvara vṛndāvana-mājha jaya jaya kṛṣṇa-sakhā baṭu dvijarāja jaya rāmaghāṭa, jaya rohiṇīnandana jaya jaya vṛndāvana-vāsī jata jana jaya dvija-patnī, jaya nāgakanyāgaṇa bhaktite jāṅhārā pāila govinda-charaṇa śhrī-rāsamaṇḍala jaya, jaya rādhāśhyāma jaya jaya rāsa-līlā sarva-manorama jaya jayojjvalarasa sarvarasa sāra pārakīyabhāve jāhā vrajete prachāra śhrī-jāhnavā-pāda-padma kariyā smaraṇa dīna kṛṣṇa-dāsa kahe nāma-saṅkīrtana
IDX.en_translation:
Glory to Rādhā, glory to Kṛṣṇa, glory to Vṛndāvana. Śrī Govinda, Gopīnātha, Madana-mohana. 

Śyāma-kuṇḍa, Rādhā-kuṇḍa, Govardhana Hill. Glory to the Kālindī Yamunā, glory to Mahāvana. 

Keśī-ghāṭa, Vaṁśīvaṭa, the twelve forests. Where the son of Nanda performed all His pastimes. 

Glory to Śrī Nanda and Yaśodā, glory to the cowherd men. Glory to Śrīdāma and others, glory to the cows and calves. 

Glory to Vṛṣabhānu, glory to the beautiful Kīrtidā. Glory to Paurṇamāsī, glory to the young cowherd women. 

Glory, glory to Gopīśvara in the midst of Vṛndāvana. Glory, glory to Kṛṣṇa’s friend, the brāhmaṇa boy (Madhu-maṅgala). 

Glory to Rāma-ghāṭa, glory to the son of Rohiṇī. Glory, glory to all the residents of Vṛndāvana. 

Glory to the wives of the brāhmaṇas, glory to the Nāga-kanyās. Who attained the feet of Govinda through devotion. 

Glory to the Śrī Rāsa-maṇḍala, glory to Rādhā-Śyāma. Glory, glory to the rāsa-līlā, which enchants everyone. 

Glory, glory to the ujjvala-rasa, the essence of all rasas. Which is preached in Vraja in the mood of paramour love. 

Remembering the lotus feet of Śrī Jāhnavā, the lowly Kṛṣṇa Dāsa sings the saṅkīrtana of the Name.
IDX.es_translation:
Toda gloria a Śhrī Rādhā, Śhrī Kṛṣṇa y el divino bosque de Śhrī Vṛndāvana. Toda gloria a Śhrī Govinda, Gopīnātha y Madana-mohana [las tres deidades regentes de Vṛndāvana]. 

Toda gloria a Śhyāma-kuṇḍa, Rādhā-kuṇḍa y la colina de Govardhana. Toda gloria al río Yamunā (Kālindī) y al gran bosque conocido como Gokula Mahāvana [donde Kṛṣṇa y Balarāma realizaron Sus pasatiempos infantiles]. 

Toda gloria a Keśhī-ghāṭa [donde Kṛṣṇa mató al demonio Keśhī], a Vaṁśhīvaṭa [el árbol baniano bajo el cual Kṛṣṇa atrajo a las gopīs con Su flauta] y a los doce bosques de Vraja, donde el hijo de Nanda llevó a cabo Sus pasatiempos. 

Toda gloria a Śhrī Nanda y Śhrī Yaśhodā [los padres de Kṛṣṇa]. Toda gloria a los pastorcillos encabezados por Śhrīdāma [el hermano mayor de Śhrīmatī Rādhārāṇī y Anaṅga Mañjarī]. Toda gloria a las vacas y los terneros de Vraja. 

Toda gloria a Śhrī Vṛṣabhānu y a la hermosa Kīrtidā [los padres de Rādhārāṇī]. Toda gloria a Paurṇamāsī. Ella es guru de la comunidad de pastores, la madre de Sāṅdīpani Muni, la abuela de Madhumaṅgala y Nāndī-mukhī, y discípula de Devarṣi Nārada. Toda gloria a las doncellas de Vraja. 

Toda gloria, toda gloria a Gopīśhvara Śhiva, que reside en Vṛndāvana [para proteger el santo dhāma]. Toda gloria, toda gloria a Madhumaṅgala, el joven brahmán amigo de Kṛṣṇa. 

Toda gloria a Rāma-ghāṭa [donde Balarāma realizó Su danza rāsa]. Toda gloria a Balarāma, el hijo de Rohiṇī. Toda gloria a todos los residentes de Vṛndāvana. 

Toda gloria a las esposas de los orgullosos brahmanes védicos y a las esposas de la serpiente Kālīya. Su bhakti puro hizo que alcanzaran los pies de loto de Govinda. 

Toda gloria a la arena circular de la danza rāsa. Toda gloria a Rādhā y Śhyāma. Toda gloria, toda gloria al hermosísimo rāsa-līlā. 

Toda gloria, toda gloria al ujjvala-rasa (śhṛṅgāra-rasa), que es la esencia y el más excelso de todos los rasas, y que es conocido como el parakīya-bhāva of Vraja. 

Recordando los pies de loto de Śhrī Jāhnavā-devī [la consorte de Nityānanda Prabhu], este caído Kṛṣṇa dāsa realiza nāma-saṅkīrtana.

IDX.en_translation:
All glories to Rādhā, all glories to Rādhā Rādhā, all glories to Rādhā, all glories to Śrī Rādhā. All glories to Kṛṣṇa, all glories to Kṛṣṇa Kṛṣṇa, all glories to Kṛṣṇa, all glories to Śrī Kṛṣṇa. 

Śyāmā and Gaurī, eternally youthful, the beloved consort Śrī Rādhā. The playful and charming lover, who enchants the gopīs, Śrī Kṛṣṇa. 

Performer of the Rāsa dance, expander of divine mellows, the holder of nectar, Śrī Rādhā. Ever-fresh and colorful, youthfully bent in three places, the beautiful dark-limbed one, Śrī Kṛṣṇa. 

Dearer than life, illuminated by beauty, extremely delicate Śrī Rādhā. Charming to the eyes, greatly delightful, most supremely beautiful Śrī Kṛṣṇa. 

Array of beauty, enchanting, with a voice like a cuckoo, Śrī Rādhā. Glorious, beloved of women, the supremely opulent Lord, Śrī Kṛṣṇa. 

Moon-faced, with teeth like kunda flowers, abode of beauty Śrī Rādhā. Supremely generous, with unlimited effulgence, extremely delicate Śrī Kṛṣṇa. 

With the gait of a swan, shining beautifully, delightful in pastimes Śrī Rādhā. Full of beauty and charm, with large eyes, supremely merciful Śrī Kṛṣṇa. 

Golden creeper, flowing with amorous mellows, very charming and unique Śrī Rādhā. Ocean of all happiness, abode of all good qualities, illuminated by beauty Śrī Kṛṣṇa. 

Charming among women, more tender than a fresh sprout, whose qualities are unfathomable Śrī Rādhā. Resident of the divine abode, manifesting divine effulgence, naturally sweetly smiling Śrī Kṛṣṇa. 

The pleasure potency, speaking very sweetly, who maddens the heart, Śrī Rādhā. Enchanting in every limb, full of charming mellows, beautifully well-formed Śrī Kṛṣṇa. 

Whose Name is Rādhā, delightful with good qualities, the queen beloved of Hari, Śrī Rādhā. Hare Hare Hari, Hare Hare Hari, Hare Hare Hari Śrī Kṛṣṇa.

IDX.en_translation:
All glories, all glories, all glories to Ṭhākura Śrī Narottama, the great king of prema-bhakti! His minister, who is non-different from him in heart, is Rāmacandra Kavirāja. 

The crown jewel of divine love, adorned with a succession of spiritual emotions, shines on every limb of his body. He sits upon a royal throne in Khetarī, accompanied by an assembly of devotees. 

He constantly deliberates on the Bhāgavatam and the works of Sanātana and Rūpa. This brilliant mellow of the Divine Couple, Rādhā and Mādhava, is the essence of supreme bliss. 

Through Śrī Saṅkīrtana and being intoxicated with the nectar of his subject, he transcends considerations of both pious and impious activities. Yoga, speculative knowledge, and various vows all weep before the presence of the Bhāgavatam. 

The scriptures of the Bhāgavatam, which bestow the wealth of devotion, are themselves glorified by Gaura. All the schools of Sāṅkhya, Mīmāṁsā, and logic tremble seeing his spiritual prowess. 

The thieves of non-devotion flee far away; they do not dare reveal themselves near him. To the poor and lowly people, the wealth of devotion is freely given. Only Govinda Dāsa feels deprived of this treasure.

jaya śhachī-nandana, jaya gaura-hari 
viṣṇupriyā-prāṇadhana, nadīyā-vihārī 

jaya śhachī-nandana, gaura guṇākara 
prema-paraśhamaṇi, bhāva-rasa-sāgara
IDX.en_translation:
All glories to the Son of Mother Śacī! All glories to Lord Gaura-hari! He is the treasure of Viṣṇupriyā’s life and He sports in the land of Nadīyā. 

All glories to the Son of Śacī! He is Lord Gaura, the mine of good qualities. He is the touchstone of divine love and the ocean of emotional mellows.
IDX.es_translation:
¡Toda gloria al hijo de Śhachī, toda gloria a Śhrī Gaurahari! Él es la riqueza de la vida de Viṣṇupriyā y Se deleita con los pasatiempos en la tierra de Nadīyā. 

Toda gloria al hijo de Śhachī, Gaurāṅga, la morada de maravillosas cualidades, la piedra de toque del prema y el océano de bhāva-rāsa.

(jaya) bhaktajanāśhraya, dīna dayāmaya, 
chinmaya achyuta dehi padam 

(jaya) parama pāvana, dharma parāyaṇa, 
daitya nisūdana dehi padam 

(jaya) veda vimohana, śhrī-rādhā-ramaṇa 
vṛndāvana dhana dehi padam 

(jaya) nitya nirañjana, dūrgati bhañjana, 
sajjana rañjana dehi padama
IDX.en_translation:
All glories to the dark-complexioned Holder of the conch, disc, and club! All glories to Him who is smeared with sandalwood, adorned with earrings, and marked with the Kaustubha gem! Please grant me shelter at Your lotus feet. 

All glories to the lotus-eyed Lord with beautiful eyebrows! O deliverer from sin! Please grant me shelter at Your lotus feet. 

All glories to the Flute-player and the enjoyer of the Rāsa dance! O beautiful and charming Lord! Please grant me shelter at Your lotus feet. 

All glories to the grave and expert Leader, who is wonderfully beautiful! O Lord who is very rare to attain even for the demigods! Please grant me shelter at Your lotus feet. 

All glories to the Enchanter of the universe and the Enchanter of the mind! O Cause of all existence! Please grant me shelter at Your lotus feet. 

All glories to the eternal Truth and the cause of all auspiciousness! O my final friend! Please grant me shelter at Your lotus feet. 

All glories to the Chastiser of the wicked, who is absorbed in His pastimes! O Subduer of the serpent Kāliya! Please grant me shelter at Your lotus feet. 

All glories to the shelter of the devotees! O merciful Friend of the distressed! O transcendental and infallible Lord! Please grant me shelter at Your lotus feet. 

All glories to the supreme Purifier, who is devoted to the path of righteousness! O Slayer of the demons! Please grant me shelter at Your lotus feet. 

All glories to the Enchanter of the Vedas and the lover of Śrīmati Rādhā-rāṇī! O Treasure of Vṛndāvana! Please grant me shelter at Your lotus feet. 

All glories to the eternal and spotless Lord, who is the destroyer of misfortune! O Delighter of the saintly! Please grant me shelter at Your lotus feet.

All glories to Your birth in Vraja, where even the Goddess of Fortune seeks to reside upon its dust. Yet, alas, You do not abandon us here! How can we, Your devotees, be otherwise, O Lord? 

Your beauty is superior to the finest autumn lotuses, from which You steal the very goddess of beauty with Your gaze. 

Alas! How can we, who are outside Your grace, attain such purity? Even though You were bound by our pleas, and even those lotuses were blessed by You. 

Having entered Your service again, why do You now slay us with that gaze? If death were to come by Your glance alone, it would be superior to death by a weapon. 

From various fears, You have preserved all of Gokula along with its forests. We consider it Your protection, for how can that protection be lost due to Your love? 

O protector of the humble! O Son of the Queen of Vraja! Our intelligence is perishable. Your apparent neglect of us appears bitter because of our suffering. 

You are the universal protector and are not easily angered like others. Therefore, being entreated by Lord Brahmā, You appeared in the most pure lineage. 

May that hand of Your Master, which is renowned and dispels the fear of the cycle of birth and death, place its auspicious touch upon our heads. 

O hero! In the depths of Vraja, You pacify the angry gopīs with a smile alone. Therefore, do not punish us in any other way; simply manifest the glorious splendor of Your face. 

Although Your feet are the abode of the Goddess of Fortune and are a great banner of merit for the distressed, You still follow the cows and dance on the heads of the venomous serpent. 

Even though You were in great distress in that state, You became our tranquil support. Alas! Why do You not protect us, whose hearts are consumed by the fire of separation from You? 

With Your sweet pastimes, delightful words, and joyful fragrance, we have been thirsty for a long time for Your nectarean speech. 

Your nectarean stories are the life of the distressed and are praised by the poets for destroying all impurities. Those who do not propagate them are wicked and deprive us of knowledge. 

Your smiling, dancing eyes and Your delightful moods dispels all sorrow, and Your presence in the forest is our very life. 

When You go to graze the cows, our minds are broken by fate. The thought of the soft grass and sprouts touching Your feet becomes our only meditation. 

Alas! Our inner hearts are ablaze! Remember Your own people, who consider themselves humble. May Your lotus feet be firmly placed in our hearts, O charmer! 

Alas! When You go to the forest each day, we see Your beautiful face with curly locks and that moment feels like a vast age to us. 

What more can be said about this in Vraja? Even for a moment, Your sight is desired. Alas, how can we gopīs not be anxious there? 

Entangled in the net of Your songs and having left our own people, what woman would You abandon in the night in this wilderness? 

O beloved! Your smiling, loving glances and Your broad chest—which is the abode of fortune—seeing all this, our own foolishness is revealed to us. 

At the end of the day, with the darkness of Your hair and the spreading dust from the cows, You manifest the moon-like glory of Your face and cause us to remember You again and again. 

Due to the increase of its own pleasure, the flute becomes a witness. Grant us, O hero, that nectar from Your lips which destroys all sorrow and is our life-giving food. 

Even though You conceive of love in that way, it is in truth an artistic creation. How can we, who are constantly in the mood of affection, ever have other desires? 

Your manifestation among the residents of Gokula is the destroyer of their sins. Grant us, who are filled with longing for You, the soothing cure for our heart’s disease. 

Your supremely beautiful lotus feet, which we gently place upon our breasts, are pained when You wander in the forest. Our minds become bewildered by the thought of thorns and stones pricking them. 

Thus, the gopīs, singing and lamenting in various ways, wept aloud, eager to see Lord Kṛṣṇa. 

Then, the Lord, whose lotus face was smiling, appeared before them wearing yellow garments and a garland—He who is the direct bewilderer of even Cupid himself.

IDX.author: narottama-dāsa ṭhākura
IDX.verses: je ānila prema-dhana karuṇā prachura hena prabhu kothā’ gelā āchārya ṭhākura kāṅhā mora svarūpa-rūpa, kāṅhā sanātana kāṅhā dāsa-raghunātha, patita-pāvana kāṅhā mora bhaṭṭa-yuga, kāṅhā kavirāja eka-kāle kothā’ gelā gorā naṭa-rāja pāṣāṇe kuṭiba māthā, anale paśhiba gaurāṅga guṇera nidhi kothā’ gele pāba se saba saṅgīra saṅge je kaila vilāsa se saṅga nā pāiyā kānde narottama-dāsa
IDX.en_translation:
Where has that master gone, that revered teacher who brought the wealth of divine love and abundant mercy? 

Where are Svarūpa Dāmodara and Rūpa Gosvāmī? Where is Sanātana Gosvāmī? Where are Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī and Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa Gosvāmī, the deliverers of the fallen? 

Where are my two Bhaṭṭas? Where is Kṛṣṇa-dāsa Kavirāja? Where has the fair-complexioned king of dancers gone all at once? 

I will smash my head against a stone; I will enter the fire. Where will I find Gaurāṅga, the treasure house of all qualities? 

Not finding the association of those companions with whom He performed His divine pastimes, Narottama dāsa cries.
IDX.es_translation:
¿Quién, debido a su inmensa compasión, trajo el tesoro del prema? ¿Adónde se ha ido esa venerable persona, Śhrī Śhrīnivāsa Āchārya (o Advaita Āchārya)? 

¿Dónde están mi Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī y Rūpa Gosvāmī? ¿Dónde está Sanātana Gosvāmī? ¿Dónde está Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī, el salvador de las almas caídas? 

¿Dónde están mi Gopāla Bhaṭṭa Gosvāmī y Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa Gosvāmī? ¿Dónde está Kṛṣṇadāsa Kavirāja Gosvāmī? ¿Adónde se fue de pronto Gaurāṅga, el rey de los bailarines? 

Me romperé la cabeza contra una roca o me lanzaré al fuego. ¿Dónde puedo encontrar a Gaurāṅga, el manantial de todas las cualidades divinas? 

Incapaz de obtener la asociacion de Śhrī Śrīnivāsa Āchārya, que realizó pasatiempos con los asociados de Mahāprabhu, Narottama dāsa llora.

hañā śhṛṅgārera puṣṭi kare

Whichever rati takes birth in someone, that kind of rasa is theirs. The principal rasas are of five kinds. Again, the seven secondary rasas are subservient qualities of rati; the relation of rati is the shelter of bhāva. 

Among the five principal rasas, O brother, I sing the glories of madhura, calling it the supreme rasarāja. All the qualities that are in other rasas are present in madhura, and it becomes more powerful due to many more. 

All the secondary rasas that exist are like sañcārī, and they nourish śṛṅgāra. One who is a follower of Śrī Rūpa and is absorbed in devotional service, their steadiness is only in madhura. 

The madhura and ujjvala rasa is always under the sway of śṛṅgāra. The son of Vraja-rāja is the viṣaya. Aiśvarya is very hidden within it; it becomes intoxicated by the influence of mādhurya. Its āśraya are the devotees.

kaisī cḣāī hariyālī ālī kuñjana mē

jorī lāge ati pyārī basi nainana mē 

jamunā ke kūla, pahira suraṅga dukūla 
kaise khila rahe fūla in kadamana mē 

gaura śhyāma raṅga, ghana dāminī ke saṅga 
bhaī akhiyā apaṅga cḣavi bharī mana mē

IDX.en_translation:
Rādhā and Dāmodara are swinging on a swing in Vṛndāvana. How the greenery has spread in the groves, O friend! 

Here is the darling of Nanda, there is the darling daughter of Bhānu. The Pair looks very dear, residing in the eyes. 

On the bank of the Yamunā, wearing colorful fine cloth. Just as flowers are blooming on these Kadamba trees. 

Fair and dark colors, like cloud and lightning together. My eyes became crippled (helplessly staring), the beauty filled the mind. 

Rādhā’s face, and the eyes of Śyāma are the cakora. The rope of the love of the sakhīs is attached to the feet.

From the swing, the delightful Rādhā, full of nectar, and Kṛṣṇa, the King of nectar, quickly descended. The two of Them sat on jeweled seats within the jeweled temple. 

Taking a fine yak-tail whisk, one devoted sakhī fans Them. With fragrant water, someone washes Their faces, and with a cloth, wipes Their eyes. 

One fills a plate with various sweets, holding it before Their mouths. With the gopī friends, with much joy, They happily ate Their meal. 

Preparing betel nuts, one sakhī took it and placed it in both Their mouths. They offered hair adorned with flowers, worshipping Them from head to foot, again and again. 

On a bed of flowers, gently, Rādhikā and Śyāma sat. From weariness, with closed eyes, seeing this, even Cupid is enchanted. 

Seeing this, the gopī friends, with much care, laid Them both down to rest. At the sakhī’s signal, to serve Their feet, this servant Vaiṣṇava Dāsa rushes.

IDX.en_translation:
Lord Kṛṣṇa is swinging, with Rādhā on His left, reveling in joyful play. With slight smiles, many gopī friends gathered together are making Them swing in amorous play while singing various melodies. 

The excellent golden swing, adorned with jewels, is filled with the intoxicating fragrance of flowers. Rows of bees are alighting upon it. The branches are entwined with fresh creepers, and the beautiful forest of Vṛndāvana shines splendidly. It is a bright moonlit night. 

Lord Kṛṣṇa, whose body is like a fresh rain cloud, swings with Rādhā on His left. Their beauty is entwined like lightning and a cloud. Moon-like necklaces adorned with star-like jewels sway on Their necks as They swing. Their bodies are gracefully entwined. 

To the rhythmic syllables of the drum, the mṛdaṅga plays an enchanting sound. The gentle sound, conquering all other sounds, spreads throughout the villages and towns—it is beyond description. 

The jeweled ornaments and ankle bells make a jingling sound as They swing. Rādhāmohana expresses hope at Their feet, and Uddhava Dāsa has complete reliance upon Them. His heart is filled with this composition.

IDX.en_translation:
“Wake up, O soul, wake up!” says Gorāchānda. How long will you sleep in the lap of the witch Māyā? 

Having come into this material world, thinking, “I will worship,” You remained deluded by the burden of ignorance. 

To deliver you, I have descended as an Avatāra. Who else but Me is your friend? 

I have brought the medicine to destroy Māyā. Take the Harināma-mahāmantra by humbly asking for it. 

Bhaktivinoda, falling at the feet of the Lord, Humbly begged for and received that Harināma-mantra.

“Wake up, O soul, wake up!” says Gorāchānda. How long will you sleep in the lap of the witch Māyā? 

Having come into this material world, thinking, “I will worship,” You remained deluded by the burden of ignorance. 

To deliver you, I have descended as an Avatāra. Who else but Me is your friend? 

I have brought the medicine to destroy Māyā. Take the Harināma-mahāmantra by humbly asking for it. 

Bhaktivinoda, falling at the feet of the Lord, Humbly begged for and received that Harināma-mantra.
IDX.es_translation:
Śhrī Gaura-chandra está llamando: ¡Levántense, almas durmientes! ¡Levántense, almas durmientes! ¿Cuánto tiempo van a seguir durmiendo en el regazo de la bruja māyā?” 

“Vinieron a este mundo material diciendo que adorarían al Señor, pero lo han olvidado y permanecen cubiertos por la ignorancia.” 

“He descendido a este mundo para liberarlos. Aparte de Mí, ¿quién es su amigo?” 

“He traído la medicina que destruye [la enfermedad] de Māyā. ¡Se lo suplico, canten estos santos nombres!” 

Postrado a los pies de loto de Śhrīmān Mahāprabhu, Bhaktivinoda ha pedido y aceptado este harināma-mantra.

IDX.en_translation:
By the good fortune of all living entities, the two brothers have appeared on this earth: the moon-like Gaura and Nitāi, who enchant the entire universe. 

In this Age of Kali, they have awakened all the unconscious souls by giving them the nectar of the Holy Name of Lord Hari. 

O brother! I have never heard of such an incarnation! They delivered all the sinful persons by going from house to house. 

Such an incarnation has never appeared in any other age. Tell me, which incarnation ever begged the sinners to give up their sins? 

Although they were beaten until blood flowed from their bodies, they still gave divine love and delivered those who struck them. 

The three worlds were filled with the nectar of the Holy Name and divine love. Only this servant Locana remains deprived.

mata ro kānhā ūwā ūwā

IDX.en_translation:
Long live Śyāma Lālā! Your turban is yellow, and Your complexion is dark. 

Nandalālā has come to Gokula. Now it’s the turn of the cowherd girls. 

“Don’t cry Kṛṣṇa!”, His aunt Sunandā explains. 

Rice pudding, sweet pretzels, fried bread, and sweet cakes are made. Joy has come to Yaśodā’s home. 

The cradle creaks as the residents of Vraja sing, “Long live the child!” 

Nanda is overjoyed! Glory to Kanhaiyā Lāl! 

An elephant is given, a horse is given, and a palanquin is given. Glory to Kanhaiyā Lāl! Elephant, horse, palanquin!

jñānī jñānayoge, kariyā jatane,

sampūrṇa jñānete hare 

tabu ta’ prārabdha, nāhi haya kṣaya, 
falabhoga vinā kabhu 
brahmabhūta jīva, falabhoga lāgi’,

ekāntī janera āra 
prārabdhāprārabdha, kicḣu nāhi thāke, 
vede gāy bāra bāra 

tomāra udaye, jīvera hṛdaya, 
sampūrṇa śhodhita haya 
karmajñāna-bandha, saba dūre jāya, 
anāyāse bhava-kṣaya 

bhakativinoda, bāhu tule kaya,

IDX.en_translation:
A wise person, through the path of knowledge and with great effort, realizes the Absolute Truth. This realization completely removes the accumulated reactions to past actions through perfect knowledge. 

Even then, the results of current actions are not destroyed; they must still be experienced. A soul absorbed in that Absolute Truth must take birth and death to experience those results. 

But, O Name! When You manifest, for a one-pointed devotee, all karmic reactions cease to exist. The Vedas sing this again and again. 

With Your appearance, the heart of the soul becomes completely purified. All the bondage of action and knowledge goes far away, and material existence is destroyed effortlessly. 

Bhaktivinoda raises his arms and says: “Hold the banner of the Name! By making the sound of the Holy Name resound, you will meet the flute-player!”

udiyācḣe ekabindu, krame bhaktirasa-sindhu-, 
lābhe tā’ra haya adhikāra 

jñāna, karma, devadevī, bahu jatanete sevi’, 
prāptafale haile tuccḣajñāna 
sādhujana-saṅgāveśhe, śhrī-kṛṣṇakathāya śheṣe, 
viśhvāsa ta’ haya balavān 

sei ta’ viśhvāse bhāi, “śhraddhā” bali sadā gāi, 
bhaktilatā-bīja bali tāre 
karmī jñānī jane jāre, śhraddhā bale bāre bāre, 
sei vṛtti śhraddhā hoite nāre 

‘nāmera vivāda mātra’, śhuniyā ta’ jvale gātra, 
lauhe jadi balaha kāñchana 
tabu lauha lauha raya, kāñchana ta’ kabhu naya, 
maṇi-sparśha nahe jatakṣaṇa 

kṛṣṇa-bhakti chintāmaṇi, tāṅra sparśhe lauha-khani, 
karmajñānagata śhraddhā-bhāva 
hañā jāya hemabhāra, cḣāḍiyā ta’ ku-vikāra, 
se kevala maṇira prabhāva
IDX.en_translation:
All yogas and sacrifices are insignificant; faith is the essence of all. One in whose heart a single drop of that faith has arisen, gradually becomes qualified to attain the ocean of the nectar of devotion. 

Even after much endeavor in serving knowledge, fruitive activities, and demigods, when the obtained results are considered insignificant, then through the association of saintly persons and finally hearing topics of Śrī Kṛṣṇa, firm belief becomes strong. 

O brother, we always sing of that firm belief as “faith”, and call it the seed of the creeper of devotion. What the fruitive worker and empiric philosopher repeatedly call faith, that tendency cannot be true faith. 

Hearing that it is “just a dispute of names,” one’s body burns. If you call iron gold, still, iron remains iron, it is never truly gold, until it receives the touch of a divine gem. 

Devotion to Kṛṣṇa is the wish-fulfilling gem. By its touch, an iron mine—the mood of faith related to karma and jñāna—becomes a heap of gold, leaving behind all impurities. That is solely the power of the gem.

IDX.en_translation:
Situated on the altar of union, surrounded by the eight chief companions in the kadamba groves of Vṛndāvana, is the flute-bearer with Rādhā, the captivator of everyone’s heart. My very life is at His feet. 

According to the companions’ command, I serve them both. As a nurtured maidservant, I always meditate on Their feet. 

Sometimes, by Their grace, They take my hand and speak sweet words. Taking betel, They both eat, and they take garlands with eagerness. 

When they disappear by some pretense, my heart burns at not seeing them. 

Wherever They may be, let them remain. I am indeed a maidservant of Their feet. In union, there is joy; in separation, there is distress—I consider all these feelings to be equal. 

Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa are my life in both life and death. Whether protecting me or killing me, let them remain happy. 

Bhaktivinoda knows nothing else. Falling at the feet of his own companions and always remaining among Rādhā’s associates, he desires the feet of the Divine Couple.

IDX.en_translation:
Ka - In the Age of Kali, Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya is the incarnation. Kha - He took up the mṛdaṅga drum and karatālas to arrange His pastimes. 

Ga - The Lord rolls on the ground in His congregational chanting. Gha - He gives the Holy Name to everyone in every home. 

Ṅa - The Lord cries loudly for the sake of the living entities. Ca - He awakens the living entities by giving them the Holy Name of Kṛṣṇa. 

Cha - His eyes are filled with tears. Ja - He purified the universe with His golden body. 

Jha - His face shines like the full moon. Ña - I have never seen such an ocean of mercy. 

Ṭa - His body trembles, overwhelmed with ecstatic emotion. Ṭha - He walks with a graceful gait and chants “Haribol!” 

Ḍa - He wears a loincloth and a belt on His thin waist. Ḍha - Swaying to and fro, He falls into the lap of Gadādhara Paṇḍita. 

Ṇa - Lord Gaura does not hear any other topics with His ears. Ta - His mind is absorbed in the nectar of melodies, beats, and songs. 

Tha - The tears in the Lord’s eyes are never still. Da - Embracing the poor and lowly people, He gives them His mercy. 

Dha - He washes everything with the topics of previous divine love. Na - I do not know in whose mood He became bent in three places. 

Pa - He flooded the entire world with the mellows of divine love. Pha - Śrī Vṛndāvana blossomed in the flow of the celestial Ganges. 

Ba - He is the one whom Lord Brahmā and Lord Śiva search for. Bha - The thousand-eyed Indra cannot find Him even by meditation. 

Ma - His gait is like a maddened elephant, and His smile is sweet and gentle. Ya - Mother Yaśodā is manifest in this world. 

Ra - His form defeats Cupid and is very enchanting. La - His pastimes and beauty are very incomparable. 

Va - He is that same Son of Vasudeva and Son of Nanda. Śa - Everyone now calls Him the Son of Śacī. 

Ṣa - He manifested a six-armed form, which is very wonderful. Sa - Be careful, the Lord of my life, Gaura, is full of divine mellows. 

Ha - Chant “Hari! Hari!” brother, and perform this great sacrifice. Kṣa - Being born on the surface of the earth, do not remain ignorant. 

Whoever chants these thirty-four verses, Narottama Dāsa begs for his lotus feet.

Alas, when, chanting “Gaurāṅga”, will I become detached and give up caring for my body in eating and sleeping? 

In Navadvīpa-dhāma, from town to town, abandoning false pride, I will beg alms (madhukarī) at the homes of the residents of the dhāma and eat to fill my belly. 

Going to the riverbank, palmful by palmful, I will drink the water of the Lord’s feet. Lying under a tree, I will give up laziness and gain strength in my body. 

Piteously chanting the names “Gaura-Gadādhara”, “Śrī Rādhā-Mādhava”, weeping and weeping, calling out loudly, I will wander throughout the dhāma. 

Seeing a Vaiṣṇava, I will fall at his feet, knowing him to be a friend of my heart. The Vaiṣṇava Ṭhākura, accepting me as his servant, will show me the Lord’s kīrtana.
IDX.es_translation:
¿Cuándo conquistaré y me desapegaré por completo de actividades corporales como comer y dormir al tiempo que canto en voz alta: “¡Gaurāṅga!”. 

Una vez abandonado mi ego falso, vagaré de aldea en aldea en Śhrī Navadvīpa-dhāma haciendo mādhukarī (Comida que mendiga un renunciante en diferentes casas tal como la abeja (madhukara) recoge miel de diferentes flores) en los hogares de los dhāma-vāsīs, y de ese modo comeré hasta que mi estómago esté satisfecho. 

En las orillas del Gaṅgā beberé con mis manos el agua sagrada que lavó los pies de loto del Señor, y bajo la sombra de un árbol aliviaré mi fatiga y devolveré las energías a mi cuerpo. 

Exclamando en voz alta: “¡Gaura-Gadādhara!” “¡Śhrī Radhā-Mādhava!”, vagaré por todo el dhāma llorando y suplicando. 

Cuando vea a un vaiṣṇava, caeré a sus pies de loto sabiendo que es el verdadero amigo de mi corazón. Aceptándome como su sirviente, ese venerable vaiṣṇava me hará presenciar los kīrtanas de Mahāprabhu.

IDX.en_translation:
When in the wood-lands of Gaura By the bank of the celestial stream With the cry of “Oh Kṛṣṇa, Oh Rādhā!” Shall I roam weeping, Renouncing the pleasures of the body, Under all diverse creepers and Trees? 

At the homes of the basest By begging I will feed, Sip the water of the Sarasvatī, From bank to bank I will roll on the ground With the tumult of cry of Kṛṣṇa? 

To the denizens of the Abode of God Making obeisance I will beg for the trace of mercy: With the particles of dust from the feet of the Vaiṣṇavas Anointing my body, Assuming the garb of the wholly free? 

The denizens of Braja and Gauḍa I will not deem as different, I will be a dweller of Braja-dhāma’s own beauty Will manifest to the eye, I will be the handmaid of Rādhā!
IDX.es_translation:
¿Cuándo llegará el día en que, abandonando mi felicidad corporal, vagaré por las riberas del Suradhunī (Gaṅgā) en Gaura-vana (Śhrī Navadvīpa-dhāma) sollozando y exclamando “¡Hā Rādhā! ¡Hā Kṛṣṇa!”? 

Me alimentaré de lo que obtenga mendigando en las casas de los intocables y beberé el agua del río Sarasvatī. Rodaré por la tierra a orillas del Sarasvatī e invocaré en voz alta los nombres de Śhrī Kṛṣṇa. 

Ofreciendo reverencias a todos los dhāma-vāsīs, les suplicaré por una gota de misericordia. Extendiendo el polvo de los pies de los vaiṣṇavas por mi cuerpo, aceptaré la ropa de un avadhūta. 

Cuando no vea distinción entre los residentes de Gauḍa y los de Vraja, me convertiré en un verdadero vrajavāsī. La forma trascendental del dhāma aparecerá ante mis ojos y me volveré una sirvienta de Śhrī Rādhā.

IDX.en_translation:
( Tune-Surat, Khambaj, Eltala ) Say, oh will that day be ever mine When all offence ceasing, The relish of the pure Name Will be infused into my heart by the pewer of mercy! 

Owning myself humbler Than the blade of grass, Welcoming the quality of fortitude in my heart, Giving honour to all, Being myself free from all vanity, Oh, when shall I taste the essence of the mellow liquid of the Name! 

Wealth, attendants, And the beautiful maid of poesy, I shall not covet for my happiness. In all my successive births, Be Thou pleased, O Gaur-Hari, To give me causeless devotion to Thy Feet! 

To articulate the Name Of Sree Krishna Horripilation of the body, thickness of the voice, Pallor and shivering Will make their appearance; A constant stream of tears will flow from my eyes. 

Oh, when shall I at Nabadwip, By the bank of the Celestial Stream, Call artlessly upon Gaur and Nityananda, And run about, Dancing and singing, Like one mad, giving up all consideration! 

Oh, when will Nityananda, Taking mercy on me, Absolve me from the infatuation of the world; And giving me the shelter Of His Own Feet Allow me entry into the Mart of the Name! 

And I shall buy and plunder  The mellow liquid of the Name of Hari, Intoxicated by the sweetness of the Name, lose all discretion; And by touching the feet Of those immersed in the mellow liquid Be ceaselessly mellowed by the liquid sweet! 

Oh, when will pity for jiva Manifest its appearance, And with an humble mind, forgetting his own happiness, Bhaktivinode, By humble solicitation, Will propagate the tidings of Divine Command!
IDX.es_translation:
Dime, ¿cuándo llegará el día en el que cesarán mis ofensas y un gusto por el santo nombre invadirá mi corazón por el poder de Tu misericordia? 

¿Cuándo me consideraré más bajo que una brizna de hierba y la cualidad de la tolerancia entrará en mi corazón? Cuando respete a todos y no desee ningún respeto para mí, saborearé la esencia del néctar de los santos nombres. 

Entonces declararé que no deseo los placeres corporales asociados con riquezas, seguidores, honores y mujeres hermosas. ¡Oh, Gaurahari! Dame devoción deseinteresada (ahaitukī-bhakti) por Tus pies de loto nacimiento tras nacimiento. 

¿Cuándo se erizarán mis vellos de éxtasis y mis palabras brotarán entrecortadas por la emoción, palidecerá y temblará mi cuerpo, y se anegarán mis ojos en lágrimas al cantar los santos nombres de Śhrī Kṛṣṇa? 

¿Cuándo, situado a orillas del río Suradhunī (Gaṅgā), en Navadvīpa, exclamaré “¡Oh, Gaura! ¡Oh, Nityānanda!” sin duplicidad? Danzando y cantando, correré de un lado a otro como un loco sin consideración alguna (hacia el mundo externo). 

¿Cuándo será misericordioso Nityānanda Prabhu y me liberará de la ilusión del disfrute sensual material? Entonces me otorgará la sombra de Sus pies de loto y me capacitará para entrar en el mercado del santo nombre. 

Suplicaré, pediré prestado o robaré el néctar del santo nombre (harināma-rasa) que me embriagará y me hará enloquecer. Tocando los pies de los que saborean ese rasa, me ahogaré constantemente en él. 

¿Cuándo se despertará en mí la compasión por todas las entidades vivientes? Entonces, olvidando mi propia felicidad y con un corazón humilde, propagaré por doquier la sagrada orden de Śhrī Chaitanya Mahāprabhu.

When will such a state be mine? Giving up material desires and diverse attachments, I will abandon the dense darkness of this material world. 

In the abode of Navadvīpa, which is non-different from Vṛndāvana, I will build a small cottage. Taking the lotus feet of the son of Śacī as my shelter, I will establish that relationship. 

On the banks of the Ganges, in a spiritual forest, sitting in a secluded spot, I will continuously drink the nectar of Kṛṣṇa’s name, calling out “Gaurāṅga!” 

O Gaura and Nitāi, You two brothers are the friends of the fallen! I am the lowest of the fallen, a wicked person; please become an ocean of mercy for me. 

Weeping, I will wander on both banks of the Ganges through the sixteen-krośa abode. At some point, by good fortune, I will see something at the foot of a tree. 

“Oh, oh, how beautiful! What have I seen?” Saying this, I will faint. Regaining consciousness, I will cry secretly, remembering a drop of Their mercy.
IDX.es_translation:
¿Cuándo llegará el día en que, renunciando a todos mis deseos mundanos y a las diversas clases de ataduras, abandonaré esta horripilante existencia material? 

Me construiré una pequeña choza en Śhrī Navadvīpa-dhāma, que no es diferente de Śhrī Vṛndāvana, y comprendiendo mi relación con Śhrī Śhachī-nandana, me refugiaré en Sus pies de loto. 

Sentado en un lugar solitario en un bosque trascendental a orillas del río Jāhnavī (Gaṅgā), beberé incesantemente el néctar del nombre de Śhrī Kṛṣṇa y recitaré en voz alta el nombre de Gaurāṅga diciendo: 

“¡Oh, Gaura-Nitāi! Ustedes son los amigos de las almas caídas. Yo soy el más caído de todos y sumamente pecador, de modo que concédanme por favor el océano de Su misericordia.” 

Llorando e implorando de este modo, vagaré por las dieciséis krośas (cincuenta y dos kilómetros cuadrados) del dhāma a ambas orillas del Jānnavī (Gaṅgā), y puede que entonces, por una gran fortuna, obtenga una visión bajo un árbol. 

“¡Oh, Manohara (encantador de mi mente)! ¿Qué estoy viendo?”. Diciendo esto, me desmayaré, y cuando recobre la conciencia, lloraré secretamente recordando esa gota de misericordia de Śhrī Śhrī Gaura-Nitāi.

IDX.search: kabe habe hena dasa mora tyaji jada asa vividha bandhana cḣadiba samsara ghora vrndavanabhede navadvipa dhame bandhiba kutira khani sachira nandana charana asraya kariba sambandha mani jahnavi puline chinmaya kanane basiya vijana sthale krsna namamrta nirantara piba dakiba gauranga bale ha gaura nitai tora duti bhai patita janera bandhu adhama patita ami he durjana hao more krpa sindhu kandite kandite sola krosa dhama jahnavi ubhaya kule bhramite bhramite kabhu bhagya fale dekhi kicḣu taru mule ha ha manohara ki dekhinu ami baliya murccḣita haba samvit paiya kandiba gopane smari duhu krpa lava
IDX.author: sacchidānanda bhaktivinoda ṭhākura
IDX.verses:
kabe ha’be hena daśhā mora 
tyaji’ jaḍa-āśhā, vividha bandhana, 
cḣāḍiba saṁsāra-ghora 

vṛndāvanābhede, navadvīpa-dhāme, 
bāṅdhiba kuṭīra-khāni 
śhachīra nandana-charaṇa āśhraya, 
kariba sambandha māni’ 

jāhnavī-puline, chinmaya-kānane, 
basiyā vijana-sthale 
kṛṣṇa-nāmāmṛta, nirantara piba, 
ḍākiba ‘gaurāṅga’ bo’le 

“hā-gaura-nitāi! torā du’ṭī bhāi, 
patita-janera bandhu 
adhama patita, āmi he durjana, 
hao more kṛpā-sindhu” 

kāṅdite kāṅdite, ṣola-krośha-dhāma, 
jāhnavī ubhaya kūle 
bhramite bhramite, kabhu bhāgya-fale, 
dekhi kicḣu taru-mūle 

hā hā manohara, ki dekhinu āmi, 
baliyā mūrccḣita ha’ba 
samvit pāiyā, kāṅdiba gopane, 
smari’ duhū kṛpā-lava
IDX.en_translation:
When will such a state be mine? Giving up material desires and diverse attachments, I will abandon the dense darkness of this material world. 

In the abode of Navadvīpa, which is non-different from Vṛndāvana, I will build a small cottage. Taking the lotus feet of the son of Śacī as my shelter, I will establish that relationship. 

On the banks of the Ganges, in a spiritual forest, sitting in a secluded spot, I will continuously drink the nectar of Kṛṣṇa’s name, calling out “Gaurāṅga!” 

O Gaura and Nitāi, You two brothers are the friends of the fallen! I am the lowest of the fallen, a wicked person; please become an ocean of mercy for me. 

Weeping, I will wander on both banks of the Ganges through the sixteen-krośa abode. At some point, by good fortune, I will see something at the foot of a tree. 

“Oh, oh, how beautiful! What have I seen?” Saying this, I will faint. Regaining consciousness, I will cry secretly, remembering a drop of Their mercy.

IDX.first_line: kabe kṛṣṇa dhana pāba hiyāra mājhāre thoba
IDX.search: kabe krsna dhana paba hiyara majhare thoba judaiba tapita parana sajaiya diba hiya basaiba prana priya nirakhiba se chandra bayana he sajani kabe mora hoibe sudina se prana nathera sange kabe va firiba range sukhamaya yamuna pulina lalita visakha lana tanhare bhetiba giya sajaiya nana upahara sadaya hoiya vidhi milaibe guna nidhi hena bhagya hoibe amara daruna vidhira nata bhangila premera hata tilamatra na rakhila tara kahe narottama dasa ki mora jivane asa cḣadi gela vrajendra kumara
IDX.author: narottama-dāsa ṭhākura
IDX.verses: kabe kṛṣṇa-dhana pāba, hiyāra mājhāre thoba, juḍāiba tāpita-parāṇa sājāiyā diba hiyā, basāiba prāṇa-priyā, nirakhiba se chandra-bayāna he sajani! kabe mora hoibe sudina se prāṇa-nāthera saṅge, kabe vā firiba raṅge, sukhamaya yamunā-pulina lalitā-viśhākhā lañā, tāṅhāre bheṭiba giyā, sājāiyā nānā upahāra sadaya hoiyā vidhi, milāibe guṇa-nidhi, hena bhāgya hoibe āmāra? dāruṇa vidhira nāṭa, bhāṅgila premera hāṭa, tilamātra nā rākhila tā’ra kahe narottama-dāsa, ki mora jīvane āśha, cḣāḍi’ gela vrajendra-kumāra
IDX.en_translation:
When will I obtain the treasure of Kṛṣṇa? I will place Him in the core of my heart, and soothe my distressed soul. I will decorate my heart, and seat the beloved of my life there; I will gaze upon His moon-like face. 

Oh friend! When will that auspicious day be mine, when with that Lord of my life, I will playfully wander on the blissful banks of the Yamunā? 

Taking Lalitā and Viśākhā, I will go and meet Him, having prepared various offerings. When will providence be merciful and unite me with that treasure-house of qualities? Will such fortune ever be mine? 

The cruel play of fate has broken the marketplace of love, not even a sesame seed’s worth remains of it. Naroṭṭamadasa says, what hope is there in my life, since the Prince of Vraja has left me?
IDX.es_translation:
¿Cúando lograré el tesoro de Śhrī Kṛṣṇa y Lo situaré en mi corazón, proporcionando así alivio a mi alma ardiente? Decoraré mi corazón, colocaré allí a mi amado y entonces contemplaré Su hermoso rostro de luna. 

¡Oh, querida amiga! ¿Cuándo llegará ese auspicioso día? ¿Cuándo recorreré las orillas del Yamunā en éxtasis con el Señor de mi corazón? 

Acompañada de Lalitā y Viśhākhā, iré a Su encuentro llevando diferentes obsequios. Siendo compasiva, la Providencia me unirá con el manantial de todas las cualidades ― ese destino será mío. 

Por desgracia, la danza de la cruel Providencia ha destruido el mercado del prema y no ha quedado ni una semilla de sésamo. Narottama dāsa se lamenta: “¿Qué esperanza me queda en la vida ahora que el hijo del rey de Vraja me ha dejado?”
