IDX.search: ore mana ki rase haiya raili bhora ki baliya eli setha ki kaja va kara hetha tileka chetana nahi tora putra dara sampada jivana yauvana mada je kara sakali asara jalabimba kataksana temati janiha mana tribhuvane krsna matra sara je dina je gela jaya ja acḣe samalo taya kaladuta dandaiya pathe cḣadiya anyatha kama bala radha krsna nama kabhu dekha na habe ta sathe ajnakari brahma hara samana kinkara ara sura muni je pada dheyaya hena krsna pada cḣadi gale diya mayadadi duhkha deha kena re amaya premananda kahe bhai krsna vina gati nai bhaja krsna charanaravinde samsara sagare padi kena kara kadubadi kaha krsna taribe anande

ore mana! ki rase haiyā raili bhora 
ki baliyā eli sethā, ki kāja vā kara hethā, 
tileka chetana nāhi tora 

putra dārā-sampada, jīvana-yauvana-mada, 
je kara, sakali asāra 
jalabimba katakṣaṇa, temati jāniha mana, 
tribhuvane ‘kṛṣṇa’ mātra sāra 

je dina je gela jāya, jā ācḣe sāmālo tāya, 
kāladūta dāṅḍāiyā pathe 
cḣāḍiyā anyathā kāma, bala ‘rādhā-kṛṣṇa’ nāma, 
kabhu dekhā nā habe tā-sāthe 

ājñākārī brahmā-hara, śhamana-kiṅkara āra, 
sura-muni je pada dheyāya 
hena kṛṣṇa-pada cḣāḍi’, gale diyā māyādaḍi, 
duḥkha deha kena re āmāya 

premānanda kahe bhāi, ‘kṛṣṇa’ vinā gati nāi, 
bhaja kṛṣṇa-charaṇāravinde 
saṁsāra-sāgare paḍi’, kena kara kāḍubāḍi, 
kaha ‘kṛṣṇa’ taribe ānande
IDX.en_translation:
O my mind! In what pleasure have you remained immersed? For what reason did you come to this world, and what work are you doing here? You do not have even a moment of awareness. 

Children, family, wealth, life, and the pride of youth—whatever you pursue, all of it is worthless. How long does a bubble on the water last? Know that everything is like that. In the three worlds, only Lord Kṛṣṇa is the true essence. 

Whatever days have passed are gone; take care of what remains. The messenger of death is standing on the path. Abandoning all other desires, chant the Names of Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa, and then you will never have to meet that messenger. 

Lord Brahmā and Lord Śiva are obedient to Him, as are the servants of death. The demigods and sages meditate upon His feet. Abandoning such lotus feet of Lord Kṛṣṇa and putting the rope of illusion around your neck, why do you give me so much sorrow? 

Premānanda says: “O brother! Without Lord Kṛṣṇa there is no refuge. Worship the lotus feet of Lord Kṛṣṇa. Having fallen into the ocean of material existence, why do you make such a fuss? Chant “Kṛṣṇa!” and you will cross over with joy.”

ore mana! kibā tumi vichāri nā chāo 
‘kṛṣṇa’ bhuli ei pāpa, teṁha tora tina tāpa, 
nānā joni bhramiyā beḍāo 

tumi kṛṣṇa-nityadāsa, kothā gela se abhyāsa, 
dhana-jana-made haiyā āndhe 
vināmūlye māthā pāti, dāsa haye khāo lāthi, 
śhraddhāte vasana diyā kāndhe 

ei mora sadā dhanda, kaha lakṣa kathā manda, 
‘kṛṣṇa-nāma’ loite ālisa 
thākite rasanā tuṇḍa, jāo kena naraka-kuṇḍa, 
ihā haite ke āra bāliśha 

vṛthā tabe nara-tanu, śhrī-kṛṣṇa-bhajana vinu, 
kemane pāmara jīte chāya 
kṛṣṇa vinā koṭiyuga, jīyei vā kon sukha, 
se jīvana pātharera prāya 

ebāra mānuṣa-deha, āra ki hoibe eha, 
bhaja kṛṣṇa, cḣāḍa anāchāra 
dekha saba nāśhā-fāṅdā, kevala anartha-dhāṅdhā, 
asamaye haya kebā kā’ra 

premānanda kahe mana, ‘kṛṣṇa’ kaha anukṣaṇa, 
āpanāra tattve hoo daḍha 
saṁsāra-vāsanā-garta, kīṭa-krimimaya kata, 
dekhiyā śhuniyā kena paḍa
IDX.en_translation:
O my mind! Why do you not consider this? Forgetting Lord Kṛṣṇa is the root of all sin; it brings you the three-fold miseries and makes you wander through various species. 

You are an eternal servant of Lord Kṛṣṇa—where has that understanding gone? Becoming blind with the intoxication of wealth and family, you bow your head to illusion without any gain, becoming its slave and receiving only kicks. 

This is my constant confusion: you speak a million useless words, but you are lazy to utter the Name of Kṛṣṇa. While having a tongue in your mouth, why do you choose to go to the pit of hell? Who could be more foolish than this? 

This human body is useless without the worship of Lord Kṛṣṇa. How can a wretched soul even desire to live like this? Without Lord Kṛṣṇa, what happiness is there in living for millions of ages? Such a life is like a stone. 

You have this human body now—will you ever get it again? Worship Lord Kṛṣṇa and give up all unrighteousness. See all these destructive snares and useless puzzles of this world. In the end, who will truly belong to whom? 

Premānanda says: “O my mind! Chant the Name of Kṛṣṇa constantly and become firm in your own spiritual identity. Why do you fall into the pit of material desires, full of worms and insects, even after seeing and hearing the truth?”

IDX.search: ore mana kise kara dehera gumana maile dehera je avastha naha ki tahara jnata dekhiye suniye nahe jnana bhusane bhusita jei pachiye padibe sei podaye karibe nahe cḣai kukkura sakuni siva bediye khaibe kiba kimva krmi iha ki edai satye laksya varsa jara keha nahi acḣe tara ebe kali ki ayu tomara charachara dekha jata sakali hoibe hata dhana jana sampada ara krsna haite janma tora mayate bhuliya bhora churi dari pravancha vachane apana uddhara pathe tile drsti nahi tate narakera hetu ratri dine chari juge tribhuvane bhuta bhavisya vartamane satya satya harinama sara smrti cḣadi hari pade dubile samsara made e sukha lutibe jama dvara kahe premananda dasa dante trna gale vasa hari hari kaha ore bhai jadi hari bala vaktre fukara karaye sastre tribhuvane tara sama nai
IDX.author: premānanda-dāsa ṭhākura
IDX.verses:
ore mana! kise kara dehera gumāna 
maile dehera je-avasthā, naha ki tāhāra jñātā, 
dekhiye śhuniye nahe jñāna 

bhūṣaṇe bhūṣita jei, pachiye paḍibe sei, 
poḍā’ye karibe nahe cḣāi 
kukkura-śhakuni-śhivā, beḍiye khāibe kibā, 
kimvā kṛmi, ihā ki eḍāi 

satye lakṣya-varṣa jā’rā, keha nāhi ācḣe tā’rā, 
ebe kali ki āyu tomāra 
charāchara dekha jata, sakali hoibe hata, 
dhana-jana-sampada āra 

‘kṛṣṇa’ haite janma tora, māyāte bhuliyā bhora, 
churi-dārī pravañcha-vachane 
āpana-uddhāra-pathe, tile dṛṣṭi nāhi tā’te, 
narakera hetu rātri-dine 

chāri juge tribhuvane, bhūta-bhaviṣya-vartamāne, 
satya satya ‘harināma’ sāra 
smṛti cḣāḍi’ hari-pade, ḍubile saṁsāra-made, 
e sukha luṭibe jama-dvāra 

kahe premānanda-dāsa, dante tṛṇa, gale vāsa, 
‘hari hari’ kaha ore bhāi 
jadi ‘hari’ bala vaktre, fukāra karaye śhāstre, 
tribhuvane tāra sama nāi
IDX.en_translation:
O my mind! Why are you so proud of this body? Do you not know what its state will be when you die? Have you gained no wisdom even after seeing and hearing the truth? 

This body, though now adorned with ornaments, will eventually decay or be burnt to ashes. Dogs, vultures, and jackals will devour it, or it will be consumed by worms—this cannot be avoided. 

Those who lived for a hundred thousand years in the first age are all gone now. What then is your lifespan in this Age of Kali? All that you see—moving or non-moving—will be destroyed, along with all wealth, people, and possessions. 

Your origin is from Lord Kṛṣṇa, but bewildered by illusion, you spend your time in theft, adultery, and deceitful words. You have no concern for the path of your own deliverance, and your actions only lead to hell day and night. 

In all four ages and in all three worlds, the only truth is the Holy Name of Lord Hari. Forgetting His lotus feet and drowning in the intoxication of material existence, your current happiness will be plundered at the door of death. 

Premānanda Dāsa says: “With a straw in my teeth and a cloth around my neck in surrender, I beg you, brother, chant “Hari! Hari!” If you utter “Hari” with your mouth, the scriptures proclaim that there is no one equal to you in the three worlds.”

IDX.first_line: ore mana kṛṣṇa nāma sama nāhi āna
IDX.search: ore mana krsna nama sama nahi ana dharma karma tapa tyaga dhyana jnana vrata yaga kicḣu nahe namera samana je nama loite hara preme matta digambara valmiki hoila tapodhana ajamila papi cḣila namabhase tare gela putrake dakiya narayana je namera svada peye tambure firaye geye devorsi narada gosai satya bhama vrata cḣale krsna sange kari tule dekhaila namera badai ananta sahasra mukhe je nama gayena sukhe tabu to karite nare sima laksya kari arjunake prabhu apanara mukhe kahecḣena namera mahima premananda kahe mana krsna bala anuksana durvasana cḣadiya hrdaya preme uccḣa nama kari avasya paibe hari nama ara nami bhinna naya
IDX.author: premānanda-dāsa ṭhākura
IDX.verses:
ore mana! kṛṣṇa-nāma-sama nāhi āna 
dharma-karma-tapa-tyāga, dhyāna-jñāna-vrata-yāga, 
kicḣu nahe nāmera samāna 

je nāma loite hara, preme matta digambara, 
vālmīki hoila tapodhana 
ajāmila pāpī cḣila, nāmābhāse tare gela, 
putrake ḍākiyā nārāyaṇa 

je-nāmera svāda peye, tambure firaye geye, 
devoṛṣi nārada-gosāi 
satya-bhāmā vrata-cḣale, kṛṣṇa-saṅge kari’ tūle, 
dekhāilā nāmera baḍāi 

ananta sahasra mukhe, je nāma gāyena sukhe, 
tabu to karite nāre sīmā 
lakṣya kari’ arjunake, prabhu āpanāra mukhe, 
kahecḣena nāmera mahimā 

premānanda kahe mana, ‘kṛṣṇa’ bala anukṣaṇa, 
durvāsanā cḣāḍiyā hṛdaya 
preme uccḣa nāma kari’, avaśhya pāibe hari, 
nāma āra nāmī bhinna naya
IDX.en_translation:
O my mind! There is nothing equal to the Name of Lord Kṛṣṇa. Religious duties, pious activities, penance, renunciation, meditation, knowledge, vows, and sacrifices—none of these are equal to the Holy Name. 

By taking that Name, Lord Śiva became intoxicated with love, and Vālmīki became a great sage. Ajāmila was a great sinner, but he was delivered even by a shadow of the Name when he called for his son, Nārāyaṇa. 

Having tasted the sweetness of that Name, the divine sage Nārada Muni wanders about, singing while playing his vīṇā. Under the guise of a vow, Satyabhāmā weighed Lord Kṛṣṇa against the Holy Name and demonstrated its supreme greatness. 

Lord Ananta Śeṣa, with His thousands of mouths, happily sings that Name, yet He can never reach its end. Addressing Arjuna, the Lord Himself spoke of the glory of the Name with His own mouth. 

Premānanda says: “O my mind! Chant “Kṛṣṇa!” constantly, abandoning all evil desires from your heart. By loudly chanting the Name with love, you will surely attain Lord Hari, for the Name and the Lord are not different.”

IDX.search: ore mana nivedana sunaha amara janmile marana acḣe kala duta acḣe picḣe bhunjaibe karma anusare javata acḣaye ai krsna krsna kaha bhai kahi krsna sara apanake krsna nama je vadane se jitila tribhuvane ki bhaya samane acḣe take jadi chinta nija hita sadhu sange kara prita asatsanga na kariha ksane kukkura bhavane gele asthi charma khuba mile gaja danta mukta simha sthane krsna nama lila guna sravana kirtana mana asru kampa pulaka anande sadhu sange sada vasi vilasaha divanisi tabe vancḣa pure premanande
IDX.author: premānanda-dāsa ṭhākura
IDX.verses:
ore mana! nivedana śhunaha āmāra 
janmile maraṇa ācḣe, kāla-dūta ācḣe picḣe, 
bhuñjāibe karma-anusāre 

jāvata ācḣaye āi, ‘kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa’ kaha bhāi, 
kahi ‘kṛṣṇa’ sāra’ āpanāke 
kṛṣṇa-nāma je vadane, se jitila tribhuvane, 
ki bhaya śhamane ācḣe tāke 

jadi chinta nija-hita, sādhu-saṅge kara prīta, 
asatsaṅga nā kariha kṣaṇe 
kukkura-bhavane gele, asthi-charma khuba mile, 
gaja-danta-muktā siṁha-sthāne 

kṛṣṇa-nāma-līlā-guṇa-, śhravaṇa-kīrtana, mana, 
aśhru-kampa-pulaka ānande 
sādhu-saṅge sadā vasi’, vilasaha divāniśhi, 
tabe vāñcḣā pure premānande
IDX.en_translation:
O my mind! Please listen to my humble appeal. If you are born, you must die, and the messengers of death are always behind you. They will make you experience the results according to your past actions. 

As long as you still have life, chant “Kṛṣṇa! Kṛṣṇa!” my brother. By chanting the Name, protect your soul. One on whose lips the Name of Kṛṣṇa resides has already conquered the three worlds; what fear can he have of the God of Death? 

If you desire your own welfare, then develop affection for the company of the saintly. Do not associate with the unholy for even a single moment. If you go to a dog’s house, you will find only bones and skin, but in a lion’s place, you will find elephant tusks and pearls. 

O my mind! With tears, trembling, and ecstatic joy, always hear and chant the Name, pastimes, and qualities of Lord Kṛṣṇa. Always sitting in the association of the saintly, enjoy these pastimes day and night; then your desires will be fulfilled in divine bliss.

IDX.first_line: ore mana ruchi nahe kena kṛṣṇa nāma
IDX.search: ore mana ruchi nahe kena krsna nama tabe jani purva janme acḣe kata papa karme se lagi vidhata tore bama jadi anya katha pao antiya santiya koo krsna nama loite alisa jadi suna krsna katha vajra jena pade matha ghume jhume tallasa balisa jadi haya asat katha ghumete chiyao tatha sunite badaye kata rati nicha sange sada vasa sadhu jana dekhi hasa kulata vandiya ninda sati sraddha deva adhikari bhangibe e bharibhuri asi duta loibe bandhiya ki gumana kara deha pachi gali jabe eha dhana jana rahibe padiya je sukhe hayecḣa matta bujhi dekha tara tattva iha tora rahibe kothaya aji mara mara kali marana e nahe gali krsna krsna kaha dina jaya je kaile se kaile mana ebe hoo sachetana fire baisa ke tore haraya kahe premananda sukhe radha krsna bala mukhe samana jiniya utha naya
IDX.author: premānanda-dāsa ṭhākura
IDX.verses:
ore mana! ruchi nahe kena kṛṣṇa-nāma 
tabe jāni pūrva-janme, ācḣe kata pāpa-karme, 
se lāgi’ vidhātā tore bāma 

jadi anya kathā pāo, āṅṭiyā sāṅṭiyā koo, 
‘kṛṣṇa-nāma’ loite ālisa 
jadi śhuna ‘kṛṣṇa-kathā’, vajra jena paḍe māthā, 
ghume jhume tallāsa’ bāliśha 

jadi haya asat-kathā, ghumete chiyāo tathā, 
śhunite bāḍaye kata rati 
nīcha-saṅge sadā vāsa, sādhu-jana dekhi’ hāsa, 
kulaṭā vandiyā ninda satī 

śhrāddha-deva-adhikārī, bhāṅgibe e bhāribhuri, 
āsi’ dūta loibe bāndhiyā 
ki gumāna kara deha, pachi’ gali’ jā’be eha, 
dhana-jana rahibe paḍiyā 

je-sukhe ha’yecḣa matta, bujhi’ dekha tā’ra tattva, 
ihā tora rahibe kothāy? 
āji mara, mara kāli, maraṇa e nahe gāli, 
‘kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa’ kaha, dina jāya 

je-kaile se-kaile mana, ebe hoo sachetana, 
fire baisa ke tore hārāya 
kahe premānanda sukhe, ‘rādhā-kṛṣṇa’ bala mukhe, 
śhamana jiniyā uṭha nāya
IDX.en_translation:
O my mind! Why do you have no taste for the Name of Lord Kṛṣṇa? I know that due to many sinful actions in your previous births, your destiny is unfavorable toward you. 

If you find other topics to discuss, you speak with great effort, but you are lazy to utter the Name of Kṛṣṇa. If you hear topics about Lord Kṛṣṇa, it feels as if a thunderbolt has struck your head, and you immediately search for a pillow to sleep. 

If there is unrighteous talk, you are wide awake and listen with great attachment. You always reside with the wicked and laugh at the saintly. You praise the unchaste and criticize those who are faithful. 

The master of funeral rites will eventually break this illusion when his messengers come to bind you. What pride do you have in this body? It will only rot and decompose, while your wealth and family will remain behind. 

The happiness you are currently intoxicated with—understand its true nature. Where will it be for you in the end? You may die today or tomorrow; death is not just an insult, it is a reality. Chant “Kṛṣṇa! Kṛṣṇa!” as the days pass by. 

Whatever you have done in the past, O mind, now become conscious. Return to the right path—who then can defeat you? Premānanda says: “Chant “Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa!” with your mouth, conquer death, and rise up!”

IDX.first_line: ore mana sādhu saṅge karaha vasati
IDX.search: ore mana sadhu sange karaha vasati jadi karmapasa bandhe magana karaye andhe jadi kula vihina utpati jadi pasu paksi krmi janmiya janmiya bhrami satata karaya gatagati jemana temana sthane grhe va parvate vane kanha kene na haya vasati thake jena ei sutra drdha chita ei matra sri haricharane rati mati ghuchibe sakala dukha paibe asesa sukha bujhi kara sri hari bhakati dharma karma jnana yoga svarga moksa bhukti bhoga krsna sevananda iha vine jadi ithe kona ksana bandha taya amaya mana tabe jena haya ta marane radha krsna duti nama jihva jena avirama duhu guna lilate sravana kahe premananda dine duhu chinta anuksane rupe jena thakaye nayana
IDX.author: premānanda-dāsa ṭhākura
IDX.verses:
ore mana! sādhu saṅge karaha vasati 
jadi karmapāśha-bandhe, magana karaye andhe, 
jadi kula-vihīna utpati 

jadi paśhu-pakṣī-kṛmi, janmiyā janmiyā bhrami, 
satata karāya gatāgati 
jemana temana sthāne, gṛhe vā parvate vane, 
kāṅhā kene nā haya vasati 

thāke jena ei sūtra, dṛḍha-chita ei mātra, 
śhrī-haricharaṇe rati-mati 
ghuchibe sakala dukha, pāibe aśheṣa sukha, 
bujhi kara śhrī-hari-bhakati 

dharma-karma-jñāna-yoga, svarga-mokṣa-bhukti-bhoga, 
‘kṛṣṇa-sevānanda’-ihā vine 
jadi ithe kona kṣaṇa, bāndha tāya āmāya mana, 
tabe jena haya ta’ maraṇe 

‘rādhā’ ‘kṛṣṇa’ du’ṭī nāma, jihvā jena avirāma, 
dūhu-guṇa-līlāte śhravaṇa 
kahe premānanda dīne, dūhu chintā anukṣaṇe, 
rūpe jena thākaye nayana
IDX.en_translation:
O my mind! Live always in the company of the saintly. Even if you are blindly bound by the results of your past actions, and even if you are born into a family without any prestige. 

Even if you are born repeatedly as an animal, a bird, or an insect, wandering constantly through the cycle of birth and death—wherever you may be, whether in a home, on a mountain, or in a forest, always seek the company of the saintly. 

Let this be your only firm principle: to maintain love and devotion for the lotus feet of Lord Hari. Then all your miseries will cease, and you will attain endless happiness. Understanding this, perform devotional service to Lord Hari. 

Religious duties, fruitive actions, speculative knowledge, mystic yoga, heaven, liberation, and material enjoyment—if my mind is bound to any of these for even a single moment instead of the bliss of serving Lord Kṛṣṇa, then let that moment be my death. 

May the two Names “Rādhā” and “Kṛṣṇa” be upon my tongue without ceasing, and may my ears always hear of Their qualities and pastimes. Premānanda humbly says: “May I constantly meditate upon Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa, and may my eyes always be fixed upon Their divine forms.”

IDX.search: ore mana suna suna tu ati barbara sata sandhi jarajara peye ei kalevara kiba garva karicḣa antara trayatmika vyadhi jata bediya acḣaye kata ki jani kakhana keba nase e ami amara bali nija prabhu pasarili samana kinkara dekhi hase je deha apana jnane jatna kara ratri dine vasana bhusana kata vesa paramatma bhagavan jabe habe antardhana bhasma kita krmi avasesa nidrate padile mana kotha ghara dvara dhana stri putra bandhava thake kathi ihate na lage dhanda tabu karya kara manda na chintile apanara gati niti niti jiya mara ite na vichara kara emati jaibe ekabara kahe dina premananda bhaja krsna padadvandva maya pasa ghuchibe galara
IDX.author: premānanda-dāsa ṭhākura
IDX.verses:
ore mana! śhuna śhuna tu ati barbara 
śhata-sandhi-jarajara, peye ei kalevara, 
kibā garva karicḣa antara 

trayātmikā vyādhi jata, beḍiyā ācḣaye kata, 
ki jāni kakhana kebā nāśhe 
‘e āmi āmāra’ bali, nija-prabhu pāsarili, 
śhamana-kiṅkara dekhi’ hāse 

je deha āpana-jñāne, jatna kara’ rātri-dine, 
vasana bhūṣaṇa kata veśha 
paramātmā bhagavān, jabe habe antardhāna, 
bhasma kīṭa kṛmi avaśheṣa 

nidrāte paḍile mana, kothā ghara-dvāra-dhana, 
strī-putra-bāndhava thāke kathi 
ihāte nā lāge dhanda, tabu kārya kara manda, 
nā chintile āpanāra gati 

niti niti jīya mara, ite nā vichāra kara, 
emati jāibe ekabāra 
kahe dīna premānanda, bhaja kṛṣṇa-padadvandva, 
māyā-pāśha ghuchibe galāra
IDX.en_translation:
O my mind! Listen, you are very ignorant. Having attained this body which is subject to so many weaknesses, what pride do you harbor within? 

Three-fold miseries surround you—who knows when one will destroy you? Saying “this is I” and “this is mine,” you have forgotten your own Lord. The servants of death only laugh at your condition. 

This body, which you consider your own and care for day and night with clothes and ornaments—when the Supreme Lord disappears from it, only ashes, worms, and insects will remain. 

When the mind falls asleep, where then are your house, wealth, family, and friends? You are not confused by this reality, yet you continue to do evil deeds without thinking of your ultimate destination. 

Daily you experience a kind of life and death, yet you do not consider that you will surely depart one day. The lowly Premānanda says: “Worship the twin lotus feet of Lord Kṛṣṇa, and the noose of illusion will be removed from your neck.”

IDX.first_line: ore mana śhuna śhuna tu baḍi goṅāra
IDX.search: ore mana suna suna tu badi gonara cḣadiya satera sanga asat sange sada ranga parinama na kara vichara kamadira vasa haye sada fira matta haye jana toma aksaya amara danda karta acḣe jei dande dande likhe sei tileke bhangibe garva tora khara praya baha bhara jeba kanya putra dara pala jare apana janiya jabe kala bandhi labe e deha padiya rabe dekhi mukha rahibe firiya kariya bahira bati grhe dibe cḣada jhati snana kare pavitra lagiya kaha dekhi keba cḣila kahara adara kaila ebe kene fele podaiya kahe premananda chita jadi chaha nija hita krsna krsna kaha svasa svasa krsna jagatera karta krsna tina lokatrata bhaji krsna kata karmafansa
IDX.author: premānanda-dāsa ṭhākura
IDX.verses:
ore mana! śhuna śhuna tu baḍi goṅāra 
cḣāḍiyā satera saṅga, asat-saṅge sadā raṅga, 
pariṇāma nā kara vichāra 

kāmādira vaśha ha’ye, sadā fira matta ha’ye, 
jāna’ tomā akṣaya amara 
daṇḍa kartā ācḣe jei, daṇḍe daṇḍe likhe sei, 
tileke bhāṅgibe garva tora 

khara-prāya baha bhāra, jebā kanyā-putra-dāra, 
pāla’ jā’re āpanā jāniyā 
jabe kāla bāndhi’ labe, e deha paḍiyā ra’be, 
dekhi’ mukha rahibe firiyā 

kariyā bāhira-bāṭī, gṛhe dibe cḣaḍā-jhāṭī, 
snāna kare pavitra lāgiyā 
kaha dekhi kebā cḣila, kāhāra ādara kaila, 
ebe kene fele poḍāiyā 

kahe premānanda chita, jadi chāha nija hita, 
‘kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa’ kaha śhvāsa śhvāsa 
kṛṣṇa jagatera kartā, kṛṣṇa tina-lokatrātā, 
bhaji’ kṛṣṇa kāṭa karmafāṅsa
IDX.en_translation:
O my mind! Listen, you are very stubborn. Leaving the company of the saintly and always enjoying bad company, you do not consider the consequences. 

Becoming subject to lust and other desires, always wandering about intoxicated, you think yourself to be immortal. But the Supreme Judge records your every moment, and in an instant, your pride will be shattered. 

Like a donkey, you carry heavy burdens—your family and children—whom you nurture while thinking they are your own. When Time eventually binds you, this body will remain fallen, and everyone’s face will turn away from it. 

They will take your body outside and sweep the house, then bathe to become purified. Tell me, who was that body really? Who was it that they once cherished? Why do they now throw it away to be burnt? 

Premānanda says: “If you desire your own welfare, chant “Kṛṣṇa! Kṛṣṇa!” with every breath. Lord Kṛṣṇa is the Master of the universe and the deliverer of the three worlds. By worshipping Him, cut the noose of your past actions.”

ore mana! svarga naraka bujha kothā 
je jemana karma kare, temani bhuñjāya tāre, 
bhāviyā dekhile saba hethā 

keha ghoḍāya dolāya fere, keha skandhe vahe kāre, 
cḣatra dhari keha chale pathe 
keha karma-anusāre, janma bhari kārāgāre, 
kāro viṣṭhā keha vahe māthe 

śhata sahasrāyuta lakṣa, keha pāle diyā bhakṣya, 
udara bharite keha nāre 
ekhāne dekhicḣa jebā, pare jā’ tā’ jāne kebā, 
vidhātāra mane se vichāre 

devatā-gandharva-yakṣa, preta-piśhācha-daitya-rakṣa, 
svabhāve sakala parachāra 
jāhāra jemana mata, sei karme anurata, 
sei mata bhakṣya se āchāra 

kṛṣṇa-pāriṣada bhakta, kṛṣṇa karme sadā rata, 
kabhu lipta nahe e saṁsāre 
se rahe māyāra pāra, tāte kāra adhikāra,

Golden-colored Gaura-candra, the purifier of the Kali age, sings while absorbed in divine ecstasy. 

All glories to the congregational chanting of Kṛṣṇa’s names, which cleanses the mirror of the heart and delights the mind! 

All glories to the chanting of Kṛṣṇa’s names, which easily extinguishes the forest fire of material existence and ends all miseries! 

All glories to the chanting of Kṛṣṇa’s names, the enjoyment of devotion, which illuminates the night-lotus of ultimate good with moonlight! 

All glories to the chanting of Kṛṣṇa’s names, the perfected form and the very life of the pure bride of knowledge! 

All glories to the chanting of Kṛṣṇa’s names, the inundating form that increases the ocean of bliss! 

All glories to the chanting of Kṛṣṇa’s names, the bestower of divine love, which gives the taste of nectar at every step! 

Bhaktivinoda proclaims this as the process to bathe one’s own self; all glories to the congregational chanting of Kṛṣṇa’s names, the treasure house of divine love!
IDX.es_translation:
Śhrī Gaura, el salvador de la era de Kali de tez dorada, canta lo siguiente saturado de bhāva. 

Toda gloria al śhrī kṛṣṇa-kīrtana, que limpia el espejo del corazón y deleita al alma. 

Toda gloria al śhrī kṛṣṇa-kīrtana, que, incluso cuando se canta de un modo indiferente, tiende a extinguir el fuego forestal de la existencia material y poner fin a todo el sufrimiento. 

Toda gloria al śhrī kṛṣṇa-kīrtana, que lanza rayos de luna sobre el blanco loto de la buena fortuna [haciendo que florezca] y que es un pasatiempo de amor del bhakti. 

Toda gloria al śhrī kṛṣṇa-kīrtana, la vida de la esposa del conocimiento trascendental y la personificación de la perfección. 

Toda gloria al śhrī kṛṣṇa-kīrtana, que es glorificado porque expande el océano de la dicha trascendental y es la personificación del diluvio [de prema]. 

Toda gloria al śhrī kṛṣṇa-kīrtana, que otorga el gusto del néctar a cada paso. Este canto es el manantial del amor puro por Dios. 

Toda gloria al śhrī kṛṣṇa-kīrtana, que baña el alma de Bhaktivinoda y es la causa fundamental del prema.

O Lord, be merciful this time. Seeing the feet of the Couple, I will make my eyes successful; this is the desire of my mind. 

Give me service to Your own feet, do not neglect me; Both Lords are oceans of mercy. I do not know anything without Both of You; I consider this a great fortune. I am very fallen and sinful. 

Receiving the order of Lalitā, going to serve the feet—this is in my mind, in the company of the dear sakhīs. Both are the crest-jewels of givers; knowing me to be very lowly, They will give Their feet nearby in charity. 

I will get the feet of Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa, the wound of the mind will be healed; all this distress will go away. Narottama Dāsa says: This desire is fulfilled; body, life—everything is successful.

IDX.en_translation:
From The Harmonist, November 1927. Edited by Bhakti Siddhānta Sarasvatī. 

With a mind so evil, In the midst of this world, Forsaken as I lay, Thy Own servant, A superior person, Thou didst send. 

Pitying me, Fallen as I was, He came to me and said,-- “Thou seem’st humble, Listen to good words That will cheer thy heart. 

“To deliver Thee Sri Krishna Chaitanya Has appeared in Navadwipa; Many another like thyself, As humble and as base, He has conducted safely across the sea of the world. 

“The promise of the Vedas To fulfill, The Son of Brahman, of golden colour, Bearing the Name of Mahaprabhu, Fills with ecstasy Nadia In company of the super-ascetic, His brother. 

“The Supreme Lord Chaitanya, Who is no other than the Son of Nanda, By the free gift of His Own Name, Has wrought the deliverance of the world, Go thou also And receive thy salvation. 

“Hearing those words I have come, O Lord, For the shelter of Thy feet,” Bhakti-vinode, Crying out in grief, Narrates the story of himself.
IDX.es_translation:
(¡Oh Señor!) He tenido la desgracia de caer en este mundo material, pero Tú has enviado a una gran alma, uno de Tus propios asociados, para salvarme. 

Viéndome en una condición tan caída, él se apiadó de mí y me dijo: “¡Oh, alma humilde!, escucha este buen consejo que traerá dicha a tu corazón.” 

“Śhrī Kṛṣṇa Chaitanya ha descendido a la tierra de Navadvīpa para liberarte. Él ha conducido ya a muchas otras almas miserables como tú al otro lado del océano de la existencia material.” 

“Cumpliendo con la promesa de los Vedas, Él apareció con una tez dorada y como el hijo de un brahmán. Conocido con el nombre de ‘Mahāprabhu’, Él y Su hermano, el avadhūta Nityānanda, han hecho enloquecer a todo Nadīyā de éxtasis divino.” 

“Śhrī Chaitanya, que es el mismo hijo de Nanda, ha salvado al mundo distribuyendo Su santo nombre. Ve y recibe tú también la liberación.” 

¡Oh Señor!, al escuchar estas palabras, Bhaktivinoda ha acudido a Tus pies de loto. Él relata sollozando la historia de su vida.

IDX.translation_intro: From The Harmonist, October 1927. Edited by Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī.
IDX.en_translation:
Hear, O Lord, the tale of my sorrows-- The poison of worldly enjoyment I have sipped, pretending it was the nectar; But now the sun is setting. 

In the diversions of play my childhood, My boyhood in studies, I wasted; There arose no consciousness of good in me. For enjoying my youth, I devised a home and settled down in it; Children and friends did fast multiply. 

Old age soon arrived, All joys departed; With disease I was smitten down. The senses lost their vigour, The body grew feeble, The heart was sad lacking enjoyment. 

Devoid of a particle of true knowledge, Missing the elixir of devotion, What help is there for me? Thou art the Friend of the fallen; I am the worst of sinners; In mercy lift me to Thy feet. 

Judging me Thou wilt find no good; Have pity, judge me not! The nectar of Thy lotus feet Make me taste; Do Thou deliver Bhaktivinode.

IDX.en_translation:
O Lord! This is my humble submission at Your lotus feet: I do not ask for bodily happiness, knowledge, wealth, or followers. 

I do not ask for heaven, nor do I ask for liberation. I do not pray for any opulence. 

By the merits and demerits of my own karma, whatever births I may receive, may I, birth after birth, sing Your names and glories. 

This is my only hope at Your feet: that causeless devotion awakens in my heart at every moment. 

Whatever affection I currently have for sense objects, may that same affection be for Your feet. 

May that affection remain equal in distress and prosperity, and may it increase day by day by the influence of Your Holy Name. 

Whether I become an animal or a bird, whether I am in heaven or in hell, may devotion to You remain in Bhaktivinoda’s heart.
IDX.es_translation:
¡Oh, Señor! Elevo mi humilde súplica a Tus pies de loto. No oro por placeres físicos, conocimiento, riquezas o seguidores. 

No busco el cielo o la salvación, y tampoco oro por ninguna clase de opulencia. 

Sea cual sea el nacimiento que obtenga por los méritos y fallos de mi karma, que cante las glorias de Tu santo nombre nacimiento tras nacimiento. 

Mi única esperanza es que se despierte en mi corazón a cada momento ahaitukī-bhakti (devoción inmotivada) por Tus pies de loto. 

Cualquier atracción que yo posea ahora por placeres mundanos, que se convierta en atracción por Tus pies. 

Que esa atracción permanezca siempre, en la prosperidad y en la adversidad, y que incremente día tras día por la influencia del santo nombre. 

Tanto si soy un ave como si soy una fiera, y tanto si estoy en el cielo como si estoy en el infierno, que el bhakti por Ti permanezca por siempre en el corazón de este Bhaktivinoda.

IDX.en_translation:
Hearing the Lord’s words, Śrīvāsa then prostrated himself on the ground and said, “Listen, my Lord! I cannot bear to see Your spiritual absorption broken. 

One son, my Lord, has died; what sorrow is that to me? Even if everyone were to die, if I can only behold You, I will still find happiness. 

If Your dancing were interrupted, O Lord, that would be my true death! Therefore, fearing misfortune, no bad news was given to You. 

Now give Your permission; taking the dead son, let everyone perform the funeral rites.” Hearing this, Lord Caitanya, the jewel of the twice-born, then began to cry. 

“How can I leave such devotees?” His heart became distressed. Hearing those words, Bhaktivinoda felt fear in his heart.

IDX.en_translation:
Seeing the evening arrive, all the gopīs become joyful and prepare for the secret meeting. Following Vṛndā’s instructions, Rādhā goes to the banks of the Yamunā, Her heart set on the grove of wish-fulfilling trees. 

Adorned in appropriate attire for the dark night, Rādhā sets out for the meeting. Meanwhile, Lord Kṛṣṇa, the crest-jewel of the cowherd assembly, contemplates many excellent qualities. 

“My dear child is tired, let him sleep soundly,” saying this, Mother Yaśodā takes Lord Kṛṣṇa and lays Him upon His bed. The Lord then secretly and alone departs, and after observing His mother to be asleep, He goes to another dwelling. 

Finding Himself alone, He leaves the bed and appears in the grove. The entire Vṛndāvana forest blossoms with joy upon seeing the Lord’s arrival, and all the gopīs become delighted.

IDX.en_translation:
At the time of twilight, in the courtyard of Śrīvāsa, Gaura-candra secretly dances with various ecstasies during the chanting of the Lord’s names, and auspicious sounds arise. 

Drums and cymbals sound, interspersed with calls of victory. Seeing the dancing of the Lord, everyone’s distress was dispelled. 

With unbroken love, all the devotees became intoxicated; forgetting themselves, they surrounded Gaura-candra, dancing and singing constantly. 

At such a time, due to a divine illness, in the inner chambers of Śrīvāsa, the women cried out loudly in grief over the separation from a son. 

Bhaktivinoda fears that if weeping arises, the spiritual mellow will be broken. Śrīvāsa immediately understood the reason and entered his own home.

IDX.en_translation:
From the waters of the deluge, You rescued the Vedas; acting like a boat, You saved them without effort. O Keśava, assuming the form of a fish—all glory to You, Lord of the universe, O Hari! 

The Earth rests on Your immense back, which is adorned with the marks of carrying the world. O Keśava, assuming the form of a tortoise—all glory to You, Lord of the universe, O Hari! 

The Earth rests on the tip of Your tusk, appearing like a dark mark on the moon. O Keśava, assuming the form of a boar—all glory to You, Lord of the universe, O Hari! 

On Your beautiful lotus-like hand, Your nails are like wondrous sharp weapons that tore apart the body of the demon king Hiraṇyakaśipu. O Keśava, assuming the form of a man-lion—all glory to You, Lord of the universe, O Hari! 

You tricked the demon king Bali with Your strides; in Your wondrous dwarf form, the waters from Your toenail purify all beings. O Keśava, assuming the form of a dwarf—all glory to You, Lord of the universe, O Hari! 

You cleanse the world of its sins with the blood of warriors, bathing it in waters that extinguish the fires of material existence. O Keśava, assuming the form of Paraśurāma—all glory to You, Lord of the universe, O Hari! 

You distribute the lovely heads of the ten-headed demon in all directions during battle—heads desired even by the guardians of the directions. O Keśava, assuming the form of Rāma—all glory to You, Lord of the universe, O Hari! 

You wear garments the color of a cloud on Your pure body, just like the Yamunā appears when frightened by Your plow. O Keśava, assuming the form of the plow-bearer Balarāma—all glory to You, Lord of the universe, O Hari! 

You condemn the animal slaughter in Vedic rituals, showing a compassionate heart for the creatures therein. O Keśava, assuming the form of Buddha—all glory to You, Lord of the universe, O Hari! 

You wield a sword for the destruction of the impious, appearing terrible like a comet. O Keśava, assuming the form of Kalki—all glory to You, Lord of the universe, O Hari! 

Śrī Jayadeva has sung this exalted, auspicious, blissful, and essential song. O Keśava, assuming ten different forms—all glory to You, Lord of the universe, O Hari! 

Obeisances to You, Kṛṣṇa, who delivered the Vedas, who upholds the worlds, who holds up the earth, who tore apart the demons, who deceived Bali, who destroyed the arrogant warriors, who conquered Rāvaṇa, who wields the plow, who expands compassion, and who stupefied the impious. O Lord who took on these ten forms, our obeisances!

O Lord of my life! This person offers a petition: O Govinda, Moon of Gokula, the ultimate source of bliss, please consider me dear to the cowherd girls. 

Grant me the service of Your lotus feet; this is my true wealth. You, my Lord, are a treasure house of mercy. Your supremely auspicious glories—hearing them is the highest nectar. What purpose cannot be accomplished through them? 

The terrible current of material existence, a difficult material mentality, and the dart of forgetting You pierce my heart. My body and mind are worn out and unconscious every moment. While living, I am as good as dead from sorrow. 

Upon such a fallen person like me, please cast Your merciful glance and keep me as a servant in Vṛndāvana. The name of Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya is my Lord, my golden abode. Narottama takes refuge in Him.

Fragrant sandalwood paste, jewel-studded ornaments, and silk garments of various colors—may I become the maidservant of Her for whom all these services are performed, and always remain with Her. 

Making the water fragrant and filling a jeweled pitcher, preparing betel nut flavored with camphor—arranging all these in a basket, along with cloves, a garland of jasmine flowers, and various incomparable foodstuffs. 

When the companion gives a signal, when will I bring all these and offer them to Lalitā? Narottama dāsa says: may this be my destiny, to stand behind the companions.

When will Lalitā-sakhī give me a fan and allow me to fan Them with a gentle breeze? All the perspiration of fatigue will vanish from Their bodies, and I will gaze upon Them with supreme bliss. 

Narottama Dāsa hopes to drink the sweetness of serving Their lotus feet. When will such a day come? I do not see any sign of it now, but I long to see the Divine Couple with my own eyes.

IDX.search: radha chinta nivesena jasya kantir vilopita sri krsna charanam vande radhalingita vigraham sevya sevaka sambhoge dvayor bhedah kuto bhavet vipralambhe tu sarvasya bhedah sada vivardhate chillila mithunam tattvam bhedabhedamachintyakam sakti saktimatoraikyam jugapadvartate sada tattvamekam param vidyal lilaya taddvidhasthitam gaurah krsnah svayam hyetad ubhavubhayamapnutah sarve varna jatravista gaura kantir vikasate sarva varnena hinastu krsna varnah prakasate sagunam nirgunam tattvam ekamevadvitiyakam sarva nitya gunair gaurah krsna rasastu nirgunaih sri krsnam mithunam brahma tyaktva tu nirgunam hi tat upasate mrsa vijnah jatha tusavaghatinah sri vinoda vihari jo radhaya milito jada tadaham vandanam kuryam sarasvati prasadatah iti tattvastakam nityam jah pathet sraddhayanvitah krsna tattvamabhijnaya gaura pade bhavenmatih
IDX.author: bhakti prajñāna keśhava gosvāmī mahārāja
IDX.verses:
rādhā-chintā-niveśhena 
jasya kāntir-vilopitā 
śhrī-kṛṣṇa-charaṇaṁ vande 
rādhāliṅgita-vigraham 

sevya-sevaka-sambhoge 
dvayor-bhedaḥ kuto bhavet 
vipralambhe tu sarvasya 
bhedaḥ sadā vivardhate 

chillīlā-mithunaṁ tattvaṁ 
bhedābhedamachintyakam 
śhakti-śhaktimatoraikyaṁ 
jugapadvartate sadā 

tattvamekaṁ paraṁ vidyāl 
līlayā taddvidhāsthitam 
gauraḥ kṛṣṇaḥ svayaṁ hyetad 
ubhāvubhayamāpnutaḥ 

sarve varṇā jatrāviṣṭā 
gaura-kāntir-vikāśhate 
sarva-varṇena hīnastu 
kṛṣṇa-varṇaḥ prakāśhate 

saguṇaṁ nirguṇaṁ tattvam 
ekamevādvitīyakam 
sarva-nitya-guṇair-gauraḥ 
kṛṣṇa-rasastu nirguṇaiḥ 

śhrī-kṛṣṇaṁ mithunaṁ brahma 
tyaktvā tu nirguṇaṁ hi tat 
upāsate mṛṣā vijñāḥ 
jathā tuṣāvaghātinaḥ 

śhrī-vinoda-vihārī jo 
rādhayā milito jadā 
tadāhaṁ vandanaṁ kuryāṁ 
sarasvatī-prasādataḥ 

iti tattvāṣṭakaṁ nityaṁ 
jaḥ paṭhet śhraddhayānvitaḥ 
kṛṣṇa-tattvamabhijñāya 
gaura-pade bhavenmatiḥ
IDX.en_translation:
Due to absorption in thoughts of Rādhā, His own luster is hidden; I bow to the lotus feet of Śrī Kṛṣṇa, whose form is embraced by Rādhā. 

In the enjoyment of the served and the servant, how can there be a difference between them? Yet in separation, the difference between them always increases. 

The principle of the divine playful couple is inconceivable as both different and non-different. The oneness of the energy and its possessor always exists simultaneously. 

Know the Supreme Reality to be one; through divine sport, it exists in two ways. Gaura and Kṛṣṇa are verily the same; both obtain each other. 

Where all colors are absorbed, the golden luster manifests. But when devoid of all colors, the blackish color shines forth. 

The Absolute with attributes and without attributes is one and without a second. Gaura is endowed with all eternal qualities, while Kṛṣṇa’s mellow is beyond them. 

The so-called wise falsely worship the impersonal Absolute, abandoning Śrī Kṛṣṇa, the Divine Couple; they are just like those who beat empty husks. 

When Śrī Vinoda-bihārī is united with Rādhā, I offer my obeisances by the grace of Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Prabhupāda. 

Thus, if one daily reads these eight verses with faith, knowing the principle of Kṛṣṇa, his mind becomes fixed at the feet of Lord Caitanya.
IDX.es_translation:
Yo adoro los pies de loto de esa forma de Śhrī Kṛṣṇa que, por estar pensando ansiosamente en Śhrīmatī Rādhikā, ha adoptado Su color dorado. [La absorción en la separación de Śhrīmatī Rādhikā cuando Ella exhibe māna (ira celosa) se intensifica hasta tal punto, que Kṛṣṇa adopta el color dorado de Ella. Otro significado de rādhāliṅgita es que Él finalmente abraza a Śhrīmatī Rādhikā cuando Ella abandona su māna.] 

Cuando el objeto supremo del servicio amoroso y la sirvienta amorosa suprema se funden en amor absoluto, ¿cómo puede haber distinción entre Ellos? Pero cuando están separados, todas Sus diferencias se intensifican perpetuamente. [Śhrī Kṛṣṇa es sevyā, el objeto supremo del servicio, y bhoktā, el disfrutador trascendental supremo; y Śhrīmatī Rādhikā es sevaka, la sirvienta suprema, y bhogya, el objeto trascendental supremo del disfrute de Él. En el sambhoga, la unión trascendental, Ellos son abheda, no hay diferencia entre ambos, pero en el vipralambha, la separación trascendental, Su bheda o dualidad en forma de cualidades únicas, se intensifica más y más.] 

La Pareja Divina, que lleva a cabo eternamente pasatiempos trascendentales, son una realidad existencial inconcebiblemente diferente y no-diferente, pues la potencia suprema y el supremo poseedor de la potencia son siempre una unidad. [Para-tattva, la realidad existencial suprema, jamás está sin Su energía o śhakti. Cuando la śhakti (potencia) y el śhaktimān (la fuente suprema de todas las potencias), tienen una sola forma, se manifiesta el gaura-tattva, la realidad de Śhrī Gaura-chandra. Cuando Ellos se encuentran en dos cuerpos separados, līlā-puruṣottama Śhrī Kṛṣṇa disfruta de ilimitados pasatiempos trascendentales con Śhrīmatī Rādhikā.] 

La Verdad Absoluta, que es uno e incomparable, ha dividido Sus pasatiempos en dos partes. Gaura es Kṛṣṇa, y Kṛṣṇa es Gaura; por tanto, Ambos son directamente la forma original de Dios. [Aunque la Verdad Absoluta Suprema es una, tiene dos clases de pasatiempos. En uno Él es Śhyāmasundara Śhrī Kṛṣṇa y en el otro Él es Gaurasundara. Śhyāmasundara es Gaurasundara y Gaurasundara es Śhyāmasundara. Así, ambos son Svayaṁ Bhagavān, la Suprema Personalidad de Dios Original de quien todas las demás formas de Dios se manifiestan.] 

Dondequiera que se combinan todos los colores se manifiesta un color dorado. Pero en la ausencia de color se manifiesta el negro. [Según la ciencia natural, cuando toda la gama de colores visibles está presente en igual proporción, como ocurre con el sol, se manifiesta el color dorado. En sánscrito esto se denomina gaura-kānti. Por otro lado, en ausencia de luz visible, se manifiesta el color negro o śhyāma-kānti.] 

La Verdad Absoluta Suprema, que es único e incomparable, al mismo tiempo posee todos los atributos y carece de atributos. Todas las cualidades trascendentales están eternamente manifiestas en Śhrī Gaura. Y la totalidad de los sentimientos trascendentales completamente libres de cualidades materiales, se manifiestan en Śhrī Kṛṣṇa. [La palabra varṇa (tez) en el verso anterior y la palabra guṇa (cualidad) en este verso establecen que śhrī-gaura-tattva es tan venerable como śhrī-kṛṣṇa-tattva. La Verdad Absoluta Suprema es al mismo tiempo saguṇa o poseedora de todos los atributos trascendentales y nirguṇa o carente de atributos materiales.) 

Los que abandonan estas dos formas de Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa, el Absoluto Supremo, y adoran la existencia impersonal no-diferenciada y omnipresente, buscan inteligentemente arroz en cáscaras vacías. [Aunque alguien conozca todas las escrituras, sus esfuerzos por lograr mukti (la liberación impersonal) mediante la adoración del brahma impersonal son una labor infructuosa. Es decir, esa persona carece de inteligencia.] 

Por la misericordia de Śhrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Prabhupāda, yo adoro a Śhrī Vinoda-Bihārī y a Śhrīmatī Rādhikā cuando están juntos. [Por la misericordia de śhrī guru, yo recibo el darśhana (una visión trascendental) de la Pareja Divina, Śhrī Śhrī Rādhā-Vinoda-bihārī, en el momento de Su encuentro trascendental.] 

La persona que recite diariamente este aṣṭakam con mucha fe, comprenderá por completo el kṛṣṇa-tattva y se absorberá en la meditación en los pies de loto de Śhrī Gaurasundara.

Revealing the sentiments of the heart, concealing their mutual faults, and skillfully deceiving rivals; teaching skillful acts, arranging the meeting of Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa, and performing various services like fanning. 

Skillfully saving the life of the heroine during her various emotional states—know these as the general duties of a female friend. 

Whatever specific duty belongs to which friend will be explained in due course. Whoever worships following Rūpa Gosvāmī accepts that service according to whichever friend’s service he follows.

IDX.verses: rādhā-kṛṣṇa karo dhyāna, svapane nā bala āna, prema vinu āra nāhi chāṅa yugalakiśhora prema, jini’ lakṣavāna hema, ārati-pirīti-rase dhāṅa jala vinu jena mīna, duḥkha pāya āyuhīna, prema vinu eimata bhakta chātaka jalada gati, emati ekānta-rati, jei jāne, sei anurakta saroja-bhramara jena, chakora-chandrikā tena, pativratā strīlokera pati anyatra nā chale mana, jena daridrera dhana, eimata premabhakti rīti viṣaya garalamaya, nāhe māna’ sukhachara, se nā sukha, duḥkha kari’ māna’ govinda viṣaya rasa, saṅga kara tāṅra dāsa, premabhakti satya kari’ jāna’ madhye madhye ācḣe duṣṭa, dṛṣṭi kari’ haya ruṣṭa, guṇahi viguṇa kari’ māne govinda vimukhajane, sfūrti nahe hena dhane, laukika kariyā saba jāne ajñāna abhāgā jata, nāhi laya sata-mata, ahaṅkāra nā jāne āpanā abhimānī bhaktihīna, jagamājhe sei dīna, vṛthā tāra aśheṣa bhāvanā āra saba parihari’, parama īśhvara hari, seva mana prema kari’ āśhā eka vraja-rājapura, govinda rasikavara, karaha sadāi abhilāṣā narottama-dāsa kahe, sadā mora prāṇa dahe, hena bhakta-saṅga nā pāiyā abhāgyera nāhi ora, micḣāmohe hainu bhora, duḥkha rahe antare jāgiyā
IDX.en_translation:
I meditate on Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa; in my dreams I speak of nothing else. Except for divine love, I desire nothing else. The love of the youthful Divine Couple, surpassing the beauty of millions of gold coins—I chase after it with ardent affection. 

Just as a fish suffers endlessly without water, its life ending, so too is a devotee without divine love. Like the chakora bird’s desire for rain clouds—such is one-pointed devotion; whoever knows this is truly devoted. 

Like a bee to a lotus, or a chakora bird to the moonlight, or a chaste wife to her husband—my mind does not wander elsewhere. Like a poor man’s treasure, this is the principle of loving devotion. 

Material enjoyments are like poison; do not consider them happiness. Regard that not as happiness, but as sorrow. The sweet mellows of Govinda—associate with His servants and know that loving devotion is the truth. 

Among them are wicked people who become angry when they see truth and consider good qualities to be faults. To those averse to Govinda, such wealth does not manifest; they consider everything to be mundane. 

All the ignorant and unfortunate ones do not accept the true path; due to ego, they do not know themselves. The arrogant and devotionless are the most wretched in this world; their endless thoughts are in vain. 

Giving up everything else, serve the Supreme Lord Hari with your mind, desiring divine love. The abode of Vraja, where Govinda is the best of those who relish mellows—always yearn for Him. 

Narottama dāsa says: “My heart always burns, not having found the association of such devotees. My misfortune has no end; I am absorbed in false illusion, and sorrow remains awake within my heart.”

O Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa! This soul makes this humble submission. Both of You are full of divine mellows and have compassionate hearts; please listen to me, my Lords. 

O Kṛṣṇa, Moon of Gokula, beloved of the cowherd girls! O best among Kṛṣṇa’s beloveds! You are golden-complexioned, and He is dark-complexioned. Just hearing about You brings solace; hearing Your qualities pacifies my soul. 

For the fallen and distressed, You have only compassion in Your minds. Your fame and renown are known throughout the three worlds. Hearing from the mouths of the saintly, I joyfully took refuge. If You neglect me, I have no other recourse. 

All glories to Rādhā! All glories to Kṛṣṇa! All glories, all glories to Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa! With folded hands above his head, Narottama falls to the ground and says: “Both of You, please fulfill my heart’s desire”.

IDX.verses: rādhā-kṛṣṇa prāṇa mora yugala-kiśhora jīvane maraṇe gati āra nāhi mora kālindīra kūle keli-kadambera vana ratana vedīra upara basāba du’jana śhyāmagaurī aṅge diba (chuyā) chandanera gandha chāmara ḍhulāba kabe heriba mukha-chandra gaṅthiyā mālatīra mālā diba dohāra gale adhare tuliyā diba karpūra tāmbūle lalitā viśhākhā ādi jata sakhīvṛnda ājñāya kariba sevā charaṇāravinda śhrī-kṛṣṇachaitanya prabhura dāsera anudāsa sevā abhilāṣa kare narottama-dāsa
IDX.en_translation:
Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa are my life, the youthful Couple. In life or death, I have no other refuge. 

On the bank of the Kālindī, in the forest of playful kadamba trees, I will seat the Two on a jeweled throne. 

I will smear sandalwood paste scented with 'cuyā' on the dark and fair limbs of Śyāma and Gaurī. Fanning Them with a yak-tail whisk, when will I gaze upon Their moon-like faces? 

Stringing a garland of mālatī flowers, I will place it around Both of Their necks. I will lift camphor-laced betel nuts to Their lips. 

Lalitā, Viśākhā, and all the other sakhīs—by their order, I will serve the lotus feet. 

The servant of the servant of Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya Prabhu—Narottama Dāsa desires this service.
IDX.es_translation:
La joven Pareja Divina, Śhrī Śhrī Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa, son mi vida y alma. En la vida o en la muerte, Ellos son mi único refugio. 

En una arboleda de kadambas situada en las riberas del Kālindi (el río Yamunā), sentaré a Ambos en un trono incrustado de joyas. 

Decoraré Sus cuerpos oscuro y dorado con pasta de sándalo perfumada con cuwa, y luego Los abanicaré con una cāmara. ¿Cuándo contemplaré Sus rostros de luna? 

Tras ensartar guirnaldas de flores malati, las colocaré alrededor de Sus cuellos y luego pondré tāmbūla (betel) aromatizado con alcanfor en Sus bocas de loto. 

Siguiendo la orden de Lalitā, Viśhākhā y las demás sakhīs, serviré Sus pies de loto. 

Narottama dāsa, el sirviente del sirviente de Śhrī Kṛṣṇa Chaitanya Mahāprabhu, implora por el servicio a la Pareja Divina.

IDX.verses: rādhā-kuṇḍa-taṭa-kuñja-kuṭīra govardhana-parvata, yāmuna-tīra kusuma-sarovara, mānasa-gaṅgā kalinda-nandinī vipula-taraṅgā vaṁśhī-vaṭa, gokula, dhīra-samīra vṛndāvana-taru-latikā-vānīra khaga-mṛga-kula, malaya-vātāsa mayūra, bhramara, muralī-vilāsa veṇu, śhṛṅga, pada-chihṇa, megha-mālā vasanta, śhaśhāṅka, śhaṅkha, karatālā yugala-vilāse anukūla jāni līlā-vilāsa-uddīpaka māni e saba cḣoḍata kaṁhi nāhi jāṅu e saba cḣoḍata parāṇa hārāṅu bhakativinoda kahe, śhuna kāna! tuyā uddīpaka hāmārā parāṇa
IDX.translation_intro: From The Harmonist, February 1929. Edited by Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī.
IDX.en_translation:
The groved cottage by the side of the pool of Radha, The Gobardhan Mount, the Bank of the Yamuna 

The Kusuma Tank. the Manasa Ganga, The Darling Daughter of Kalinda of mighty current, 

Bansibata, Gokula, Dhir-Samira, The water thut serves the trees and creepers of Brindaban, 

All different species of Birds and Deer, the Malaya Breeze, Peacocks, Black Bees, the Diversions of the Flute, 

Cane, Horn, Font.prints, Wreaths of Clouds, Spring, Moon, Conch, karatala,- 

Knowing these to accord well with the blissful sports of the Divine pair I cherish as excitants of the resurgence of the Divine pastimes 

I go nowhere leaving these, I lose my life if T give them up 

‘Listen, O Kan, says Bhaktivinode, ‘My life is an excitant of Thee’.
IDX.es_translation:
Una enramada de parras a orillas del Rādhā-kuṇḍa, la colina de Govardhana, las riberas del Yamunā... 

… Kusuma-sarovara, Mānasa-gaṅgā, la hija del monte Kalinda (Yamunā) con sus expansivas olas... 

Vaṁśhīvaṭa, Gokula, Dhīra-samīra, los árboles, las enredaderas y los bosquecillos de Vṛndāvana... 

... las aves y los ciervos, la fresca brisa procedente de las montañas Malaya, los pavos reales, los abejorros, los pasatiempos con la flauta muralī... 

... la flauta veṇu, la trompa de cuerno de búfalo, las huellas en el polvo de esa tierra, los cúmulos de nubes, la primavera, la media luna, la caracola y los karatālās... 

Sé que todos esos elementos son favorables para los intercambios conyugales amorosos de la Pareja Divina y, por lo tanto, los considero como uddīpana, estímulos que evocan el recuerdo de Sus lúdicos pastiempos amorosos. 

No iré a ninguna parte dejando atrás esos estímulos, pues abandonarlos es como abandonar la vida misma. 

Bhaktivinoda dice: “¡Escúchame, oh Kāna, Tus uddīpana son mi vida y mi alma”.

rādhā-mādhava kuñja-vihārī

IDX.en_translation: Rādhā-Mādhava is the enjoyer of pastimes in the groves. He is the beloved of the gopīs and the lifter of Govardhana Hill. He is the son of Mother Yaśodā, the delighter of the inhabitants of Vraja, and the wanderer in the forests along the banks of the Yamunā.
IDX.es_translation: Śhrī Kṛṣṇa es el amado de Śhrī Rādhā y el disfrutador de pasatiempos en los bosques de Vraja. Él es el ser más querido para las gopīs y quien levantó la colina de Govardhana. Es el amado hijo de Madre Yaśhodā, da placer a los residentes de Vraja y pasea por los bosques a orillas del río Yamunā.

IDX.en_translation:
I offer my obeisances to the goddess Lalitā, who is very charming with all her qualities. Her body is used as an instrument to wipe away the drops of sweat originating from the lotus feet of Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa, and she is very bold due to her exceedingly elevated and special friendship. 

I offer my obeisances to the goddess Lalitā, who is very charming with all her qualities. Her beautiful face surpasses the luster of the rays of the full moon, her beautiful eyes are restless like those of a startled deer, and she is famous for her art of decorating Rādhā. 

I offer my obeisances to the goddess Lalitā, who is very charming with all her qualities. Her body is adorned with silken garments, ornaments, and a bodice, beautifully colored like the feathers of Garuḍa dancing joyfully, and her golden complexion shames the luster of yellow pigment. 

I offer my obeisances to the goddess Lalitā, who is very charming with all her qualities. She instructs Rādhā by saying, “O my friend, be very contrary toward the cunning son of Nanda! Do not be submissive, for that will only lead to your degradation! Rādhā, listen to my beneficial words!” 

I offer my obeisances to the goddess Lalitā, who is very charming with all her qualities. Her eyes become slightly red with anger upon seeing even a little trick played by Kṛṣṇa upon Rādhā, and she quickly shames Him with her clever words. 

I offer my obeisances to the goddess Lalitā, who is very charming with all her qualities. She is the abode of all motherly affection for the queen of the cowherds, she is the teacher of the gopīs in the art of friendship, and she is non-different from the very life of Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa. 

I offer my obeisances to the goddess Lalitā, who is very charming with all her qualities. She immediately fulfills the desires and makes successful anyone in Vraja whom the daughter of Vṛṣabhānu sees to be following her path. 

I offer my obeisances to the goddess Lalitā, who is very charming with all her qualities. She considers the joyful union of Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa as the most excellent of all festivals, and she is the chief among the beloved companions of Gokula. 

One who delights in these eight verses, cherished by the qualities of Lalitā, and reads them with pure vision—that person is lovingly attracted by Rādhā, the effulgent wish-fulfilling creeper of Vṛṣabhānu’s family, into Her own group.
IDX.es_translation:
Ella seca las gotas de sudor que aparecen sobre los pies de loto de Śhrī Śhrī Rādhā-Mādhava. Poseedora del más elevado sauhṛda-rasa, ella se mantiene siempre independiente. Yo ofrezco praṇāma a la valiente y audaz Lalitā-devī, que es un caudal de encantadoras cualidades. 

Su hermoso rostro eclipsa el brillo de la luna llena, sus ojos [siempre inquietos] son como los de una cierva asustada y es famosa por su extraordinaria pericia en el arte de vestir a Śhrīmatī Rādhikā. Yo ofrezco praṇāma a Lalitā-devī, que es un caudal de encantadoras cualidades. 

Su vestido de seda es tan hermoso como las plumas multicolores de un pavo real danzando en éxtasis. Su cuerpo está bellamente adornado con diferentes clases de ornamentos enjoyados y un corpiño. Su tez dorada derrota al color del gorochanā 6. 6 Pigmento de color amarillo brillante utilizado para pintar, para teñir y como tilaka. Yo ofrezco praṇāma a Lalitā-devī, que es un caudal de encantadoras cualidades. 

Ella instruye a Śhrīmatī Rādhikā diciendo: “¡Oh, Kalaṅkini (desvergonzada)! Escucha estas palabras que son beneficiosas para Ti. ¡Oh, Rādhe! Vrajendra-nandana es muy astuto, de modo que mantente firme en tu oposición. No te muestres agradable y sumisa.” Yo ofrezco praṇāma a Lalitā-devī, que es un caudal de encantadoras cualidades. 

Cuando escucha a Vrajendra-nandana pronunciando aunque sea unas cuantas palabras insinuantes a Śhrīmatī Rādhikā, sus ojos enrojecen [de ira] y hace que se avergüence de inmediato con palabras sarcásticas [como “¡Tú eres tan sincero y honesto; un amante tan casto!”]. Yo ofrezco praṇāma a Lalitā-devī, que es un caudal de encantadoras cualidades. 

Ella es la morada del vātsalya-rasa de Śhrī Yaśhodā-devī, la reina de goparāja Nanda. Como el guru instructor de todas las sakhīs, ella les enseña el arte de la amistad. Ella es la vida de Śhrīmatī Rādhikā y del hermano mayor de Baladeva. Yo ofrezco praṇāma a Lalitā-devī, que es un caudal de encantadoras cualidades. 

Cuando ve a alguna joven doncella en cualquier lugar de Vraja y percibe que está inclinada hacia Vṛṣabhānu-nandini, Lalitā satisface de inmediato todos los deseos de esa doncella y hace así que su vida sea un éxito. Yo ofrezco praṇāma a Lalitā-devī, que es un caudal de encantadoras cualidades. 

Su principal labor es dar placer a Śhrīmatī Rādhikā y a Vrajendra-nandana organizando Sus encuentros, que ella considera el mejor de los festivales. Ella es la principal de todas las priya-sakhīs de Gokula. Yo ofrezco praṇāma a Lalitā-devī, que es un caudal de encantadoras cualidades. 

Quienquiera que recite con un corazón alegre y puro estos ocho versos [en alabanza de Lalitā-devī], que son sumamente bellos debido a que describen sus encantadoras cualidades, es afectuosamente atraído hacia Śhrīmatī Rādhikā —la brillante enredadera de los deseos de la dinastía de Vṛṣabhānu Mahārāja— y entra a formar parte de Su grupo de sakhīs [que son como Su propia vida].

Glory to the Mistress! Glory to the Beloved of Hari! Chant “Glory, Glory, Glory to the Daughter of Vṛṣabhānu!” 

Glory to the Golden-limbed One! Glory to the Golden-bodied One! Chant “Glory, Glory, Glory to the Princess of the King of Vraja!”

IDX.en_translation:
In the land named Rāṛha, in the village of Ekacakrā, in the home of Haṛāi Paṇḍita—on the auspicious thirteenth day of the bright fortnight of the month of Māgha—Lord Balarāma was born. 

Haṛāi Paṇḍita, exceedingly joyous, celebrated a grand festival for his son. The entire world trembled with delight, unable to contain its joy. 

Advaita Āchārya, the Lord of Śāntipura, became joyful in his heart and made an inference. He understood within that Lord Balarāma, the elder brother of Kṛṣṇa, had taken birth. 

The minds of all the devotees became very pleased and they floated in an ocean of joy. The sorrowful Kṛṣṇa-dāsa says: “This lowly and fallen soul will surely be delivered.”

Rādhe, all glories to You, beloved of Mādhava, O worshiped by the circle of young women of Gokula.

O full of mercy, please bestow mercy upon me, Whose character is described by Sanaka and Sanātana.

IDX.verses:
rādhe jhūlana padhāro jhuka āye badarā 
jhuka āye badarā, ghira āye badarā 

aiso māna nahī kīje, haṭha cḣoḍo rī alī 
tum to parama sayānī vṛṣabhānu kī lalī 

sājo solah śhriṅgāra ḍāro nainana kajarā 
paharo pañcha-raṅga sāḍī oḍho śhyāma chadarā 

tero rasika pritama, maga johata khaḍo 
rādhe jahā paga dhāro śhyāma nainā dharo 

ḍārī reśhama ḍorī jāpai jhūle rādhā gorī 
jākī baiyā gorī gorī pahare hāthana gajarā
IDX.translation_intro: Rādhe Jhūlana Padhāro
IDX.en_translation:
O Rādhā, go and sit on the swing. Low rain clouds have come and filled the sky. 

Give up Your sulky mood, O friend. Don’t be stubborn like this. You are the dear, highly intelligent daughter of King Vṛṣabhānu. 

Decorate Yourself with sixteen kinds of ornaments and line your eyes with kajjal. Don your five-colored sārī and cover yourself with a thin, dark veil. 

Your playful beloved is waiting for You on the path. O Rādhā, wherever You place Your feet, Śyāma’s eyes follow. 

Silken ropes are hung, upon which fair Rādhā is swinging. Her golden arms are decorated with floral bracelets.

IDX.first_line: rādhikā charaṇa padma sakala śhreyera sadma
IDX.search: radhika charana padma sakala sreyera sadma jatane je nahi aradhila radha padankita dhama vrndavana jara nama taha je na asraya karila radhikabhava gambhira chitta jeba mahadhira gana sanga na kaila jivane kemane se syamananda rasasindhu snanananda labhibe bujhaha ekamane radhika ujjvala rasera acharya radha madhava suddhaprema vicharya je dharila radhapada parama jatane se paila krsna pada amulyaratane radhapada vina kabhu krsna nahi mile radhara dasira krsna sarva vede bale cḣodata dhana jana kalatra suta mita cḣodata karama geyana radha pada pankaja madhurata sevana bhakativinoda paramana
IDX.author: sacchidānanda bhaktivinoda ṭhākura
IDX.verses: rādhikā charaṇa-padma, sakala śhreyera sadma, jatane je nāhi ārādhila rādhā-padāṅkita-dhāma, vṛndāvana jā’ra nāma, tāhā je nā āśhraya karila rādhikābhāva-gambhīra-, chitta jebā mahādhīra, gaṇa-saṅga nā kaila jīvane kemane se śhyāmānanda, rasasindhu-snānānanda, labhibe bujhaha ekamane rādhikā ujjvala-rasera āchārya rādhā-mādhava-śhuddhaprema vichārya je dharila rādhāpada parama jatane se pāila kṛṣṇa-pada amūlyaratane rādhāpada vinā kabhu kṛṣṇa nāhi mile rādhāra dāsīra kṛṣṇa, sarva-vede bale cḣoḍata dhana-jana, kalatra-suta-mita, cḣoḍata karama-geyāna rādhā pada-paṅkaja-, madhurata-sevana, bhakativinoda paramāṇa
IDX.en_translation:
Whoever has not carefully worshipped the lotus feet of Rādhikā, the abode of all auspiciousness, And has not taken shelter in that abode marked by Rādhā’s footprints, named Vṛndāvana. 

How will they attain the joy of Kṛṣṇa, the bliss of bathing in the ocean of divine mellows, Whoever has not associated in life with those great, sober persons whose minds are deeply absorbed in the mood of Rādhikā? Understand this with full attention. 

Rādhikā is the preceptor of the brightest, most exalted divine mellow. The pure love of Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa is to be contemplated. 

Whoever takes hold of Rādhā’s feet with utmost care, They attain Kṛṣṇa’s feet as an invaluable jewel. 

Without Rādhā’s feet, Kṛṣṇa is never attained. Kṛṣṇa belongs to the maidservant of Rādhā; all the sacred texts declare this. 

Give up wealth and people, give up wife, son, and friends, give up fruitive activities and speculative knowledge. Bhakati Vinoda makes the sweet service of Rādhā’s lotus feet his ultimate conclusion.
IDX.es_translation:
Alguien que no ha adorado con mucha atención los pies de loto de Śhrīmatī Rādhikā, que son la morada de todo lo auspicioso; que no se ha refugiado en la morada llamada Śhrī Vṛndāvana, que está decorada con las huellas de los pies de loto de Rādhā... 

... y que en esta vida no se ha asociado con los devotos de Śhrīmatī Rādhikā ―cuyos sentimientos son profundos y graves y cuyo corazón es extremadamente sobrio―, ¿cómo puede esa persona experimentar la bienaventuranza de bañarse en el océano de rasa del amor por Śhrī Śhyāmasundara? 

Śhrīmatī Rādhikā es la āchārya de las melosidades del amor conyugal (ujjvala-rasa). Se debe hablar acerca del amor puro entre Rādhā y Mādhava y meditar en él. 

Quien coloca los pies de loto de Śhrī Rādhā en su corazón con sumo cuidado obtiene la joya inestimable de los pies de loto de Kṛṣṇa. 

Sin los pies de loto de Śhrī Rādhā, nadie puede conocer a Śhrī Kṛṣṇa. Todas las escrituras védicas declaran que Kṛṣṇa pertenece a las sirvientas de Rādhā. 

Tras abandonar las riquezas, los seguidores, la esposa, los hijos y los amigos, así como también las actividades materialistas y el conocimiento especulativo, uno se debe absorber en la dulzura del seva de los pies de loto de Śhrī Rādhā. Esta es la solemne declaración de Bhaktivinoda.

IDX.first_line: rādhikā charaṇa reṇu bhūṣaṇa kariyā tanu
IDX.search: radhika charana renu bhusana kariya tanu anayase pabe giridhari radhika charanasraya je kare se mahasaya tanre muni jano bali hari jaya jaya radha nama vrndavana janra dhama krsna sukha vilasera nidhi hena radha guna gana na sunila mora kana vanchita karila more vidhi tanra bhakta sange sada rasa lila prema katha je kare se paya ghana syama ihate vimukha jei tara kabhu siddhi nai nahi jena suni tara nama krsna nama gane bhai radhika charana pai radha nama gane krsna chandra samksepe kahinu katha ghuchao manera vyatha duhkha maya anya katha dvandva
IDX.author: narottama-dāsa ṭhākura
IDX.verses:
rādhikā-charaṇa reṇu, bhūṣaṇa kariyā tanu, 
anāyāse pābe giridhārī 
rādhikā-charaṇāśhraya, je kare se mahāśhaya, 
tāṅ’re muñi jāṅo bali-hārī 

jaya jaya ‘rādhā’ nāma, vṛndāvana jāṅ’ra dhāma, 
kṛṣṇa sukha-vilāsera nidhi 
hena rādhā-guṇa-gāna, nā śhunila mora kāṇa, 
vañchita karila more vidhi 

tāṅ’ra bhakta-saṅge sadā, rasa-līlā prema-kathā, 
je kare se pāya ghana-śhyāma 
ihāte vimukha jei, tā’ra kabhu siddhi nāi, 
nāhi jena śhuni tā’ra nāma 

kṛṣṇa-nāma-gāne bhāi, rādhikā-charaṇa pāi, 
rādhā-nāma-gāne kṛṣṇa-chandra 
saṁkṣepe kahinu kathā, ghuchāo manera vyathā, 
duḥkha-maya anya kathā-dvandva
IDX.en_translation:
By making the dust of Rādhā’s feet your ornament, you will easily attain the Lord who lifted Govardhana Hill. Whoever takes shelter of Rādhā’s feet—that great soul—I dedicate myself to them. 

All glories to the name “Rādhā,” whose abode is Vṛndāvana, the treasure house of Kṛṣṇa’s blissful pastimes. My ears did not hear such glorification of Rādhā; fate has deprived me. 

Whoever is always in the company of Her devotees, speaking of Their divine pastimes and loving talks, attains the Lord whose complexion is like a dark cloud. Whoever is averse to this will never achieve perfection; I do not even want to hear their name. 

O brother! By singing the name of Kṛṣṇa one attains Rādhā’s feet, and by singing Rādhā’s name one attains Kṛṣṇa. I have told you this truth in brief—now end your mind’s distress; all other talk is full of sorrow and conflict.
IDX.es_translation:
Decora tu cuerpo con el polvo de los pies de loto de Śhrīmatī Rādhikā y alcanzarás fácilmente a Giridhārī. Quien se refugia en los pies de loto de Śhrīmatī Rādhārāṇī es una gran personalidad; yo alabo de corazón a esa gran alma. 

Toda gloria al nombre de Rādhā, cuya morada es Śhrī Vṛndāvana. Ella es la custodia de los bienaventurados pasatiempos que dan placer a Śhrī Kṛṣṇa. Si mis oídos no escuchan las narraciones de las glorias de Rādhā, el destino me ha engañado. 

Quien está siempre inmerso en los temas saturados de amor de Sus pasatiempos llenos de rāsa con Sus devotos, alcanza a Ghanaśhyāma 1. La persona que siente aversión por esto nunca alcanzará la perfección; no deseo ni oír su nombre. 1 Nombre de Kṛṣṇa que significa ‘de tez oscura (śhyāma) como una nube reciente de lluvia (ghana)’. 

¡Oh, hermano! Por cantar el nombre de Kṛṣṇa se alcanza a Śhrīmatī Rādhikā, y por cantar el nombre de Rādhā se alcanza a Śhrī Kṛṣṇa-chandra. Ya te he dicho brevemente cómo encontrar alivio a los sufrimientos de tu corazón. Cualquier cosa que contradiga estas palabras sólo producirá sufrimiento y pesar.

IDX.first_line: rādhikā hṛdayonmādi vaṁśhī kvāṇa madhu ccḣaṭaḥ
IDX.search: radhika hrdayonmadi vamsi kvana madhu ccḣatah radha parimalodgara garimaksipta manasah kamra radha mano mina vadisikrta vibhramah prema garvbandha gandharva kilakinchita ranjitah lalita vasya dhira dhamanabhasa vasikrtah radha vakrokti piyusa madhurya bhara lampatah mukhendu chandrikodghurna radhika raga sagarah vrsabhanu suta kantha hari hara harin manih fulla radha kamalini mukhambuja madhuvratah radhika kucha kasturi patra sfurad urah sthalah iti gokula bhupala sunu lila manoharam jah pathen nama dasakam sosya vallabhatam vrajet
IDX.author: rūpa gosvāmī
IDX.verses:
rādhikā-hṛdayonmādi-vaṁśhī-kvāṇa-madhu-ccḣaṭaḥ 
rādhā-parimalodgāra-garimākṣipta-mānasaḥ 

kamra-rādhā-mano-mīna-vaḍiśhīkṛta-vibhramaḥ 
prema-garvbāndha-gāndharvā-kilakiñchita-rañjitaḥ 

lalitā-vaśhya-dhīrā-dhāmānābhāsa-vaśhīkṛtaḥ 
rādhā-vakrokti-pīyūṣa-mādhurya-bhara-lampaṭaḥ 

mukhendu-chandrikodghūrṇa-rādhikā-rāga-sāgaraḥ 
vṛṣabhānu-sutā-kaṇṭha-hāri-hāra-harin-maṇiḥ 

fulla-rādhā-kamalinī-mukhāmbuja-madhuvrataḥ 
rādhikā-kucha-kastūrī-patra-sfurad-uraḥ-sthalaḥ 

iti gokula-bhūpāla-sūnu-līlā-manoharam 
jaḥ paṭhen nāma-daśhakaṁ so’sya vallabhatāṁ vrajet
IDX.en_translation:
The shower of the honey of the sound of the flute, which maddens Rādhikā’s heart. He whose mind is distracted by the heaviness of the emission of Rādhā’s fragrance. 

He who has made His pastime a fish-hook for the fish of the mind of lovely Rādhā. He is colored by the kilakiñcita of Gāndharvā, who is blinded by the pride of love. 

He is controlled by the mere semblance of the anger of the patient (heroine) controlled by Lalitā. A libertine for the abundance of the sweetness of the nectar of Rādhā’s crooked words. 

The ocean of Rādhikā’s passion, agitated by the moonlight of the moon of Her face. The emerald of the enchanting necklace on the neck of the Daughter of Vṛṣabhānu. 

The bee of the lotus-face of the blooming Rādhā-lotus. He whose chest shines with the musk-leaf on Rādhikā’s breasts. 

He who reads this Name-Decad, charming with the pastimes of the Son of the King of Gokula—he becomes dear to Him.

IDX.first_line: rādhikā śharada indu nindi mukha maṇḍalī
IDX.search: radhika sarada indu nindi mukha mandali kuntale vichitra veni champaka puspa sobhani nilapatta ange sobhe tahe adha odani vandiye sri pada padma vrsabhanu nandini taruna aruna jini sindurera mandali jaicḣi ali matta bhare malayaja gandhini bhurura bhangima koti koti kama ganjini vandiye sri pada padma vrsabhanu nandini khanjana ganjana dithi vangima suchahani anjana ranjita tahe kamasara sandhini tila puspa jini nasa vesara sudolani vandiye sri pada padma vrsabhanu nandini pakva bimbafala jini adhara surangini dasana dadimva bija jini ati sobhani vasanta kokila jini sumadhura volani vandiye sri pada padma vrsabhanu nandini kanaka mukura jini gandayuga sobhani ratana manjira paye vankaraja dolani kesara mukata hara urapara jholani vandiye sri pada padma vrsabhanu nandini kanaka kalasa jini kuchayuga sobhani karivara kara jini vahuyuga dolani sulalita angulite mudrikara sajani vandiye sri pada padma vrsabhanu nandini gaja ari jini maja guruya nitambini tapara sobhita bhala kanakera kinkini kanaka ulata rambha januyuga sobhani vandiye sri pada padma vrsabhanu nandini hamsaraja gati jini sumanthara chalani ratula charane raje kanaya supanjini yugala charane sobhe javaka suranjini vandiye sri pada padma vrsabhanu nandini
IDX.author: sanātana gosvāmī
IDX.verses:
rādhikā śharada-indu-nindi mukha maṇḍalī 
kuntale vichitra veṇī champaka-puṣpa-śhobhanī 
nīlapaṭṭa aṅge śhobhe tāhe ādha oḍanī 
vandiye śhrī-pāda-padma vṛṣabhānu-nandinī 

taruṇa aruṇa jini sindurera maṇḍalī 
jaicḣi ali matta bhare malayaja-gandhinī 
bhurūra bhaṅgima koṭī koṭī kāma-gañjinī 
vandiye śhrī-pāda-padma vṛṣabhānu-nandinī 

khañjana-gañjana diṭhi vaṅgima-suchāhanī 
añjana rañjita tāhe kāmaśhara-sandhinī 
tila-puṣpa jini nāsā vesara-sudolanī 
vandiye śhrī-pāda-padma vṛṣabhānu-nandinī 

pakva bimbafala jini adhara suraṅgiṇī 
daśhana dāḍimva-bīja jini ati śhobhanī 
vasanta kokila jini sumadhura-volanī 
vandiye śhrī-pāda-padma vṛṣabhānu-nandinī 

kanaka-mukura jini gaṇḍayuga-śhobhanī 
ratana-mañjīra pāye vaṅkarāja-dolanī 
keśhara mukatā hāra ura’para jholanī 
vandiye śhrī-pāda-padma vṛṣabhānu-nandinī 

kanaka kalasa jini kuchayuga-śhobhanī 
karivara-kara jini vāhuyuga-dolanī 
sulalita aṅgulite mudrikāra sājanī 
vandiye śhrī-pāda-padma vṛṣabhānu-nandinī 

gaja-ari jini mājā guruyā nitambinī 
tā’para śhobhita bhāla kanakera kiṅkinī 
kanaka-ulaṭa-rambhā jānuyuga-śhobhanī 
vandiye śhrī-pāda-padma vṛṣabhānu-nandinī 

haṁsarāja-gati jini sumanthara-chalanī 
rātula charaṇe rāje kanayā supañjinī 
yugala charaṇe śhobhe jāvaka surañjinī 
vandiye śhrī-pāda-padma vṛṣabhānu-nandinī
IDX.en_translation:
The face of Śrīmati Rādhā-rāṇī shames the autumn moon. Her hair is a wonderful braid adorned with jasmine flowers. A blue cloth and a fine veil adorn Her body. I worship the lotus feet of the daughter of Vṛṣabhānu. 

The mark of vermilion on Her forehead surpasses the beauty of the rising sun. She is like a honeybee intoxicated by the fragrance of sandalwood. The curves of Her eyebrows defeat millions of Cupids. I worship the lotus feet of the daughter of Vṛṣabhānu. 

Her sidelong glances defeat the graceful movements of the wagtail bird. Her eyes, adorned with kohl, are like the arrows of Cupid. Her nose surpasses the beauty of a sesame flower and is adorned with a nose ornament. I worship the lotus feet of the daughter of Vṛṣabhānu. 

Her lips are red like ripe bimba fruit, and Her teeth surpass the beauty of pomegranate seeds. Her sweet voice outshines the cuckoo of spring. I worship the lotus feet of the daughter of Vṛṣabhānu. 

Her cheeks are beautiful like golden mirrors. Jeweled anklets jingle upon Her feet. A pearl necklace hangs upon Her chest. I worship the lotus feet of the daughter of Vṛṣabhānu. 

Her breasts are beautiful like golden pitchers, and Her graceful arms are like the trunk of a magnificent elephant. Adorned rings are upon Her delicate fingers. I worship the lotus feet of the daughter of Vṛṣabhānu. 

Her waist is slender like that of a lion, and Her hips are beautifully heavy. A golden belt is adorned upon them. Her knees are as beautiful as inverted golden banana trees. I worship the lotus feet of the daughter of Vṛṣabhānu. 

Her graceful walk surpasses the gait of a royal swan. On Her reddish feet shine golden anklets. Her feet are beautifully colored with red lac dye. I worship the lotus feet of the daughter of Vṛṣabhānu.

IDX.first_line: rāgāveśhe vraja dhāma vāse jadi tīvra kāma
IDX.search: ragavese vraja dhama vase jadi tivra kama thake tava hrdaya bhitare radha krsna lilarasa paricharya sulalasa hoo jadi nitanta antare bali tabe suna mama mana bhajana chaturavara sri svarupa damodara prabhu seva janhara jivana sagana sri rupa yini rasa tattva jnana mani lila tattva je kaila prakasa tanhara agraja bhai janhara samana nai varnila je yugala vilasa sei saba mahajane spasta prema vijnapane smara mana tumi nirantara bhaktivinodera nati maha jana gana prati vijnapita karaha satvara
IDX.author: sacchidānanda bhaktivinoda ṭhākura
IDX.verses: rāgāveśhe vraja-dhāma-, vāse jadi tīvra kāma, thāke tava hṛdaya-bhitare rādhā-kṛṣṇa-līlārasa, paricharyā-sulālasa, hoo jadi nitānta antare bali tabe, śhuna, mama mana bhajana chaturavara, śhrī-svarūpa-dāmodara, prabhu-sevā jāṅhāra jīvana sagaṇa śhrī-rūpa-yini, rasa-tattva-jñāna-maṇi, līlā-tattva je kaila prakāśha tāṅhāra agraja bhāi, jāṅhāra samāna nāi, varṇila je yugala-vilāsa sei saba mahājane, spaṣṭa prema-vijñāpane, smara, mana tumi nirantara bhaktivinodera nati, mahā-jana-gaṇa-prati, vijñāpita karaha satvara
IDX.en_translation:
If there is an intense desire within your heart for residing in the holy land of Vraja with great attachment, and if you deeply desire the sweet nectar of Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa’s pastimes and Their service, 

Then I say, listen, my mind, to the best of those expert in worship, Śrī Svarūpa Dāmodara, whose very life is the service of the Lord. 

Together with his associates, Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī—who is a jewel of knowledge of transcendental mellows and who revealed the truth of the Lord’s pastimes—and his elder brother, who has no equal, have described the pastimes of the Divine Couple. 

Remember those great personalities with clear declarations of love continuously, O my mind. Make Bhaktivinoda’s obeisances quickly known to those great personalities.
